Title: Data Analyst Looker
Description:
¡Hola! 🙋




¿Todavía no conoces hiberus? Somos una empresa de #tecnología construida con un ingrediente diferencial, la HIPERESPECIALIZACIÓN.




Formar parte de hiberus significa crecimiento, pasión por la tecnología, interés por la innovación, ambiente laboral flexible y colaborativo, compañerismo, aprendizaje, formación continua, motivación y superación ante nuevos retos... y esto es solo el principio.




Contamos con un equipo de más de 4.500 profesionales, 46 áreas de especialización y 35 hubs de desarrollo en España, Europa, Latinoamérica, Estados Unidos y África. Somos la primera empresa tecnológica española de capital privado. En los últimos cuatro años, hemos experimentado un crecimiento exponencial, duplicando nuestro volumen de negocio año tras año. Esto nos ha permitido consolidarnos como un actor clave en el ecosistema tecnológico español y mantenernos competitivos frente a los líderes internacionales ¡Estamos redefiniendo el mapa tecnológico mundial! 🌐💻




Trabajamos muy duro, para transformar nuestra vida a través de la tecnología y queremos contar contigo para seguir creciendo. Si lo tuyo es el mundo IT, te gusta estar al día en las últimas tecnologías y quieres asumir un nuevo reto profesional ¡Sigue leyendo, te estamos buscando!




🔎¿Qué estamos buscando?

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior con experiencia en Looker y Power BI, capaz de transformar necesidades de negocio en modelos analíticos, métricas y cuadros de mando de alto impacto. Queremos una persona con una sólida base en modelado de datos, orientación al cliente y capacidad para convertir información compleja en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones.

Buscamos una persona que nos ayude a seguir creciendo, con ganas de aportar y seguir evolucionando de la mano de los mejores profesionales, pero, sobre todo... ¡en hiberus buscamos buena gente! 😉




💻Algunas de tus funciones

Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos analíticos orientados a negocio.
Definir métricas, KPIs y estructuras de reporting junto a equipos de negocio.
Desarrollar, evolucionar y optimizar dashboards en Looker y Power BI.
Traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas escalables.
Participar en la recogida de requisitos, validación funcional y presentación de resultados a clientes.
Analizar datos y generar insights que aporten valor real al negocio.
Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Arquitectura y Negocio para garantizar la calidad y consistencia del dato.
Proponer mejoras funcionales, analíticas y técnicas de manera proactiva.
Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar procesos de desarrollo y análisis.




💻💪🏻Habilidades y requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años como Data Analyst o roles similares.
Experiencia demostrable en modelado de datos (dimensional, analítico o reporting).

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Power BI, incluyendo:

Diseño de dashboards.
Modelado semántico.
Definición de KPIs y métricas.
Desarrollo con DAX.

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Looker, incluyendo:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de modelos en LookML.
Creación de Explores y vistas.
Desarrollo de cuadros de mando y reporting.
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL para explotación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes y stakeholders de negocio.
Capacidad para comunicar resultados y presentar soluciones analíticas.
Perfil autónomo, proactivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas.
Capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.




🙌¿Qué te ofrecemos?

💼 Contrato indefinido en una compañía puramente tecnológica, que forma parte de un gran grupo, solvente y en crecimiento.

💰 Salario fijo competitivo

🏖️ Ambiente familiar, cercano, ¡como una gran familia!

⏰ Conciliación con nuestra vida personal y laboral mediante horario flexible, desconexión digital, jornada intensiva viernes y verano.

🤙 Cultura “techie”, nos gusta estar en contacto con la tecnología, herramientas, y últimas novedades!

📚 ¡Formación! Siempre que quieras, disfrutarás de un amplio catálogo de cursos formativos, adaptados a tu perfil profesional, inquietudes y novedades del sector. Para ello, pondremos a tu disposición todo el potencial de nuestra Hiberus University y los acuerdos con los principales fabricantes.

💳 ¡Benefíciate! Programa de retribución flexible a medida: seguro médico, tarjeta de transporte público, cheques guardería, tarjeta restaurante, etc.




En hiberus estamos viviendo un crecimiento explosivo 💥 y queremos que formes parte de nuestro equipo.




Suena bien, ¿verdad? Si quieres saber más, ¡inscríbete y te contamos!




Si quieres saber más busca nuestros hashtag

#somoshiberus #lascosasocurrenaquí y conoce todo lo que hacemos.

www.hiberus.com

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Take your career to the next level with Amaris Consulting as a Data Analyst. Be part of an international team, thrive in a global group with a €800M turnover and over 1,000 clients worldwide, and an agile environment. You will join the Data team of one of our clients, working closely with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights. Spanish fluency is required as part of this role.




✍️ WHAT WOULD YOU NEED? ✍️

2-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role.
Strong proficiency with SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Solid knowledge of relational databases, data modelling, and version control tools such as Git.
Familiarity with Python for data analysis and automation.
Proven experience working with reporting solutions, dashboards, and business intelligence tools.
Advanced proficiency in Spanish (written and spoken).
Intermediate level of English.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.




👉 WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions to support business decision-making.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Design, optimize, and maintain database structures to ensure data integrity and performance.
Analyse large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Participate in data quality, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Implement reporting and monitoring solutions that provide meaningful business insights.
Stay current with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in Data Analytics and Business Intelligence.




🚀 WHY US? 🚀

Join our dynamic team of talented people and discover a world full of growth and opportunity. Here's what we offer:

Rapid growth through a personalised career path and salary assessment. 70% of our senior leaders started in entry-level positions.
Improve your skills through our Technology Academy catalogue, Udemy platform, language classes, webinars and workshops.
Take control of your training with a personal annual budget and company-paid certifications.
Enjoy flexible policies, remote work options and excellent social benefits such as transport and restaurant tickets, childcare support and private health insurance.
Benefit from our WeCare programme, which supports employees in critical situations.
Unlock your full potential, both professionally and personally.




Amaris Consulting prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive work environment. To this end, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, creed, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.

Title: Data Analyst French Native Speaker (Python & SQL) - Spain Remote
Description:
Join us on our exciting journey!

We are recruiting a new Data Analyst with work knowledge of Python & SQL and proficient in French language.

Under guidance, performs data analytics activities related to complex business problems and issues to provide insight to decision makers. May provide analytic support for internal project teams and for external client consulting or services engagements.

If you want to play a key role in a multicultural, dynamic and committed team this could be the role for you!

Essential Functions


Under guidance, performs basic quantitative or qualitative analyses to support the development of solutions for internal or external client project teams.
Identifies and interprets trends and patterns in datasets.
Creates specifications for reports and analysis based on business needs and required or available data elements.
May directly produce datasets and reports for analysis using existing IQVIA tools.
Verifies data for accuracy and completeness.
May manipulate and transform data to optimize analyses.
Performs audits of own work or that of others to ensure conformance with established procedures or to resolve routine issues.
May work with stand alone data systems or enterprise wide tools supporting activities such as inquiry resolution, data validation, and trend analysis.


Qualifications


Bachelor's Degree Req
1-3 years of previous professional experience preferably working with pharmaceutical data. Req
Data analysis skills and working knowledge of Microsoft software tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Access), SQL, PowerBI, Python.
Works willingly and effectively with others in and across the organization to accomplish team goals.
Knowledge and understanding of the fundamental processes of the business.
Knowledge of the methods, tools and techniques related to one’s functional area.
Knowledge of the industry and an understanding of the marketplace.
Effective time management skills.


We invite you to join IQVIA™

IQVIA™ is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible – to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA™ is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications and merit. We prohibit discrimination based on any unlawful consideration such as age, race, national origin, gender or other "protected status“.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights, and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

At IQVIA, we believe that diversity, inclusion, and belonging empower our mission to accelerate innovation for a healthier world. We create a culture of belonging by valuing the perspectives of all talented employees worldwide and providing them with the opportunity to power smarter healthcare for everyone, everywhere. When our talented employees bring their authentic selves and their diverse experiences to work, they enable us to accomplish extraordinary things. Multifaceted thought processes spark innovation. Multi-talented collaboration harnesses innovation to deliver superior outcomes. Likewise, as part of this culture, IQVIA is committed to ensuring effective equality between women and men, integrating it as a strategic principle in its corporate and human resources policies.

Title: Sr Data Analyst BigQuery
Description:
En Logicalis Spain estamos en búsqueda de un Senior Data Analyst BigQuery para incorporarse en nuestra área de Data & AI en un proyecto de análisis de Huella Telecom para un servicio estratégico del sector telecomunicaciones.

El equipo de Data & AI de Logicalis trabaja con clientes nacionales e internacionales, llevando a cabo importantes proyectos de ingeniería de datos, inteligencia artificial y analítica avanzada, estrategia del dato, gobierno, integración y arquitectura, abarcando todo el ciclo de vida del dato.

RESPONSABILIDADES


Análisis y explotación de grandes volúmenes de datos para la obtención de insights y apoyo a la toma de decisiones.
Diseño, mantenimiento y optimización de procesos de gestión y calidad de datos.
Desarrollo de soluciones de análisis y automatización utilizando herramientas de tratamiento de datos.
Elaboración de informes, métricas y cuadros de mando para diferentes áreas de la organización.
Colaboración con equipos técnicos y de negocio para identificar oportunidades de mejora y asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos definidos.
Participación activa en iniciativas de mejora continua, eficiencia operativa y optimización de procesos.


REQUISITOS


Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en análisis de datos.
Conocimientos avanzados de SQL y experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de información.
Experiencia en entornos Cloud orientados al dato (valorable GCP/BigQuery).
Conocimientos de Python para automatización, transformación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia en integración, validación y conciliación de datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes.
Dominio de herramientas de reporting y análisis, incluyendo Excel avanzado.
Valorable experiencia con Data Studio / Looker.
Perfil con fuerte capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y resolución de problemas.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración con equipos técnicos y áreas de negocio.


BENEFICIOS

> Incorporación inmediata a compañía líder del sector IT con un alto grado de expertise en el área de Data & Analytics dónde nos encontramos en pleno proceso de expansión.

> Estabilidad laboral a través de contrato indefinido con amplias oportunidades de desarrollo profesional y crecimiento en la compañía.

> Modalidad de trabajo 100% remoto, en cualquier punto de España.

> Paquete retributivo muy competitivo acorde a la valía del candidato.

> Posibilidad de acogerse a planes de retribución flexible (tarjeta restaurante, tarjeta transporte y tarjeta guardería).

> Seguro médico y GYMPASS.

> Planes de formación adaptados a cada perfil (cursos técnicos, certificaciones oficiales, formación de idiomas...).

> Portal de descuentos especiales para empleados.

> Buen ambiente de trabajo y entorno muy colaborativo.

Descubre de esta oferta y muchas más en nuestra Página de Empleo. 🚀

Title: Data Analyst - Las Rozas
Place: Las Rozas de Madrid, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Desde E-Frontiers estamos buscando un perfil de Data Analyst para formar parte de uno de nuestros clientes: una empresa de datos y analítica que ayuda a tomar decisiones en el sector inmobiliario. Ofrecen soluciones como análisis de datos, modelos predictivos y servicios de datos escalables para optimizar inversiones, riesgos y rendimiento.

​​​​​​Formarás del equipo AVM Regulado y participarás en el ​​​​​desarrollo, mantenimiento y entrega de modelos automáticos de valoración, proporcionando valoraciones masivas de activos inmobiliarios.


Tareas:

Diseño, calibración y actualización de modelos estadísticos para la valoración automática masiva de activos inmobiliarios.
Control de la calidad del dato: Exploración, limpieza y validación de bases de datos inmobiliarias.
Monitorización y estudio del error de los modelos.
Elaboración de análisis de mercado y resultados de valoración de carteras.
Automatización de procesos con Python/SQL.
Reporting e interpretación de resultados.


Requisitos:

Grado en Economía, ADE, Ingeniería o Matemáticas.
Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años como Data Analyst.
Conocimiento del mercado de carteras NPL.
Nivel básico de Python, y nivel avanzado de Excel y PPT.
Inglés C1.


Se ofrece:

Contrato indefinido.
Oportunidad de desarrollo profesional.
Híbrido en Las Rozas (3 días oficina, 2 días de teletrabajo).
​​​​​​​Horario flexible.
Servicio de menú diario incluido.



Sobre E-Frontiers: Somos una agencia de reclutamiento especializada en perfiles IT, de origen Irlandés y con presencia en España desde hace 10 años. La contratación será directamente con el cliente y te estaremos dando acompañamiento durante todo el proceso de selección. Trabajamos con diferentes clientes desde Start-Ups hasta multinacionales.

Title: PL/SQL Data Analyst (Power BI) - 100% Remote
Description:
Role Description

¡Estamos buscando el mejor talento! únete a UST

UST es una multinacional líder en servicios de tecnología digital, certificada como Top Employer, con más de 35.000 profesionales en todo el mundo y presencia en más de 30 países. Ayudamos a grandes compañías mediante soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras y proyectos de transformación digital.

¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos un/a PL/SQL Data Analyst con experiencia avanzada en Power BI para incorporarse a un squad Agile y participar de forma integral en el ciclo de vida de las user stories, desde el análisis de requisitos hasta la validación final con negocio.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de garantizar la calidad, consistencia y fiabilidad de la información reportada, trabajando estrechamente con equipos técnicos y usuarios de negocio para desarrollar soluciones de reporting de alto impacto.

Ubicación: 100% remoto

Idioma: Inglés nivel B1 o superior

Responsabilidades principales


Analizar requisitos funcionales y transformarlos en soluciones analíticas eficientes.
Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar dashboards, informes y visualizaciones avanzadas en Power BI.
Realizar validaciones y análisis de datos para asegurar la calidad de la información.
Desarrollar y mantener consultas, procedimientos y procesos en PL/SQL.
Participar en actividades de testing y soporte durante las fases de validación con usuarios de negocio.
Colaborar activamente dentro de un entorno Agile, participando en las ceremonias y actividades del squad.
Garantizar la calidad, consistencia, trazabilidad y fiabilidad de los datos reportados.
Proponer mejoras y automatizaciones en los procesos de reporting existentes.
Participar en el ciclo completo de las user stories, desde el análisis inicial hasta la validación final.


Requisitos clave


Mínimo de 5 - 6 años de experiencia desarrollando dashboards, reporting y visualizaciones en Power BI.
Entre 3 - 4 años de experiencia en PL/SQL.
Experiencia sólida en modelado de datos.
Experiencia en validación, análisis y control de calidad de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con metodologías Agile.
Capacidad analítica, orientación al detalle y compromiso con la calidad de los datos.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y experiencia colaborando con usuarios de negocio.
Nivel de inglés B1 o superior.


Valoraremos especialmente


Conocimientos de Scala a nivel intermedio (3-4 años)
Experiencia en la definición y seguimiento de KPIs y métricas de negocio.
Experiencia en optimización y automatización de procesos de reporting.
Participación en procesos UAT, User Acceptance Testing.
Experiencia acompañando y dando soporte a usuarios de negocio durante las fases de validación y despliegue.


¿Qué ofrecemos?


23 días de vacaciones, además del 24 y 31 de diciembre.
Beneficios sociales, como seguro médico, seguro de vida y accidentes y compensación por teletrabajo.
Programa de retribución flexible para restaurante, guardería, transporte, formación de idiomas y seguro de salud.
Acceso gratuito a diferentes plataformas de formación.
Estabilidad profesional y posibilidades de desarrollo de carrera.
Programa de referidos con incentivos.
Posibilidad de elegir entre 12 o 14 pagas.
Medidas de conciliación y flexibilidad laboral.
Descuentos exclusivos mediante UST Club y acuerdos con gimnasios.


¿Te interesa?

Si te apasionan los datos, Power BI y la generación de información fiable para la toma de decisiones de negocio, queremos conocerte.

Inscríbete y forma parte de UST.

En UST estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y la diversidad. Nuestros procesos de selección se desarrollan sin discriminación por razón de género, edad, discapacidad, raza, religión, orientación sexual o nacionalidad.

Skills

Agile, Dashboard Development, Data Analysis, Data Modeling, Data Validation, KPI Reporting, PL/SQL, Power BI, SQL Server Reporting Services, User Acceptance Testing

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
¡Dale un aire nuevo a tu vida y sigue creciendo en tu carrera dentro de los servicios centrales de VERISURE!

¿Quiénes somos?

Securitas Direct es ahora Verisure, también en España. En Verisure llevamos más de 30 años protegiendo hogares ,negocios y, sobre todo, a las personas . Con 35 años de experiencia y presentes en18 países, somos la compañía de alarmas líder a nivel mundial. Combinamos tecnología propia de vanguardia con la respuesta experta de nuestros profesionales para anticiparnos a las situaciones de peligro y proteger lo que más importa. Si quieres crecer en unacompañía referente, con un propósito claro y retos de escala global, aquí puedes hacerlo.

¿Quieres ser parte de nuestro crecimiento?

Como analista senior de Business intelligence participarás en proyectos trasversales orientados al mundo de datos dando cobertura a las distintas áreas del cliente, en un entorno de trabajo dinámico con aprendizaje y retos continuos.

Responsabilidades en tu día a día


Colaboración en proyectos clave para la compañía y de alto carácter transversal e impacto en KPIs.
Colaborar con el cliente interno para facilitarle la toma de decisiones, ayudando a identificar el problema de negocio, los sistemas y procesos implicados y desarrollar la solución de BI más adecuada.
Realizar múltiples análisis exploratorios y explicativos con diferentes conjuntos de datos, se requiere pensamiento crítico y creativo “out of the box”.
Preparación y depuración de datos para análisis y segmentaciones de clientes.
Creación de Dashboards, desarrollos en BD, análisis adhoc.
Comunicación y coordinación constante con las diferentes áreas de Verisure para entender correctamente los datos.


Requisitos Para La Posición


Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años en proyectos de BI en funciones similares.
Titulación universitaria superior: Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
Dominio leguaje SQL y experiencia trabajando en BBDD tales como Oracle, SQL Server, Sybase, Snowflake ).
Experiencia demostrable con Power BI o herramienta de visualización de datos similar
Persona proactiva, analítica y con buena capacidad de comunicación.
Clara Orientación al Cliente.


Valorables


Conocimiento de metodologías Agile
Experiencia previa en Python
Experiencia previa con AWS
Experiencia previa con otras herramientas de Visualización y Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, o de reporting como Business Objects


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

💻Modelo híbrido de teletrabajo (16 días de teletrabajo al trimestre) para que los adaptes a tus necesidades.

⌚Horario flexible de entrada/salida y jornada intensiva los viernes.

🏖️22 días de vacaciones al año + 1 de asuntos propios + bolsa de horas de exceso

🎂La tarde de tu cumpleaños ¡Libre!

🏃‍♂️‍➡️Plan de carrera personalizado anual

🥖Comedor subvencionado, contamos con 3 restaurantes dentro de nuestra oficina por lo que ¡Olvídate de Tuppers!

⏰Descuentos en productos propios

💳Retribución flexible

🤱Apoyo a la maternidad y paternidad, políticas de igualdad y diversidad

🧗‍♂️ ¡Tú eres protagonista de tu desarrollo! Tendrás la oportunidad de desarrollar un catálogo formativo adhoc adaptado a tu perfil profesional.

Si has llegado hasta aquí es porque realmente te hemos parecido interesantes 😀. Cómo próximos pasos, apúntate en nuestra oferta y el equipo de gestión de personas revisará tu perfil. Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Fundada hace 16 años por Stanford Alumni, Bravo se ha convertido en un actor destacado en el panorama financiero, ofreciendo soluciones crediticias a consumidores sobreapalancados que se encuentran en dificultades. Tenemos operaciones en seis países diversos: México, Colombia, España, Italia, Portugal y Brasil. Nuestro viaje se define por un compromiso incesante de capacitar a las personas para que paguen sus deudas y recuperen la libertad financiera.




Nuestro compromiso con la excelencia y el trabajo duro nos ha llevado a un historial de crecimiento sostenido de dos dígitos durante la última década, posicionándonos como líderes en la industria. A partir de 2023, gestionamos más de 600 millones de euros de deuda de clientes, brindando a las personas la orientación que necesitan para pagar sus deudas de manera efectiva. Seguimos estableciendo objetivos ambiciosos para el futuro mientras buscamos crecer más de 3 veces en los próximos cinco años ampliando nuestros mercados actuales y expandiéndonos a otras geografías.




¿A quién buscamos?




Queremos gente apasionada por los datos, los nuevos retos y que disfrute resolviendo problemas complejos de negocio. Buscamos personas curiosas, organizadas, atentas al detalle, proactivas y con alta tolerancia a la frustración, capaces de hablar tanto con el equipo técnico como con la dirección.

Formación: Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería (Industrial, Informática, Telecomunicaciones), Economía o carreras afines con fuerte base cuantitativa.
Herramientas clave: Dominio de SQL y fundamentos de programación en Python o R. Soltura en herramientas de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similares) y un uso avanzado de Excel.
Mindset: Interés genuino en aprender sobre modelado estadístico, Machine Learning y automatización de flujos de trabajo.




La experiencia previa es valorable, pero no indispensable. ¡Lo que más nos importa es tu curiosidad analítica y que nos muestres lo que sabes hacer (proyectos propios, GitHub, competiciones de Kaggle o tu TFG)!




¿Qué harás?




Extracción y limpieza de datos (ETL): Recopilarás, estructurarás y validarás la calidad de la información comercial proveniente de distintas fuentes para prepararla para su análisis.
Análisis Exploratorio: Buscarás patrones, correlaciones y tendencias ocultas en los datos para responder a preguntas estratégicas del negocio (ej. ¿por qué un producto funciona mejor en una zona que en otra?).
Data Storytelling: Traducirás modelos y análisis complejos en conclusiones visuales, claras y accionables para la Gerencia y Dirección.
Ecosistema de BI: Diseñarás, automatizarás y mantendrás vivos los dashboards de control del área, garantizando que el dato sea único y fiable.
Innovación analítica: Propondrás mejoras en los procesos de reporting y lanzarás pequeñas pruebas de concepto de analítica avanzada (ej. modelos de segmentación de clientes o predicción de ventas).




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Nuestro horario es de L-V de 10.00 a 19.00 y estamos ubicados en una de las mejores zonas de Madrid (Calle Velázquez) para que disfrutes también de todo lo que ofrece el barrio (tiendas, cafeterías, restaurantes, bares...).




Tendrás un contrato indefinido a tiempo completo y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro del equipo.




Al incorporarte a nuestra empresa optarás a grandes beneficios como acceso a Wellhub, disponer inmediatamente del salario generado a través de Payflow y descuentos con otras de nuestras empresas partners en alimentación, formación, descuentos en compras, etc.




Adicionalmente podrás disfrutar del día a día de nuestro ambiente joven, multicultural y dinámico en el que aprender y crecer en tu camino profesional. También contarás con una formación especializada para enseñarte todo lo que necesitas para el puesto de trabajo, y además nos encantará que te apuntes a todas nuestras actividades como los famosos afterwork, equipo de fútbol, celebración de fiestas y eventos en la ofi o incluso las que tú quieras implementar!




¡En Bravo estamos emocionados de recibir tu candidatura y descubrir cómo puedes contribuir a nuestro crecimiento!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Analyst to join our Claims Team.

This team is present for our customers when they need us most.

As a Data Analyst for our Claims Team, you will be more than just a "report generator." You will be a strategic partner, acting as the bridge between raw data and operational excellence. Your mission is to take full ownership of our claims insights to optimize the most critical moment for our customers.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


You will become a "go-to" person for the Claims team. You won't just provide data; you will interpret it, providing actionable insights and recommending specific business moves to improve efficiency.
We are looking for someone to take the lead on ETL processes. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines to ensure our claims datasets are robust, scalable, and accurate.
You will design high-impact Tableau dashboards that are both visually impeccable and highly functional. Your goal is to tell a clear story that allows stakeholders to make informed decisions at a glance.
You will collaborate closely with Pricing, Product, and Engineering to ensure a 360-degree view of the business, aligning claims performance with our overall growth strategy.
You will identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, freeing up the team to focus on high-value decision-making.


What We’re Looking For


Strong experience in data manipulation and extraction using SQL (MySQL, Redshift, or PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with building and maintaining ETL pipelines. You know how to transform raw data into structured, clean datasets.
2-3 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a fast-paced environment (Consulting, Fintech, or Insurtech).
Proven track record of creating advanced models and dashboards in Tableau or similar BI tools.
Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Business Administration).
Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.


Nice-to-have


Ownership & Initiative: You don't wait for instructions; you identify gaps and propose solutions.
Communication & Influence: You can translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability: You thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment and can pivot your focus as business needs evolve.


€32,000 - €35,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: we offer a performance-based bonus up to 5.000€ for this role.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Customer Success Operations)
Description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Customer Success organisation serves hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals across 13 markets. Two global business lines sit at the centre of that effort, Individual Doctors and Clinics, each led by a VP who needs sharp, reliable analytics to grow their business and make decisions with confidence.

This role sits within Global Customer Success Operations & Analytics, the team that acts as the connective layer between the business and Docplanner's data organisation: BI (dashboard and data standardisation), Data Platform (infrastructure, architecture, DWH), and Product Analytics (product launches and opportunities).

This role is dedicated to one business line, partnering closely with that VP and their leadership team on the deep dives, data models, dashboards, and experiments needed to run and grow the business across our 13 markets.

You'll report to the Global CS Ops analytics manager, who sets the team's priorities and supports big projects the team takes on. Within that frame, you own how your own time is spent day to day, prioritizing incoming asks, sequencing your backlog, and deciding what needs your manager's input versus what you can resolve directly with your business and data stakeholders.

How will you make an impact?

Reporting, dashboards & data models


Build and maintain the recurring reporting, dashboards (Tableau, superset), and data models your business line runs on
Build and maintain automations that scale across markets
Keep outputs consistent with BI's dashboard and data standards, escalating gaps rather than working around them


Analytical models: statistics & prediction (a growing focus)


Today, most of your time goes to reporting and execution. Over the next year, we expect a meaningful shift toward analytical modelling (statistics and prediction)
Review, update, and improve the statistical and predictive models your business line already relies on
Build MVPs for new predictive or statistical use cases, handing them off to Data Science once validated
Bring regression, forecasting, and other statistical techniques into your day-to-day analysis, not just descriptive reporting


AI-first execution


Work AI-first: use AI to query, code, and analyse faster and more consistently
Use and contribute to the team's shared libraries, reusable code, and architecture (e.g. GitHub-based repositories)


Bridging business and data teams


Act as the translation layer between your business line and Docplanner's data organisation: BI, Data Platform, and Product Analytics
Bring the right requirements to each team, and flag when scope or timelines don't match business priority


Driving analytics for your business line


Partner directly with the VP of your assigned business line and their team to understand the business, identify gaps, and surface opportunities
Lead deep dives that go beyond describing what happened to explain why, and what do next
Propose, run, and analyse experiments (A/B tests and beyond) that inform business decisions


Prioritisation & stakeholder alignment


Own the day-to-day sequencing of your own workload: triage incoming requests, judge urgency and impact, and decide what to tackle first without waiting to be told
Align directly with assigned business and data stakeholders on what matters and when
Escalate cross-team or resourcing trade-offs to your manager, who owns prioritisation of the team's big projects


Qualifications

What will help you thrive?


Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar)
+3-5 years of relevant analytics experience as an individual contributor
Very good SQL skills (Amazon Redshift preferred); solid Python, especially for statistical and predictive modelling
Working knowledge of statistical modelling (regression analysis, forecasting/prediction, A/B testing)
Hands-on experience with Superset and/or Tableau, building dashboards for non-technical audiences
Skilled at digesting complex data into business language: able to summarise findings and frame them as a clear narrative, not just a report
Experience working cross-functionally, partnering with non-technical stakeholders across departments
Professional fluency in English (Spanish is a plus)


What makes you a strong fit?


Proactive by default: you spot what needs doing and raise the level of execution around you, rather than waiting for instructions
Owner with entrepreneurial mindset: own your work, your results, and everything in between
Able to prioritise your own workload with sound criteria, and know when to align with stakeholders versus escalate to your manager
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driven by results
Understands the capabilities and limits of AI/LLMs and has experience building things with them (professionally or on your own)
Track record of scoping problems, running high-quality quantitative analysis, and developing insights that drive decisions
Communicates complex concepts simply and clearly; builds trust across a wide range of stakeholders


Extra advantage


Experience building or validating statistical/predictive models and handing them off to a Data Science team
Experience in tech companies, start-ups, and/or consultancy. No prior experience in healthcare or SaaS required, but curiosity about both is critical!


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Ashleigh Hill to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Andreu Passola; your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind - it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Technical Interview – A short SQL assessment and discussion with our Head of BI.

4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and stakeholder panel to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader/stakeholder/peer from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers, transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths - whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Customer Success organisation serves hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals across 13 markets. Two global business lines sit at the centre of that effort, Individual Doctors and Clinics, each led by a VP who needs sharp, reliable analytics to grow their business and make decisions with confidence.

This role sits within Global Customer Success Operations & Analytics, the team that acts as the connective layer between the business and Docplanner's data organisation: BI (dashboard and data standardisation), Data Platform (infrastructure, architecture, DWH), and Product Analytics (product launches and opportunities).

This role is dedicated to one business line, partnering closely with that VP and their leadership team on the deep dives, data models, dashboards, and experiments needed to run and grow the business across our 13 markets.

You'll report to the Global CS Ops analytics manager, who sets the team's priorities and supports big projects the team takes on. Within that frame, you own how your own time is spent day to day, prioritizing incoming asks, sequencing your backlog, and deciding what needs your manager's input versus what you can resolve directly with your business and data stakeholders.

How will you make an impact?

Reporting, dashboards & data models

  • Build and maintain the recurring reporting, dashboards (Tableau, superset), and data models your business line runs on
  • Build and maintain automations that scale across markets
  • Keep outputs consistent with BI's dashboard and data standards, escalating gaps rather than working around them

Analytical models: statistics & prediction (a growing focus)

  • Today, most of your time goes to reporting and execution. Over the next year, we expect a meaningful shift toward analytical modelling (statistics and prediction)
  • Review, update, and improve the statistical and predictive models your business line already relies on
  • Build MVPs for new predictive or statistical use cases, handing them off to Data Science once validated
  • Bring regression, forecasting, and other statistical techniques into your day-to-day analysis, not just descriptive reporting

AI-first execution

  • Work AI-first: use AI to query, code, and analyse faster and more consistently
  • Use and contribute to the team's shared libraries, reusable code, and architecture (e.g. GitHub-based repositories)

Bridging business and data teams

  • Act as the translation layer between your business line and Docplanner's data organisation: BI, Data Platform, and Product Analytics
  • Bring the right requirements to each team, and flag when scope or timelines don't match business priority

Driving analytics for your business line

  • Partner directly with the VP of your assigned business line and their team to understand the business, identify gaps, and surface opportunities
  • Lead deep dives that go beyond describing what happened to explain why, and what do next
  • Propose, run, and analyse experiments (A/B tests and beyond) that inform business decisions

Prioritisation & stakeholder alignment

  • Own the day-to-day sequencing of your own workload: triage incoming requests, judge urgency and impact, and decide what to tackle first without waiting to be told
  • Align directly with assigned business and data stakeholders on what matters and when
  • Escalate cross-team or resourcing trade-offs to your manager, who owns prioritisation of the team's big projects

Qualifications

What will help you thrive?

  • Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar)
  • +3-5 years of relevant analytics experience as an individual contributor
  • Very good SQL skills (Amazon Redshift preferred); solid Python, especially for statistical and predictive modelling
  • Working knowledge of statistical modelling (regression analysis, forecasting/prediction, A/B testing)
  • Hands-on experience with Superset and/or Tableau, building dashboards for non-technical audiences
  • Skilled at digesting complex data into business language: able to summarise findings and frame them as a clear narrative, not just a report
  • Experience working cross-functionally, partnering with non-technical stakeholders across departments
  • Professional fluency in English (Spanish is a plus)

What makes you a strong fit?

  • Proactive by default: you spot what needs doing and raise the level of execution around you, rather than waiting for instructions
  • Owner with entrepreneurial mindset: own your work, your results, and everything in between
  • Able to prioritise your own workload with sound criteria, and know when to align with stakeholders versus escalate to your manager
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driven by results
  • Understands the capabilities and limits of AI/LLMs and has experience building things with them (professionally or on your own)
  • Track record of scoping problems, running high-quality quantitative analysis, and developing insights that drive decisions
  • Communicates complex concepts simply and clearly; builds trust across a wide range of stakeholders

Extra advantage

  • Experience building or validating statistical/predictive models and handing them off to a Data Science team
  • Experience in tech companies, start-ups, and/or consultancy. No prior experience in healthcare or SaaS required, but curiosity about both is critical!

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Ashleigh Hill to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Andreu Passola; your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind - it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Technical Interview – A short SQL assessment and discussion with our Head of BI.

4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and stakeholder panel to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader/stakeholder/peer from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:

  • Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
  • Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
  • Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.

📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers, transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths - whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

UST es una multinacional líder en servicios de tecnología digital, certificada como Top Employer, con más de 35.000 profesionales en todo el mundo y presencia en más de 30 países. Ayudamos a grandes compañías a través de soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras y proyectos de transformación digital.

Buscamos un/a PL/SQL Data Analyst con experiencia avanzada en Power BI para incorporarse a un squad Agile y participar de forma integral en el ciclo de vida de las user stories, desde el análisis de requisitos hasta la validación final con negocio.

📍 Ubicación: 100% remoto (España)

🗣️ Idioma: Inglés nivel B1 o superior




🔧 Responsabilidades principales

Analizar requisitos funcionales y transformarlos en soluciones analíticas eficientes.

Realizar validaciones y análisis de datos para asegurar la calidad de la información.
Desarrollar y mantener consultas y procedimientos en PL/SQL.
Participar en actividades de testing y soporte durante las fases de validación con usuarios de negocio.
Colaborar activamente dentro de un entorno Agile participando en ceremonias y actividades del squad.
Garantizar la consistencia, trazabilidad y fiabilidad de los datos reportados.
Proponer mejoras y automatizaciones sobre los procesos de reporting existentes.

Mínimo de 5-6 años de experiencia desarrollando dashboards, reporting y visualizaciones en Power BI.
Entre 3 - 4 años de experiencia en PL/SQL.
Experiencia sólida en modelado de datos.
Experiencia en validación, análisis y control de calidad de datos.
Experiencia trabajando con metodologías Agile.
Capacidad analítica, orientación al detalle y compromiso con la calidad de los datos.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y experiencia colaborando con usuarios de negocio.
Nivel de inglés B1 o superior.




⭐ Valoraremos especialmente

Conocimientos de Scala a nivel intermedio (3-4 años)
Experiencia en la definición y seguimiento de KPIs y métricas de negocio.
Experiencia en optimización y automatización de procesos de reporting.
Participación en procesos UAT, User Acceptance Testing.
Experiencia acompañando y dando soporte a usuarios de negocio durante las fases de validación y despliegue.

✈️ 23 días de vacaciones + 24 y 31 de diciembre.

❤️ Beneficios sociales (seguro médico, seguro de vida y accidentes, compensación de teletrabajo).

🍴 Programa de retribución flexible (restaurante, guardería, transporte, formación de idiomas y seguro de salud).

🎓 Acceso gratuito a múltiples plataformas de formación.

🚀 Estabilidad profesional y plan de carrera.

🤝 Programa de referidos con incentivos.

💳 Posibilidad de elegir entre 12 o 14 pagas.

🏠 Medidas reales de conciliación y flexibilidad laboral.

🎁 Descuentos exclusivos a través de UST Club y acuerdos con gimnasios.




📩 Si te apasionan los datos, Power BI y la generación de insights de negocio, queremos conocerte. ¡Inscríbete y forma parte de UST!

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - User Acquisition (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our User Acquisition team. You'll own the measurement of how we acquire users across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties — from attribution and channel performance to cohort LTV and payback — and turn that into clear recommendations on where to spend the next dollar.

The ideal candidate has exceptional analytical skills, strong SQL and Python skills, deep familiarity with mobile app marketing data, and can bring rigor to data quality, analysis and storytelling.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own UA performance measurement across paid channels (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Unity), including CPI/CAC, ROAS, retention, and payback by channel, campaign, geo, and creative
Build and maintain predictive LTV models and cohort curves that let the UA team make bid and budget decisions on early signals
Reconcile and validate data across MMPs, ad networks, and internal event data, and investigate discrepancies in attribution, installs, and revenue
Analyze web-to-app and web funnel performance, from landing page to install to first reward or engagement, and identify where users drop off
Design and read incrementality tests, geo-holdouts, and creative or landing-page A/B tests to measure true lift beyond last-touch attribution
Monitor traffic quality and flag anomalies, including fraud, low-quality sources, and post-install behavior that doesn't match expectations
Partner with the UA team on budget allocation and channel mix scenarios, and translate findings into clear spend recommendations


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
4+ years in analytics, with at least 2 years supporting user acquisition or performance marketing for mobile apps
Hands-on experience with at least one MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, or Branch) and an understanding of attribution windows, re-engagement, and postbacks
Experience building dashboards, LTV/payback models and cohort analyses
Familiarity with growth marketing concepts such as: A/B Testing, Causal analysis, Incrementality, Inferential statistics, MMM etc, iOS SKAN & incoming privacy changes
Nice to have: experience with Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments


Alignment with Our Core Values:


Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.


You'll Thrive Here If You Are


Analytical
Pragmatic
Curious
Communicative
Action-Driven
Collaborative


Why Join Mode Mobile


High ownership and autonomy across business units
Direct influence on a sizable UA budget allocation across a portfolio of apps.
Strong partners across engineering, product, growth, and content
Opportunities to shape Mode's analytics function and data culture
A fast-moving, supportive, global remote environment


We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms


Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule


What We Are Offering


We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).

We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Treasury
Description:

Senior Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Design, build, and maintain robust AI agentic workflows and analytical tools to automate and enhance Treasury data processes and decision-making
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


6+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience working with AI and building agentic workflows
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - Monetization (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our Monetization team. You'll own how we measure and grow revenue across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties, spanning subscriptions, in-app purchases, advertising, and partner offers, and turn that into clear recommendations on pricing, packaging, and revenue mix. The ideal candidate has exceptional SQL and Python skills, hands-on experience with consumer subscription apps, and the rigor to design pricing experiments that hold up.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own revenue and monetization metrics across the portfolio, including ARPU/ARPDAU, LTV, trial-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn rates, refunds, and revenue mix by source
Design and analyze pricing, packaging, and paywall experiments (price points, trial length, plan structure, paywall placement and copy), and read results with statistical rigor
Build subscription cohort and LTV models that inform pricing decisions and feed back into UA bidding and payback targets
Analyze ad monetization performance, including eCPM, fill rate, impressions per user, and mediation/bidding setup, and balance ad revenue against retention and user experience
Measure the economics of partner offers and rewards, including revenue earned vs. rewards paid out, to keep the rewards model profitable
Reconcile revenue data across app stores, subscription platforms, ad networks, and internal systems, and investigate discrepancies
Partner with Monetization, Product, and GMs on revenue forecasting, opportunity sizing, and roadmap prioritization
Communicate analytical findings through clear, compelling narratives to drive alignment, inform prioritization, and deliver measurable business impact


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
4+ years in analytics, preferred background in monetization, pricing, or revenue analytics for consumer subscription apps & games
Experience with LTV modeling and revenue forecasting on subscription and ad monetized apps/games
Track record of designing and interpreting pricing or paywall A/B tests, including pitfalls like novelty effects, long conversion windows, and LTV vs. short-term conversion tradeoffs
Familiarity with app store subscription mechanics (App Store/Google Play billing, trials, grace periods, renewals, refunds) and subscription platforms (e.g., RevenueCat, Superwall, Adapty)
Nice to have: experience with ad mediation experience (AppLovin MAX, ironSource/Unity LevelPlay, AdMob), web checkout or web-to-app payments, rewards or loyalty program economics, Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), dashboarding tools (Looker, Tableau), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments


Alignment with Our Core Values:


Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
Action-driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.


You'll Thrive Here If You Are


Analytical
Pragmatic
Curious
Communicative
Action-Driven
Collaborative


Why Join Mode Mobile


High ownership and autonomy across business units
Direct impact on product, revenue, and user experiences
Strong partners across engineering, product, growth, and content
Opportunities to shape Mode's analytics function and data culture
A fast-moving, supportive, global remote environment


We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms


Allow OKRs to Guide Us
Assume Positive Intent
Agree to Disagree & Commit
Set New Precedents
Accomplish More with Less
Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
Speak Up
Be Resourceful
Follow the 80/20 Rule


What We Are Offering


We are a 100% remote-first, global company.
A competitive compensation package.
We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full-time team members).
We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
Work with energetic, passionate, and results-driven people.
Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
Bonusly - We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full-time team members).

Title: Analista de Datos Junior
Description:
Mediaset España es el grupo audiovisual líder en España y uno de los más rentables de Europa, siendo uno de los principales creadores de contenidos a nivel nacional. Somos entretenimiento, información, publicidad, tecnología, big data, marketing… y mucho más.




Actualmente, buscamos incorporar un/a Analista de Datos Junior para formar parte de nuestro equipo de Marketing y contribuir al análisis y tratamiento de datos para apoyar la toma de decisiones de la organización.




Principales responsabilidades




Recopilar, procesar y validar datos procedentes de diferentes fuentes internas y externas.
Diseñar y mantener dashboards e informes automatizados para realizar el seguimiento de métricas clave.
Analizar tendencias, patrones y correlaciones para apoyar la toma de decisiones.
Elaborar informes y presentaciones claras que faciliten la comprensión de los datos y estén orientadas a las necesidades del negocio.
Colaborar con equipos de otras áreas de la compañía para garantizar la calidad y accesibilidad de la información.
Identificar oportunidades para mejorar los procesos de recopilación y análisis de datos.
Garantizar la integridad, confidencialidad y seguridad de los datos utilizados.




🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?




Una persona con capacidad para analizar, interpretar y transformar datos en información clara y útil para el negocio, que sepa trabajar en equipo y adaptarse a un entorno dinámico.




Formación Académica




Grado en Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Marketing Digital o disciplinas afines.
Se valorará formación de posgrado o certificaciones en analítica o análisis de datos.




Experiencia y conocimientos




Experiencia profesional de hasta 2 años en análisis de datos o posiciones similares.
Nivel avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets.
Manejo de herramientas de visualización de datos como Power BI, Tableau, Looker o Data Studio.
Conocimientos de análisis de datos, métricas de negocio y bases de datos.
Se valorará experiencia con BigQuery, AWS, Azure o Snowflake.
Se valorará conocimiento de SQL y experiencia con Python o R.




🤝 ¿Qué ofrecemos?




Buen ambiente laboral donde te sentirás parte del equipo desde el primer día.
Otros beneficios de compañía tales como: comedor de empresa gratuito, medidas de retribución flexible, becas de estudio, entre otros.

Title: Senior Mobility Data Analyst
Description:
Somos una compañía global especializada en la distribución eficiente de vehículos, con más de 47 años de experiencia en el sector de la automoción, con origen y sede central en Madrid, España.

Nuestro enfoque de negocio, combina un profundo conocimiento de la industria, tecnología propia, digitalización e inteligencia de datos para entender las necesidades reales de movilidad y ofrecer soluciones flexibles y personalizadas a particulares, empresas y administraciones públicas.

Hoy, estamos presentes en 18 países de Europa y Latinoamérica, representando cerca de 40 marcas oficiales de vehículos a través de una red de más de 3.200 puntos de venta y servicio independientes. Pensamos de forma global y actuamos con un fuerte enfoque local, adaptando nuestro modelo a cada mercado y estableciendo, relaciones a largo plazo con fabricantes, clientes y socios financieros. En 2025, generamos una facturación de 5.500 millones de euros y vendimos 220.000 vehículos nuevos.

Move. It’s your right.

En Astara apostamos por la igualdad de oportunidades, la inclusión y la diversidad. ¡Animamos a todas las personas, incluidas aquellas con discapacidad, a unirse a nuestro equipo! Si necesitas alguna adaptación durante el proceso de selección, no dudes en contárnoslo

Astara Intelligence

En Astara Intelligence transformamos datos en decisiones de negocio para el sector de la movilidad. Somos la unidad de analítica y consultoría de Astara, compañía global de movilidad, y trabajamos con clientes públicos y privados en proyectos de movilidad inteligente, estrategia, datos e innovación.

Buscamos un/a consultor especialista en análisis de datos de movilidad para incorporarse al equipo de consultoría de movilidad en ASTARA Intelligence (Advisory). Participarás en proyectos de consultoría de movilidad, analizando datos, estructurando problemas complejos y preparando recomendaciones claras para cliente.

Main Functions/Responsibilities


Analizar datos de movilidad, demanda, territorio, usuarios, operaciones y mercado.
Apoyar proyectos de consultoría en movilidad urbana, transporte, smart cities y nuevos modelos de servicio.
Construir análisis, modelos y dashboards en Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL u otras herramientas.
Preparar informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones para cliente, en español e inglés.
Definir KPIs, escenarios, diagnósticos y recomendaciones estratégicas.
Colaborar con consultores/as, analistas, diseñadores/as y perfiles técnicos en proyectos end-to-end.
Explorar el uso de IA y automatización para acelerar research y análisis.


Professional Experience/Qualifications


+5 años de experiencia en consultoría, analítica, movilidad, transporte, smart cities, estrategia y/o data analytics.
Formación en Ingeniería, Economía, Data Science, Estadística, Matemáticas, Urbanismo, Transporte o similar.
Nivel experto de Excel y experiencia en analisis de bases de datos complejas.
Conocimiento experto de Power BI, Tableau, Looker o herramientas similares.
Inglés profesional, escrito y hablado (nivel C1-C2)
Capacidad para estructurar problemas ambiguos, extraer insights y comunicarlos con claridad
Excelente comunicación oral (presentación) y escrita (redacción de documentos)
Interés real por la movilidad, las ciudades, la tecnología y los datos
