Title: Data Analyst - BigQuery
Description:
¡En Ayesa Digital crecemos Contigo!




Cada profesional de nuestra empresa es importante para nosotros, nos ayudan a crecer de manera diversa y gracias a ellos somos más de 11.000 personas trabajando con el mismo objetivo internacionalmente.




Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!




Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo con un/a Data Analyst / BI Consultant, para participar en proyectos de analítica de datos, reporting y evolución del ecosistema analítico corporativo. La persona seleccionada trabajará en modalidad de teletrabajo híbrido en Madrid.




¡Anímate a dar el salto! ¡Te estamos esperando!




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Actuar como referente analítico y nexo entre las áreas de Negocio y Tecnología.
Gestionar la transformación, modelado y explotación de datos, garantizando la calidad y disponibilidad de la información para la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos orientados a negocio.
Definir, documentar y evolucionar KPIs, métricas e indicadores de gestión.
Desarrollar lógica de negocio mediante DAX y modelos semánticos.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes en Power BI.
Construir visualizaciones que faciliten el análisis y la toma de decisiones de las distintas áreas de negocio.
Asegurar la correcta integración y explotación de datos entre BigQuery y Power BI.
Recopilar, analizar y documentar requisitos funcionales de las áreas usuarias.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas y de reporting.
Participar en la migración de procesos y modelos actualmente desarrollados en SAS hacia tecnologías Google Cloud y Microsoft.
Colaborar en la evolución de la arquitectura analítica y en la mejora continua de herramientas, procesos y modelos de datos.
Establecer mecanismos de control y seguimiento de la calidad del dato.
Identificar incidencias, inconsistencias y riesgos asociados a la información.
Gestionar iniciativas analíticas, coordinando diferentes equipos y asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos y entregables.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia como Data Analyst, BI Consultant o en posiciones similares relacionadas con Business Intelligence y Analítica de Datos.
Dominio avanzado de SQL.
Experiencia trabajando con BigQuery.
Conocimientos sólidos de Power BI, diseño de informes y cuadros de mando.
Experiencia desarrollando modelos semánticos y cálculos mediante DAX.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos y procesos ETL/ELT.
Capacidad para analizar necesidades funcionales y transformarlas en soluciones analíticas.
Experiencia actuando como interlocutor/a entre negocio y equipos técnicos.
Orientación a la calidad del dato y a la mejora continua.
Capacidad de organización, gestión de prioridades y trabajo en entornos dinámicos.
Valorable experiencia en proyectos de migración desde SAS hacia entornos Google Cloud o Microsoft.




Te Ofrecemos Un Camino Lleno De Aventuras




¡Llega hasta donde tú quieras! ¡Crece con nuestros programas de desarrollo! Te ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.




Porque lo importante sois tú y los tuyos : contamos con políticas que facilitan la conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada intensiva en verano.

Tú decides cómo usar tu dinero: disfruta de nuestra retribución flexible, contamos con: Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.

Plan Bienestar descuentos en viajes, tecnología, formación, deporte, belleza y ¡muchos más!

Diviértete participando en los diferentes concursos y actividades que organizamos: ¿te gusta el deporte, escribir, la fotografía? Todo tiene cabida.

¡Actualízate! apostamos por un aprendizaje continuo, contamos con formación especializada, certificaciones e idiomas.

¡Deja tu huella! Impacta con nuestros proyectos de voluntariado social.




¡Únete a la multinacional española tecnológica referente en el mundo!

Title: Data Analyst - Fincrime Reporting
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

Data Analyst - FCC Reporting

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Compliance team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Regulatory FinCrime Compliance domain!

Our data mission is to enable effective risk detection, monitoring and regulatory compliance through robust data models, scalable analytics and high quality reporting.

The team works closely with Compliance, Risk and Product to design and implement data-driven controls, detection mechanisms, and investigative tools across multiple jurisdictions.

Projects range from building curated data models to cover global key risk indicators for financial crime compliance and automating into standardised board packs, to scaling our regulatory reporting engine to incorporate datasets specific to transaction monitoring, screening and client KYC.

As part of the team you will


Design and maintain data models and datasets used for transaction monitoring, customer risk scoring, and financial crime investigations.
Own end-to-end delivery of FinCrime analytics solutions: requirements gathering, data extraction, transformation, validation, and deployment.
Develop and optimise detection logic and monitoring rules (e.g. transaction monitoring scenarios, anomaly detection, behavioural patterns).
Perform data quality checks and controls to ensure completeness, accuracy, and auditability of FinCrime datasets.
Build dashboards and analytical tools (Looker / Looker Studio or similar) for monitoring risk exposure, alerts, and investigation pipelines.
Support regulatory and internal audits, providing traceability of data, methodologies, and controls.
Contribute to the automation and continuous improvement of FinCrime processes (screening, monitoring, alert handling).


What We’re Looking For


2-5 years Experience in Data/Business Analytics – preferably within FinCrime, Compliance, Risk, or Financial Services.
Advanced SQL skills – able to read and write queries across complex datasets.
Experience with our modern data stack tools is a plus: dbt, Google Cloud BigQuery, Looker / Looker Studio, Git.
Experience building data pipelines, transformations, and analytical datasets.
Solid understanding of financial crime frameworks.
Experience working with Python is desirable.
Knowledge of payment flows, FX, or banking products is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking with focus on data quality, controls, and risk interpretation.
Experience working with transaction monitoring systems or alerting frameworks is a plus.
Ability to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into data logic.
Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)


What Ebury Offers You


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment (hybrid model, 4 days office / 1 day remote)
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off and all the Málaga public holidays.
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

Title: Data Analyst III (Remote)
Description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Data Analyst to join the Office of Adversary Strategy. As a Data Analyst in this organization, you have the privilege of working with various types of cybersecurity data to support our larger mission of stopping breaches from a purposefully adversarial mindset.

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our team and support the ability to make data-informed decisions across our portfolio. In this role, you will analyze large-scale security telemetry, threat intelligence feeds, and detection data to uncover patterns, improve operations, and support strategic initiatives. You'll work cross-functionally with various product and engineering teams to transform raw security data into actionable insights.

If you are a hands-on data nerd who loves to run queries all day and wants to operate at scale, apply & let's talk!

What You'll Do:


Analyze large volumes of security event data, endpoint telemetry, and threat intelligence feeds to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging threats
Design and maintain dashboards and reports that track key security metrics
Translate complex security data findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting workflows using SQL, Python, Logscale, or similar tools
Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility
Contribute to the development of KPIs and metrics frameworks for measuring security product performance and adoption
Stay current on cybersecurity trends, adversary behaviors, and industry best practices to inform analysis


What You'll Need:


Curiosity and a deep desire for continuous learning
Education: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Experience: 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably within cybersecurity, IT, or related technical domains
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in querying large, complex, datasets, in particular graph databases
Experience with tools like Python or R for data analysis and automation
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
Experience working with large-scale, high-velocity datasets (logs, streaming telemetry, SIEM data)
Bonus: Understanding of security concepts (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK framework, security operations experience)
Analytical Skills:
Strong statistical analysis and quantitative reasoning skills
Ability to translate ambiguous business/security questions into structured analyses
Communication Skills:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Benefits Of Working At CrowdStrike:


Market leader in compensation and equity awards
Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
Paid parental and adoption leaves
Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Link’s vision is to become the global leader for deep data in life sciences. We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Data Analyst to join our product team.

In this role, you will play a key part in developing and implementing a data governance framework, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and integrity. Your main responsibilities include establishing data quality monitoring processes, identifying root causes of inconsistencies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps.

To thrive in this role, you need expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation and automation. You should be comfortable working with large datasets, designing dashboards with actionable recommendations, and applying statistical techniques to assess and enhance data quality.

The ideal candidate has experience in creating documentation (process documentation, data collection guidelines) and in contributing to data governance policies and best practices.

What You'll Do


Implement a data governance framework
Establish and maintain robust processes for tracking and assessing data quality
Develop automated checks to proactively detect data inconsistencies
Apply statistical techniques to enhance data quality
Create customized reports and dashboards
Extract data from databases (e.g., Redshift, MongoDB)
Identify and resolve root causes of quality issues
Collaborate in cross-functional teams of product managers, engineering, and operations
Create and maintain documentation


Requirements


5+ years of work experience in data analysis or data quality role
Strong technical skills in data analysis, with proficiency in SQL and Python
Experience in data storage and processing on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams
Experience writing process documentation and data collection guidelines


Nice to Have


University degree in medicine or life sciences
Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines)
Experience with workflow automation tools such as Apache Airflow
Experience working in an Agile or product-driven environment
Familiarity with data privacy and compliance regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


1% charitable giving program
Life insurance
Pension contribution
Fitness reimbursement


Compensation


Total compensation: 50,000 - 70,000 EUR

Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva Link’s vision is to become the global leader for deep data in life sciences. We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Data Analyst to join our product team.

In this role, you will play a key part in developing and implementing a data governance framework, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and integrity. Your main responsibilities include establishing data quality monitoring processes, identifying root causes of inconsistencies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps.

To thrive in this role, you need expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation and automation. You should be comfortable working with large datasets, designing dashboards with actionable recommendations, and applying statistical techniques to assess and enhance data quality.

The ideal candidate has experience in creating documentation (process documentation, data collection guidelines) and in contributing to data governance policies and best practices.

What You'll Do

  • Implement a data governance framework
  • Establish and maintain robust processes for tracking and assessing data quality
  • Develop automated checks to proactively detect data inconsistencies
  • Apply statistical techniques to enhance data quality
  • Create customized reports and dashboards
  • Extract data from databases (e.g., Redshift, MongoDB)
  • Identify and resolve root causes of quality issues
  • Collaborate in cross-functional teams of product managers, engineering, and operations
  • Create and maintain documentation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of work experience in data analysis or data quality role
  • Strong technical skills in data analysis, with proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Experience in data storage and processing on cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Strong problem-solving skills and experience working with cross-functional teams

Nice to Have

  • University degree in medicine or life sciences
  • Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
  • Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
  • Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines)

  • Experience working in an Agile or product-driven environment

Title: Analista de Datos Junior
Description:
¿Te gustaría unirte a un proyecto tecnológico puntero con un impacto positivo?




Desde Newtral nace Trueflag, una spin-off con el propósito de utilizar la IA como herramienta para combatir la desinformación y las fake news.




Estamos buscando a una persona que se incorpore como Data Analyst que combine la habilidad de manejar grandes volúmenes de datos con una fuerte orientación al negocio y al cliente.




¿Cuáles serían tus principales responsabilidades?

Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos provenientes de diversas fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones e información relevante para los diferentes stakeholders.
Diseñar y construir informes y dashboards efectivos que comuniquen resultados de forma clara a los clientes y al equipo interno.
Buscar en los datos las historias que importan a cada cliente y convertirlas en entregables listos para enviar.
Identificar oportunidades de automatización en análisis de datos, informes y generación de alertas en tiempo real.
Garantizar la integridad y precisión de los datos mediante procesos de validación y limpieza.




¿Qué buscamos?

Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas o similar.
Experiencia previa de +2 años en consultoría de BI o analista de datos. Importante haber trabajado con grandes volúmenes de datos.
Experiencia en análisis de datos, elaboración de informes y cuadros de mando.
Conocimientos en bases de datos SQL (OLTP y OLAP)
Experiencia básica con Python para análisis y manipulación de grandes volúmenes de datos
Experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, Looker u otras similares.
Familiaridad con procesos ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
Español nativo e inglés alto.




Bonus:

Se valorará experiencia trabajando con dbt.
Se valorará haber trabajado con equipos de Data Science.
Se valorará experiencia trabajando con bases de datos NoSQL.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Trabajo 100% remoto desde cualquier parte de España.
Posibilidad de un espacio de coworking en Madrid o Vigo.
La posibilidad de trabajar en un equipo técnico de primer nivel.
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida
23 días de vacaciones además del 24 y 31 de Diciembre.
Plan de retribución flexible.
Dos offsites de empresa al año.
Condiciones competitivas: fijo anual bruto de 35-42k € + Variable.

Title: AI & Analytics Analyst
Description:
We are looking for an AI & Analytics Analyst who can turn business questions into analyses, models, and evidence-based decisions.




What You’ll Do

Descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analyses for business use cases.
Development of notebooks, SQL queries, transformations, visualizations, and reusable analytical components in Palantir Foundry.
Support the building, evaluation, and monitoring of AI models, maintaining metrics, assumptions, and technical evidence.
Design dashboards and executive narratives with conclusions, recommendations, and next steps.
Collaborate with business squads, data engineering, data governance, and technology providers.




What We’re Looking For

1–2 years of experience in data analysis, data science, BI, or analytical automation.
Python and advanced SQL; Power BI, Tableau, or another BI tool.
Statistics, supervised/unsupervised machine learning, and model evaluation.
Proficiency with notebooks, repositories, version control, and technical documentation.
Experience with Palantir Foundry (Pipeline Builder, Code Repositories, Ontology, Contour, Workshop), Databricks, or Azure—or a clear willingness to learn quickly.
Best practices in data quality, privacy, security, and AI governance.
Degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Quantitative Economics. High level of English proficiency preferred.




Soft skills: analytical mindset, curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning, clear communication with technical and business audiences, cross-functional collaboration, and responsible handling of sensitive data.

Title: Data & IA Analyst
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Sobre Nosotros

Scuffers es una marca de ropa inspirada en la estética urbana mediterránea, con un estilo y carácter distintivo impulsado por los valores de autenticidad y autoexpresión.

Nuestra filosofía se centra en el desarrollo de producto, investigamos y exploramos cuidadosamente materiales y fits únicos, para ser capaces de ofrecer ropa que no solo se ve bien, sino que también te haga sentir bien.

Ya llevamos seis años construyendo nuestro lifestyle. Comenzamos creando ropa con la que nos gustaría vestirnos a nosotros y fuimos creciendo gracias a una comunidad de personas que buscaban lo mismo.

Si te apasionan los retos y quieres formar parte de nuestro equipo dinámico y joven, buscamos nuevos perfiles para unirse a nuestro equipo.

El Rol

Buscamos un/a Data & IA Analyst que se incorpore a nuestro equipo para ayudarnos a ordenar, estructurar y analizar los datos de Scuffers, convirtiéndolos en información útil para la toma de decisiones de negocio.

Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre análisis de datos y tecnología: alguien que no solo sepa analizar información, sino que sea capaz de utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para construir sus propias soluciones, automatizaciones y dashboards.

Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con el IA Builder, participando en la construcción y evolución de herramientas internas que nos permitan trabajar con nuestros datos de forma más ágil, fiable y autónoma.

Es un rol muy dinámico, ideal para alguien analítico, curioso, resolutivo y con ganas de construir cosas.

Funciones y Responsabilidades

Data & Analytics (core del rol):


Estructuración y modelado de los datos de la empresa:
Definir cómo se organizan y relacionan las diferentes fuentes de información.
Trabajar con datos de ventas, inventario, pedidos, colaboradores, marketing, etc.
Asegurar que los datos sean consistentes, fiables y fáciles de consultar.
Análisis de datos para extraer conclusiones útiles para el negocio:
Identificar tendencias, oportunidades y posibles problemas.
Analizar qué funciona, qué no y por qué.
Convertir datos en conclusiones claras y accionables.
Creación y mantenimiento de dashboards y herramientas de reporting que permitan al equipo consultar la información de forma autónoma.
Integración y conexión de diferentes fuentes de datos para crear una visión global del negocio.

IA & Product Building


Utilización de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para construir soluciones de análisis, reporting y automatización.
Trabajar con asistentes de IA para programar y desarrollar herramientas, siendo capaz de:
Dar contexto y definir correctamente los problemas.
Revisar y validar el código generado.
Detectar errores y corregirlos.
Iterar hasta conseguir soluciones fiables.
Colaboración con el responsable de IA en el desarrollo y evolución de las plataformas internas de Scuffers.
Integración de herramientas de reporting dentro de las plataformas existentes cuando sea necesario.
Automatización de procesos repetitivos relacionados con la gestión y preparación de datos.

Requisitos


Experiencia trabajando con SQL y bases de datos.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos y capacidad para estructurar y relacionar diferentes fuentes de información.
Experiencia sólida utilizando Python para limpiar, transformar, cruzar y automatizar datos.
Experiencia real utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para programar y construir herramientas, más allá de utilizar IA únicamente para consultas o generación de contenido.
Capacidad para construir dashboards, aplicaciones o herramientas de reporting.
Conocimientos de PostgreSQL será un plus.
Capacidad para leer y realizar modificaciones sencillas en Next.js.
Mentalidad analítica y capacidad para convertir datos en conclusiones de negocio.
Mentalidad proactiva y resolutiva.
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y avanzar de manera ordenada.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar información técnica y conclusiones de forma sencilla.


Será Un Plus


Experiencia trabajando con datos de e-commerce.
Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence y visualización de datos.
Conocimientos de estadística aplicada.
Experiencia analizando tendencias, comportamiento de clientes o realizando previsiones.
Experiencia trabajando con APIs y conectando diferentes fuentes de datos.


¿Qué ofrecemos?

🫰🏻Una filosofía de trabajo marcada por el crecimiento de grupo y marca de forma paralela. Cada semana supone un nuevo reto, para ti y para el resto.

🎢 Crecimiento profesional: Tenemos un camino muy largo por delante, con muchos retos que cumplir y tú serás una parte fundamental, por lo que iremos creciendo juntos.

🔝Impacto: Nos movemos rápido y eso hará que cada paso cuente y se note.

🫂Dream team: Somos un equipo joven con buena comunicación y muchas ganas de aprender unos de otros.

👖Presupuesto mensual para renovar tu armario: Queremos que seas un auténtico embajador de Scuffers.

🍑 Fruta fresca, café y snacks en nuestra oficina en Pozuelo de Alarcón.

Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Role purpose

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.
Explore and propose new use cases of AI applied to data analysis, maintaining a pragmatic innovation mindset.




Profile we are looking for

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.
Fluent in English and Spanish (C1+), with experience working in international and cross-functional environments




Nice to have

Experience using AI to automate analysis, generate insights, or improve analytical efficiency.
Knowledge of cloud environments, large-scale data management, or analytical pipelines.
Previous experience in product, operations, or business environments.
Ability to prioritize and focus analysis on what truly drives impact.




What We Offer

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.
Direct participation in decision-making forums and strategic projects.
A highly skilled team with a collaborative mindset.
Opportunity to grow at the intersection of data, AI, and business.







Strong fit with our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fueled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.

Title: Regional Data Analyst
Description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About The Role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.

We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.

In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making.

What You Will Do


Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.
Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.
Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.
Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.
Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.
Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.
Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.
Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.
Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.
Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.
Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.
Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.
Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.
Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.


Required

What you need to succeed:


3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.
Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.
Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.
Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.
Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Excellent written and spoken English.


Preferred


Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.
Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Spanish language skills.
Portuguese language skills.
Experience identifying and implementing technology-driven process improvements and automations.
Project management experience or a strong project management mindset.
Experience working across multiple countries, cultures, and business environments.


What we offer you


A permanent contract.
A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
Meal vouchers.
Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.
Be part of an experienced and international team.
A good vibe working environment.
The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.
Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.
The freedom to innovate, experiment, and help shape smarter ways of working.
Office location: Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid, Spain.
Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.


Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Entrar en BigQuery y atacar las tablas con SQL para responder a las preguntas de negocio.

Proponer nuevos análisis e indicadores.

Experiencia de 2 a 5 años como Analista BI o Analista de Mercado.

Title: Portfolio Data Analyst
Description:
About Morningstar

Morningstar is a leading global provider of independent investment insights, serving both individual and institutional investors across public and private markets. Our offerings include a wide range of data, research, and investment management services, with $300+ billion in assets under management. Operating in 32 countries, Morningstar supports financial advisors, asset managers, retirement plan providers, and more with comprehensive investment solutions.

The Team

Morningstar’s Research group provides independent analysis on individual securities, managed investments, portfolios, and markets. The group also collects and maintains high-quality data on the equities, managed investments, and fixed-income investments we cover in our database, one of the largest investment databases in the world. Morningstar is one of the largest independent sources of manager, equity, and credit research in the world. We transform data into insights that investors can use to reach their financial goals.

The Role

The Managed investment Data Team requires a Data Research Analyst to process our portfolio data across global markets. The analyst will need to work closely with the global Portfolio Team and Local Business Representatives, taking responsibility for data coverage, quality, and timeliness to the highest standards. The Portfolio Data Analyst will form closer links with providers related to data acquisition processes and gain expert knowledge of our database. The position will be based in our Data and Development Centre EMEA.

Responsibilities


Collect and maintain Morningstar data, ensuring high levels of data accuracy, completeness and coverage.
Meet the predetermined production deadlines for internal and external clients
Collaborate strongly with the global data teams
Continuously evaluate procedures, create and enhance analytical tools, and implement process improvement projects.
Act as an expert regarding investment data points and calculations, answering questions and escalations from data team.
Maintain and strengthen existing relationships with fund companies and clients as well as 3rd party data providers
Keep up to date on current and new financial regulations (Solvency II, MIFID II, etc.)
Drive process improvement by applying LEAN Six Sigma tools and implementing process automation.
Support Morningstar's portfolio capabilities, by testing incoming templates (TPT+, APT, etc.
Handling of Portfolio Data Transfer Agreement. Strong collaboration with Legal department and fund companies


Requirement


Solid understanding of the financial industry and passionate in investment data.
Excellent writing, communication, problem solving, organizational, and analytical skills.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, capable of handling high volumes of data and meeting strict deadlines
Fluent English and at least one other European language is mandatory.
A minimum of 2 years of experience in Morningstar, ideally in data management.
Expertise in Morningstar data, methodology, quality and processes. A strong knowledge of derivative investments is also required.


Ready to Shape the Future? At Morningstar, every hire we make strengthens our mission to empower investor success. Apply now and help shape the future of investing with us.

Base Salary Compensation Range

EUR 29.000,00-39.000,00

Bonus Target

5% Annual

We expect the compensation and target bonus for this role to fall within the stated range. The specific compensation offered will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other job-related factors.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

Title: Customer Strategy Analyst - Santander Insurance
Description:
Country: Spain

IT STARTS HERE




Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.




This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.




Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.




The Wealth Management & Insurance division covers three businesses in all Santander Group countries: Insurance, Asset Management and Private Banking. We work to provide the best solutions to our clients in these three businesses in the 10 countries where we are present.




THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE




Santander Insurance is looking for a Customer Strategy Analyst based out of Madrid.




The role will develop a deep understanding of key customer performance indicators to support value creation and strategic decision-making. Reporting to the Customer 360 & AI Director within the Customer Strategy & AI team.




As a customer strategy analyst your mission will be to build and maintain a robust and scalable analytical framework to monitor, understand and drive customer strategy performance across global and local markets. The role will support data-driven decision making by providing actionable insights on key customer KPIs, identifying performance drivers, and assessing the business impact of strategic initiatives.




We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:




1. Customer Analytics Framework

Develop and maintain a robust analytical environment to monitor customer performance across geographies, ensuring consistency between global and local views.
Define and standardize KPIs, metrics and analytical methodologies to ensure comparability and alignment across countries.
Design and enhance reporting tools and dashboards to provide clear visibility on customer performance.




2. KPI Monitoring & Performance Tracking

Track and analyze the evolution of key customer KPIs, including:
Customer lifetime Value
Net Promoter Score (NPS)
Customer churn
Customer base evolution
Product holding (e.g., insurance policies per customer)
Identify trends, deviations vs. targets and early warning signals.
Provide regular performance updates to key stakeholders and senior management.




3. Deep-Dive Analysis & Insights Generation

Conduct in-depth analyses to identify key drivers of performance, improvement levers and potential risks to achieving budget and strategic targets.
Segment customers and behaviors to uncover actionable insights.
Support hypothesis generation and validation using data.




4. Business Impact Assessment

Analyze and quantify the impact of strategic initiatives (e.g., commercial actions, retention strategies, cross-selling initiatives) on customer KPIs and business outcomes.
Develop frameworks to measure ROI and effectiveness of initiatives.
Support prioritization of initiatives based on data-driven insights.




5. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Work closely with business, data and local teams to ensure alignment on definitions, analyses and insights.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Support decision-making processes at both global and local levels.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING




Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.




The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.







Professional Experience

At least 5 years of professional experience in the insurance industry, preferably in roles related to analytics and performance tracking.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI monitoring and business performance management.
Experience working with large and complex datasets across multiple sources.
Artificial intelligence application on task and process automation, data analytics and innovation. (Preferred)




Education

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.




Languages

Very high proficiency in English and Spanish are required.
Portuguese is desirable (Preferred)




Hard Skills

Proficiency in SQL and Excel for data extraction and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to build dashboards and reports.
Familiarity with data models, data structures and analytical frameworks is a plus. (Preferred)




Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to connect data analysis with business impact and decision-making.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.







WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT




Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.

We’re enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
Flexibility that works. Enjoy a hybrid working models—some days remote, some days onsite with your team—along with flexible hours.
Learning for life. Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com)
Competitive rewards. Receive a highly competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, motivating you to keep growing with us.
Financial advantages. Benefit from preferential banking terms, special interest rates on loans, life insurance, and more.
Your health is our priority. Through BeHealthy, our global wellness programme, we promote Holistic wellbeing.
We know family is everything. That’s why we offer childcare support and family-friendly programmes tailored to each life stage.
Always by your side. Get access to Santander Contigo, our program for employees and their families offering legal, emotional, and administrative advisory services.
Extra benefits. Gym/WellHub membership, medical centers in some of our facilities, meal subsidy, parking, shuttle service from various points in Madrid, as well as exclusive discounts and offers for Santander employees. And that’s only the beginning—we’ll tell you more when you join!




We’re here to keep you motivated, help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.




LOCAL COMPLIANCE




Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.




WHAT TO DO NEXT




If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

Collaborate with Project Managers and Data Science teams to support operational initiatives and ensure smooth project execution

Based in Madrid

Title: Data Analytics Lead (Product Intelligence)
Description:
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.









Job Description



About the role



The Product Intelligence team serves a critical role by providing business intelligence to the organization: we synthesize data sources across the company, delivering product usage and business insights that directly shape product strategy and decision-making.



We are looking for a Data Analytics Lead to own the analytical and semantic layer of Product Intelligence – the person who defines what our data means, makes sure it is trustworthy, and turns it into insight that changes decisions. You will work hand in hand with Product Management and Engineering to define the telemetry we need in order to answer the questions the business is actually asking, establish the success metrics that product and commercial teams are measured against, and proactively investigate product usage and user journeys to surface opportunities PMs would not have found on their own. You will also be the analytical voice in the room with senior leadership, regularly presenting insights and recommendations to senior management.



This is a deliberately broad, high-ownership analytics role rather than a report-building one. You will own data quality, cataloging, and the semantic definitions that make our data AI-ready, and you will partner closely with your data engineering counterpart – defining the business needs and data requirements, and collaborating with them to deliver the pipelines and models that support them.



As a senior individual contributor, you will lead our analytics function, its standards, and its definitions. As Lead you are expected to own the discipline and set its direction, with your influence coming from the quality of your work and your partnerships across Product, Engineering, and the business.



What you’ll do



Insight & analysis



Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate product usage and telemetry data into product-led insights – identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, and supporting revenue targets.
Perform proactive, self-directed analysis into product usage and user journeys – funnel and drop-off analysis, feature adoption, cohort and retention behaviour – to help Product Managers understand how the product is really used and where to improve it.
Define, document, and own the success metrics used to evaluate product features, releases, and business objectives, and make sure they are consistently understood and applied across teams.
Provide regular reporting, insights, and recommendations to senior management, and present them directly to that audience.
Manage senior stakeholders across the business, balancing competing analytical priorities from Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.

Data definition, quality & governance



Own the semantic layer: define what our core business entities and metrics mean – customer, account, active user, adoption, churn, expansion – so that a given metric means the same thing everywhere in the company.
Champion an AI-ready data strategy by defining the semantics, metric definitions, and metadata that allow AI and LLM-powered tools to query our data reliably and return trustworthy answers.
Own data quality for the analytical layer: define quality expectations and checks, monitor for silent correctness failures, and drive issues to resolution with the owning teams before they reach a dashboard or a leadership deck.
Build and maintain the data catalog and documentation, so that data consumers across the company can find data, understand its meaning, and know how much to trust it.
Establish and maintain data governance practices for the analytics layer – ownership, lineage, definitions, and access – proportionate to a fast-moving team.

Data collection & partnering with Engineering



Work with Product Managers and Engineering to define and implement new product telemetry, specifying the events, properties, and grain needed to answer real business questions – and validating that what ships actually answers them.
Identify gaps in what we currently collect, and make the case for the instrumentation needed to close them.
Define business and data requirements clearly enough to be built, and collaborate with your data engineering counterpart to deliver the pipelines, models, and data structures required to support them.
Contribute to the design and evolution of the analytics layer, including semantic modeling and dashboarding within our BI tools.
Promote an agile, iterative way of working and actively contribute to team ceremonies.


Qualifications



What We’re Looking For



Analytics experience



Degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-analytical field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in a data analyst, product analyst, analytics engineer, or business intelligence role, including experience operating with a high level of autonomy and owning your own analytical agenda.
Strong SQL – comfortable working directly in a data warehouse against large, messy, multi-source data without needing someone to prepare it for you.
Proven experience partnering with Product and business teams to deliver product-led insights, such as identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, or supporting revenue growth.
Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting data strategy and insights to executive/C-level audiences.
Hands-on experience with product usage or telemetry data – funnels, user journeys, feature adoption, cohort and retention analysis.
Experience defining success metrics and KPIs, and the judgement to know when a proposed metric will drive the wrong behaviour.
Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, or similar – including building the semantic/data model behind a dashboard, not just the dashboard itself.
Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, grain, slowly changing dimensions) and the ability to reason about whether a data model can answer a given business question.
Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding tools – Claude Code or similar – as part of your day-to-day analytical work: exploring unfamiliar data, writing and debugging queries and transformations, and automating repetitive analysis.
Familiarity with the modern data stack – dbt, cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), AWS services such as S3, Athena, or Glue – and comfort using Git as part of an analytics workflow.
Experience specifying telemetry or instrumentation requirements together with Product and Engineering teams.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain a complex finding simply without losing its rigor. Fluency in English.
Available to travel to our head office in Lausanne on an occasional basis.

Data quality, governance & AI-readiness



Practical experience owning data quality – defining checks and expectations, investigating discrepancies, and distinguishing a genuine business result from a data problem.
Experience with data cataloging, documentation, or data governance practices, and an understanding of why shared definitions matter more than tooling.
Solid understanding of AI/ML and LLM concepts and their implications for data – in particular, why semantic definitions, metric consistency, and data quality determine whether an AI tool gives a trustworthy answer or a plausible wrong one.
Ability to identify where AI can create value in an analytics workflow, and interest in using it to work faster.

How you work



Curious and proactive: you go looking for the insight nobody asked for, and you sanity-check a result against business reality before you present it.

Job Description

About the role

The Product Intelligence team serves a critical role by providing business intelligence to the organization: we synthesize data sources across the company, delivering product usage and business insights that directly shape product strategy and decision-making.

We are looking for a Data Analytics Lead to own the analytical and semantic layer of Product Intelligence – the person who defines what our data means, makes sure it is trustworthy, and turns it into insight that changes decisions. You will work hand in hand with Product Management and Engineering to define the telemetry we need in order to answer the questions the business is actually asking, establish the success metrics that product and commercial teams are measured against, and proactively investigate product usage and user journeys to surface opportunities PMs would not have found on their own. You will also be the analytical voice in the room with senior leadership, regularly presenting insights and recommendations to senior management.

This is a deliberately broad, high-ownership analytics role rather than a report-building one. You will own data quality, cataloging, and the semantic definitions that make our data AI-ready, and you will partner closely with your data engineering counterpart – defining the business needs and data requirements, and collaborating with them to deliver the pipelines and models that support them.

As a senior individual contributor, you will lead our analytics function, its standards, and its definitions. As Lead you are expected to own the discipline and set its direction, with your influence coming from the quality of your work and your partnerships across Product, Engineering, and the business.

What you’ll do

Insight & analysis

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to translate product usage and telemetry data into product-led insights – identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, and supporting revenue targets.
  • Perform proactive, self-directed analysis into product usage and user journeys – funnel and drop-off analysis, feature adoption, cohort and retention behaviour – to help Product Managers understand how the product is really used and where to improve it.
  • Define, document, and own the success metrics used to evaluate product features, releases, and business objectives, and make sure they are consistently understood and applied across teams.
  • Provide regular reporting, insights, and recommendations to senior management, and present them directly to that audience.
  • Manage senior stakeholders across the business, balancing competing analytical priorities from Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance.

Data definition, quality & governance

  • Own the semantic layer: define what our core business entities and metrics mean – customer, account, active user, adoption, churn, expansion – so that a given metric means the same thing everywhere in the company.
  • Champion an AI-ready data strategy by defining the semantics, metric definitions, and metadata that allow AI and LLM-powered tools to query our data reliably and return trustworthy answers.
  • Own data quality for the analytical layer: define quality expectations and checks, monitor for silent correctness failures, and drive issues to resolution with the owning teams before they reach a dashboard or a leadership deck.
  • Build and maintain the data catalog and documentation, so that data consumers across the company can find data, understand its meaning, and know how much to trust it.
  • Establish and maintain data governance practices for the analytics layer – ownership, lineage, definitions, and access – proportionate to a fast-moving team.

Data collection & partnering with Engineering

  • Work with Product Managers and Engineering to define and implement new product telemetry, specifying the events, properties, and grain needed to answer real business questions – and validating that what ships actually answers them.
  • Identify gaps in what we currently collect, and make the case for the instrumentation needed to close them.
  • Define business and data requirements clearly enough to be built, and collaborate with your data engineering counterpart to deliver the pipelines, models, and data structures required to support them.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of the analytics layer, including semantic modeling and dashboarding within our BI tools.
  • Promote an agile, iterative way of working and actively contribute to team ceremonies.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Analytics experience

  • Degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-analytical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in a data analyst, product analyst, analytics engineer, or business intelligence role, including experience operating with a high level of autonomy and owning your own analytical agenda.
  • Strong SQL – comfortable working directly in a data warehouse against large, messy, multi-source data without needing someone to prepare it for you.
  • Proven experience partnering with Product and business teams to deliver product-led insights, such as identifying upsell opportunities, predicting churn, or supporting revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting data strategy and insights to executive/C-level audiences.
  • Hands-on experience with product usage or telemetry data – funnels, user journeys, feature adoption, cohort and retention analysis.
  • Experience defining success metrics and KPIs, and the judgement to know when a proposed metric will drive the wrong behaviour.
  • Experience with data visualization and BI tools such as Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, or similar – including building the semantic/data model behind a dashboard, not just the dashboard itself.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (facts, dimensions, grain, slowly changing dimensions) and the ability to reason about whether a data model can answer a given business question.
  • Hands-on experience using agentic AI coding tools – Claude Code or similar – as part of your day-to-day analytical work: exploring unfamiliar data, writing and debugging queries and transformations, and automating repetitive analysis.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack – dbt, cloud data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), AWS services such as S3, Athena, or Glue – and comfort using Git as part of an analytics workflow.
  • Experience specifying telemetry or instrumentation requirements together with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain a complex finding simply without losing its rigor. Fluency in English.
  • Available to travel to our head office in Lausanne on an occasional basis.

Data quality, governance & AI-readiness

  • Practical experience owning data quality – defining checks and expectations, investigating discrepancies, and distinguishing a genuine business result from a data problem.
  • Experience with data cataloging, documentation, or data governance practices, and an understanding of why shared definitions matter more than tooling.
  • Solid understanding of AI/ML and LLM concepts and their implications for data – in particular, why semantic definitions, metric consistency, and data quality determine whether an AI tool gives a trustworthy answer or a plausible wrong one.
  • Ability to identify where AI can create value in an analytics workflow, and interest in using it to work faster.

How you work

  • Curious and proactive: you go looking for the insight nobody asked for, and you sanity-check a result against business reality before you present it.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity – able to turn a vague business question into a well-defined analysis, and to say clearly when the data cannot answer it.

Join our team in Madrid and play a key role in leading automation, analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives across pricing operations for the M&C, B2B, and Fleet segments in the MED region. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As a Senior Data Analyst on our Growth team, you will play a pivotal role in driving our marketing performance to new heights. You will collaborate closely with User Acquisition and Growth partners to analyze data, find opportunities, and deliver actionable insights. Your work will empower strategic business decisions and improve player experiences.

What You'll Do
Partner closely with UA and Growth collaborators to understand performance, investigate business questions, and provide actionable recommendations.
Lead analytical projects end-to-end, from problem definition and data exploration through to insights and collaborator communication.
Own and evolve the business logic and analytical requirements of Growth data models, ensuring they accurately represent how the business measures performance.
Act as a key collaborator with Data Engineering, translating business and analytical needs into clear data requirements and validating delivered solutions.
Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues, inconsistencies, and gaps across Growth reporting and underlying data models.
Build and maintain scalable reporting and analytical solutions, reducing repetitive manual analysis where possible.
Define and maintain key Growth metrics and measurement logic across areas such as spend, acquisition, revenue, attribution, and marketing performance.
Perform deep-dive analyses to understand performance drivers, find opportunities, and support investment decisions.
Communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical collaborators, including senior leadership.
Provide technical mentorship and share standard methodologies with other analysts while contributing to consistent analytical standards across the team.
Work closely with Data Scientists on measurement, experimentation, and modeling projects by offering solid analytical and data foundations.


What We're Looking For

We are seeking an ambitious and seasoned Senior Data Analyst with a proven track record of delivering outstanding results. You should have:
4+ years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related role.
Strong experience independently delivering analytical projects and working directly with business collaborators.
Experience owning or contributing significantly to analytical data models, metric definitions, or reporting foundations.
Advanced SQL skills and strong experience working with large and complex datasets.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis, automation and analytical workflows.
Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and analytical data structures.
Experience converting business requirements into data requirements and collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.
Proficiency in a data visualization/BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.
Good understanding of statistical analysis and experimentation.
Familiarity with digital marketing data, attribution, and acquisition metrics is a strong plus.
A strong ownership approach, comfortable independently driving work through to completion.
A curious and analytical nature, always looking to investigate unexpected results and challenge assumptions.
Realistic and dedicated to identifying ways forward.
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy and reliability.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast paced business environment.
Strong collaboration skills, capable of working effectively across Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and business teams.
Excellent communication skills, able to challenge constructively and build trust with technical and non-technical collaborators.
Willingness to assist in the technical growth of other analysts and help maintain high analytical standards throughout the team.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Preparar informes avanzados alineados con KPIs y requisitos del proyecto
Mantener, actualizar y asegurar la calidad de la documentación y reportes en herramientas como SharePoint y Office365

Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para convertir insights en acciones concretas
Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis

Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos

Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel

Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)

Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente

Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos

Descripción de la empresa

MSX International es un líder global en servicios para el sector de automoción, presente en más de 80 países. Desde nuestra sede en Barcelona trabajamos con diferentes fabricantes internacionales para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras que impulsan la eficiencia, la calidad y el rendimiento de sus operaciones.

Si buscas un entorno dinámico, analítico, internacional y orientado a la mejora continua, este es tu sitio.

Descripción del empleo

Como Analista de Datos, serás responsable de gestionar, analizar y transformar datos clave relacionados con proyectos del sector automoción. Tu misión será convertir grandes volúmenes de datos en insights claros y accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones, la optimización de procesos y el rendimiento general del negocio.

Requisitos

  • Realizar análisis diarios, semanales y mensuales utilizando herramientas como Tableau, Power BI y Excel
  • Identificar tendencias, variaciones y oportunidades de mejora
  • Preparar informes avanzados alineados con KPIs y requisitos del proyecto
  • Mantener, actualizar y asegurar la calidad de la documentación y reportes en herramientas como SharePoint y Office365
  • Identificar patrones en los datos y proponer acciones correctivas u oportunidades de optimización
  • Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para convertir insights en acciones concretas
  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de estándares internos en informes y dashboards
  • Presentar análisis, conclusiones e información relevante a equipos internos y dirección
  • Asegurar la precisión, consistencia y calidad de los datos analizados
  • Proponer mejoras continuas en procesos, metodologías y flujos de análisis

Requisitos

Conocimientos y habilidades

  • Habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar con equipos diversos
  • Enfoque resolutivo para problemas complejos
  • Capacidad para gestionar prioridades y trabajar con plazos ajustados
  • Dominio de Tableau, Power BI y Excel
  • Conocimientos de sistemas de gestión de datos, minería de datos, procesos ETL y reporting automatizado
  • Competencias en análisis estadístico y modelos de rendimiento
  • Experiencia con herramientas de automatización (RPA) es un plus
  • Conocimiento de Microsoft Dynamics (deseable)

Formación

  • Grado en Ingeniería, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas o formación equivalente

Experiencia

  • Experiencia previa demostrable como Analista de Datos

Idiomas

  • Español nativo
  • Inglés B2 (escrito y hablado)

Información adicional

Qué ofrecemos

  • Puesto permanente con contrato indefinido desde el primer día.
  • Política de teletrabajo de hasta el 50% de la jornada mensual tras el periodo de adaptación.
  • Formar parte de un gran equipo de profesionales en una compañía internacional consolidada.
  • Obtener una visión global del sector automoción, interactuando con clientes, proveedores, consultores y concesionarios.
  • Salario: 23.000 euros brutos anuales.
  • Acceso a MSX Bazaar, el portal de compras colectivas con grandes descuentos para empleados.
  • Posibilidad de adherirte al Plan de Retribución Flexible (seguro médico, tarjeta transporte, tarjeta restaurante, formación...).
  • 23 días laborables de vacaciones al año según convenio y 3 días por año completo trabajado.
  • Incentivos adicionales por programas de recomendación interna, formadores internos, detección de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, etc.

¿Crees que eres la persona ideal para este puesto? ¡Queremos conocerte! Envíanos tu candidatura ahora.
