Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

What you'll do


Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.


Who you are


Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
You're fluent in SQL and Python.
You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.


🤝 What we offer

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🍱 Healthy meals: No more boring tupperware – enjoy daily meals with Nora Foods. We cover 50% of each order!

💳 Cobee card: Flexible compensation for transport and restaurants, so you can make the most of your net salary.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

Our Process

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Coffee at the Office with the Founders

Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Customer Success Operations)
Description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Customer Success organisation serves hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals across 13 markets. Two global business lines sit at the centre of that effort, Individual Doctors and Clinics, each led by a VP who needs sharp, reliable analytics to grow their business and make decisions with confidence.

This role sits within Global Customer Success Operations & Analytics, the team that acts as the connective layer between the business and Docplanner's data organisation: BI (dashboard and data standardisation), Data Platform (infrastructure, architecture, DWH), and Product Analytics (product launches and opportunities).

This role is dedicated to one business line, partnering closely with that VP and their leadership team on the deep dives, data models, dashboards, and experiments needed to run and grow the business across our 13 markets.

You'll report to the Global CS Ops analytics manager, who sets the team's priorities and supports big projects the team takes on. Within that frame, you own how your own time is spent day to day, prioritizing incoming asks, sequencing your backlog, and deciding what needs your manager's input versus what you can resolve directly with your business and data stakeholders.

How will you make an impact?

Reporting, dashboards & data models


Build and maintain the recurring reporting, dashboards (Tableau, superset), and data models your business line runs on
Build and maintain automations that scale across markets
Keep outputs consistent with BI's dashboard and data standards, escalating gaps rather than working around them


Analytical models: statistics & prediction (a growing focus)


Today, most of your time goes to reporting and execution. Over the next year, we expect a meaningful shift toward analytical modelling (statistics and prediction)
Review, update, and improve the statistical and predictive models your business line already relies on
Build MVPs for new predictive or statistical use cases, handing them off to Data Science once validated
Bring regression, forecasting, and other statistical techniques into your day-to-day analysis, not just descriptive reporting


AI-first execution


Work AI-first: use AI to query, code, and analyse faster and more consistently
Use and contribute to the team's shared libraries, reusable code, and architecture (e.g. GitHub-based repositories)


Bridging business and data teams


Act as the translation layer between your business line and Docplanner's data organisation: BI, Data Platform, and Product Analytics
Bring the right requirements to each team, and flag when scope or timelines don't match business priority


Driving analytics for your business line


Partner directly with the VP of your assigned business line and their team to understand the business, identify gaps, and surface opportunities
Lead deep dives that go beyond describing what happened to explain why, and what do next
Propose, run, and analyse experiments (A/B tests and beyond) that inform business decisions


Prioritisation & stakeholder alignment


Own the day-to-day sequencing of your own workload: triage incoming requests, judge urgency and impact, and decide what to tackle first without waiting to be told
Align directly with assigned business and data stakeholders on what matters and when
Escalate cross-team or resourcing trade-offs to your manager, who owns prioritisation of the team's big projects


Qualifications

What will help you thrive?


Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar)
+3-5 years of relevant analytics experience as an individual contributor
Very good SQL skills (Amazon Redshift preferred); solid Python, especially for statistical and predictive modelling
Working knowledge of statistical modelling (regression analysis, forecasting/prediction, A/B testing)
Hands-on experience with Superset and/or Tableau, building dashboards for non-technical audiences
Skilled at digesting complex data into business language: able to summarise findings and frame them as a clear narrative, not just a report
Experience working cross-functionally, partnering with non-technical stakeholders across departments
Professional fluency in English (Spanish is a plus)


What makes you a strong fit?


Proactive by default: you spot what needs doing and raise the level of execution around you, rather than waiting for instructions
Owner with entrepreneurial mindset: own your work, your results, and everything in between
Able to prioritise your own workload with sound criteria, and know when to align with stakeholders versus escalate to your manager
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driven by results
Understands the capabilities and limits of AI/LLMs and has experience building things with them (professionally or on your own)
Track record of scoping problems, running high-quality quantitative analysis, and developing insights that drive decisions
Communicates complex concepts simply and clearly; builds trust across a wide range of stakeholders


Extra advantage


Experience building or validating statistical/predictive models and handing them off to a Data Science team
Experience in tech companies, start-ups, and/or consultancy. No prior experience in healthcare or SaaS required, but curiosity about both is critical!


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Ashleigh Hill to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Andreu Passola; your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind - it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣ Technical Interview – A short SQL assessment and discussion with our Head of BI.

4️⃣ Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and stakeholder panel to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader/stakeholder/peer from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers, transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths - whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

Title: Data Analyst Demand Planning
Description:
Job Summary

Are you passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve planning performance and drive better business decisions?

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Demand Planning to support our global planning organization through advanced analytics, performance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will partner with Demand Planning, Commercial, Supply Planning, Finance, Information Technology, and external stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights that enhance forecast accuracy, business performance, and planning maturity. The position supports a fully remote working model and offers the opportunity to contribute to global transformation and data-driven decision-making initiatives.

Job Description

Global Operations

Ensuring excellence in execution across the value chain through operational effectiveness, supply chain performance, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Team Description

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the role:

We are looking for a responsible and hard-working Senior Data Analyst to join our efforts in taking over the print-on-demand industry. You would work in an international environment with talented teammates in a casual atmosphere. You’ll have your hands on very rich and diverse data related to the print-on-demand universe.

Your daily tasks will include:


Acting as a go-to data person within your respective team
Engaging in product analytics, ops analytics and business analytics
Continuously improving your team's product features with suggestions from ad-hoc and regular data analysis
Analyzing internal, market, and customer levels of data regarding various business areas
Translating data into actionable insights


You’ll level up fast by building production-grade analytics with state-of-the-art tools—Snowflake Intelligence, Streamlit in Snowflake, Amplitude, and more—gaining real ownership, mentorship, and impact at scale. In collaboration with our data engineers, you will define data models and ensure data quality through rigorous QA processes. You will work with Looker's analytical layer, defining explores, measures, and dimensions to support robust data exploration.

Your qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, physics, economics or a related quantitative field required
Strong written & verbal English communication skills
At least 4 years of professional experience in data analysis
Demonstrated ability to present and clearly articulate summarized data analysis results
Advanced SQL skills and experience with Snowflake or similar data warehouses
Proficiency in Excel usage for data analysis
Hands-on experience with BI tools to create interactive dashboards and visualizations (Looker is a plus)
Solid understanding of data modeling and data quality principles
Hands-on experience with event tracking and product analytics tools (Amplitude is a plus)
Hands-on experience with A/B testing and causal inference


What we offer:


A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done
An opportunity to work remotely
Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 10 AM)
Private health insurance
2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being
1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice
Learning Budget to support your professional development.
Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online
Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!
Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ About the role

Data is highly valued at LocalStack, and this role is an opportunity to shape our product analytics strategy as we scale. You’ll connect fragmented data and user identities across the Emulator, CLI, VS Code extension, web app and docs, using rich product telemetry to understand how behaviour drives conversion, expansion and churn. You’ll help define what we build versus buy, establish better product analytics foundations, and turn usage data into insights that inform pricing, packaging and growth decisions. You’ll work closely with highly technical teams and have significant ownership in shaping how product analytics, data tooling and AI-assisted ways of working evolve at LocalStack.

✅ We Expect you to accomplish in this role:


Build and evangelise product analytics foundations, delivering actionable insight for GTM, Finance, Marketing, Product and Engineering teams on how the product is being bought and used (across PLG and SLG channels)
Connect the user journey across the Emulator, CLI, VS Code extension, console, docs site, website, offering a 360 degree customer view view into customer behaviour (for all types: human, CI, AI agent) and composites (e.g. human + AI)
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes that impact the product success
Understand how data currently flows at LocalStack and work with technical teams to develop enrichment to deliver the product analytics vision
Develop insights that prove out the value proposition / ROI for customers in collaboration with customers and customer facing teams


✅ Specialist Skills/ Experience


7+ years in data analytics role with a strong focus on product analytics
Experience modelling a unified system, showcasing architecture level thinking
Strong experience with complex SQL and ideally programming languages such as Python.
Experience with web and product analytics tools such as Posthog, GA4, Segment, RudderStack, Heap, Amplitude, Contentsquare, or equivalent
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.


🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack


Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes
Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.
Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.
Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.
Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.


🎁 Benefits we offer:


Fully remote
Competitive salary
Annual company retreat
2 extra company-wide holidays
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture (community guilds and online company events)
Yearly bonus


Sounds like a good match?

We'd love to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of cloud development at LocalStack.

To apply, follow the application process. Make sure to include a short motivation outlining why you are the perfect candidate for this role.

If your profile looks like a good match, our talent team will be in touch to organize further steps within 2 weeks.

Please note, that due to a high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

Compensation Range: £70K - £90K

Title: Content Partners Data Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Content Partners Data Analyst to analyse how advertising drives user acquisition, engagement and retention for streaming, CTV, gaming and other content-app brands.

This is a client-facing role combining strong SQL and data visualisation skills with deep knowledge of the content-app market. You will analyse advertising, audience and app-usage data, build clear measurement frameworks and dashboards, use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, and present actionable recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.

Key responsibilities:


Measure Advertising Performance: Analyse campaign exposure and performance across CTV, streaming, gaming and other content-app environments
Connect Ads to Outcomes: Measure how campaigns influence app usage, acquisition, engagement, retention and re-engagement
Build Client Insights: Turn complex behavioural and advertising data into clear, commercially relevant stories and recommendations
Develop Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs and repeatable approaches for reach, frequency, incrementality, conversion and engagement measurement
Create Dashboards & Reporting: Build scalable visualisations and reporting that make campaign and audience performance easy to understand
Use AI to Accelerate Analysis: Apply tools such as Claude to speed up exploration, QA, insight generation and reporting workflows
Present to Stakeholders: Lead analysis readouts and confidently present findings to clients, partners and senior internal teams
Understand the Content Market: Track CTV, streaming and gaming trends and translate market changes into better measurement and client recommendations


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


5+ years of experience in advertising measurement, analytics or insights within streaming, CTV, digital content, gaming or a closely related industry
Strong SQL skills: Able to independently query, join and analyse large behavioural and advertising datasets
Advertising measurement expertise: Experience with campaign performance, reach/frequency, attribution, incrementality, conversion and engagement metrics
Content-app experience: Strong understanding of streaming, broadcaster, FAST, gaming or other digital content businesses and their growth and engagement goals
Data visualisation skills: Hands-on experience with tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Looker or Power BI and a strong eye for clear analytical storytelling
AI-enabled analytics: Comfort using tools such as Claude, Amazon Bedrock or similar LLM platforms to improve analytical productivity and insight generation
Excellent presentation skills: Confident explaining analysis and recommendations to both technical and non-technical internal and external stakeholders
Analytical curiosity: A genuine love of content, strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations; Python is a plus


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Experienced Data Analyst - Digital Sales (m/f/d)
Description:
Your Tasks

This position is part of the Digital Sales Data Foundation team, which drives data-driven decision making across our digital platforms by analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and measuring the impact of strategic initiatives with a strong focus on A/B testing to enhance customer experience and business performance. You will work closely with other Data Analysts, Data Engineers, a dedicated Product Owner, and colleagues from global and local business departments.

Your tasks:


Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve analytics, tracking, and experimentation initiatives across digital areas.
Design, optimize, and document scalable tracking and measurement concepts, ensuring data quality, consistency, and usability for reporting, analysis, experimentation, and third-party integrations.
Define relevant KPIs, build dashboards, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support product optimization and data-driven decision-making.
Support and improve experimentation processes, including A/B test design, sample size planning, KPI alignment, analysis methodology, result interpretation, and rollout recommendations.
Contribute to scalable experimentation practices, tooling, automation, and knowledge management to support a growing number of experiments across markets, platforms, and product areas.
Work hands-on with complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics tools, while collaborating closely with developers and data teams.
Act as a trusted sparring partner for stakeholders, working independently or within cross-functional teams, and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


Your Profile


Several years of experience in digital analytics, conversion analysis, product analytics, experimentation, or a similar data-focused role, ideally in an e-commerce or digital product environment.
Strong understanding of tracking concepts, KPI frameworks, data quality, reporting, and analytics tools such as Google Data Studio, Adobe Analytics, Firebase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong experience with A/B testing or experimentation methodologies, including test setup, sample size considerations, KPI definition, statistical evaluation, interpretation of results, and communication of conclusions.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud or data warehouse technologies such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, or similar solutions.
Experience working with developers and technical teams, including documentation of requirements, tracking concepts, data flows, and implementation logic.
Familiarity with modern collaboration and productivity tools such as GitHub, GitHub Copilot, AI agents, reusable skills/workflows, or similar tools.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions and explain complex topics clearly.
High level of ownership, self-organization, curiosity, and ability to work both independently and as part of technical and cross-functional teams.


About Us

MediaMarktSaturn is Europe’s leading consumer electronics retailer. It sees itself as a partner, daily companion and navigator for its customers in the digital world. Its over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores are closely integrated with their online shops. MediaMarktSaturn has a total headcount of more than 60,000.

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working on making Europe's number one consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its sector. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 11 countries.

Technology Hub located in Barcelona, is one of the service units of MediaMarktSaturn Technology to deliver adequate staffing and engineering skills for the agreed deliveries of the global deployment plan for the entire group.

If you are interested in this position but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are




Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.




Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.




What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued




So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Senior Marketing Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We are looking to welcome yet another brilliant Senior Marketing Data Analyst into our Marketing Analytics team.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be responsible for designing and driving high-impact analytics solutions, from developing advanced statistical frameworks to evaluate marketing performance, to building data pipelines that integrate third-party sources, to creating interactive tools that empower partner teams. These are just a few examples of the initiatives you’ll help lead and deliver end-to-end, playing a key role in shaping the technical direction of our analytics efforts. The demands on this team are constantly evolving with the needs of Socialpoint’s and Zynga’s dynamic marketing teams, so it is important that you be able to adapt and utilize your time efficiently.

What You'll Do


Partner closely with marketing and cross-functional teams to identify growth opportunities, improve efficiency, and shape strategic initiatives.
Lead analytical deep dives to surface insights and translate them into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Visualize and communicate analytical findings clearly, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Apply statistical methodologies to evaluate performance and account for uncertainties in major initiatives.
Proactively explore and prototype opportunities using AI-driven automation to streamline investigations and improve decision-making.


What You Bring


Demonstrated experience with some or all of the following: predictive modeling, statistics, experimental design, optimization, data visualization
Understanding of marketing metrics and KPIs, with experience in campaign optimization, Lifetime Value (LTV) modeling, and incrementality analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Python with hands-on experience in Redshift, Databricks, PySpark, and Airflow
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate ambiguous questions into data-driven insights
Strong communication skills — you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus
A team player, you establish effective relationships to work with others for the win
Proven work experience in data analytics or data science roles
BS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Economics, or other quantitative field; Masters, MBA or PhD preferred


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)


The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Please contact us at recruitment@socialpoint.es to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position.

Please be aware that Socialpoint does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Socialpoint also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Title: Commercial Reporting and Insights Analyst – Healthcare – Barcelona, Spain
Description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Commercial Reporting and Insights Analyst – Healthcare – Barcelona, Spain

Please note, internally, this position is titled: Sales Operations Analyst

Meet The Team


You’ll join Dexcom’s Commercial Excellence organization, where data, systems, and insights support commercial planning, execution, and performance measurement across EMEA. The team is building a more connected, consistent data ecosystem to help regional and country teams make better decisions and drive commercial impact.
This role helps standardize commercial performance reporting, dashboards, and key metrics, turning agreed data definitions into timely insights that highlight trends, risks, and areas requiring action.


Where You Come In


Build, maintain, and improve standardized EMEA commercial performance dashboards and recurring reports aligned to agreed business definitions.
Partner with Commercial Excellence, Analytics, Sales Operations, Finance, Marketing, and country teams to translate reporting needs into practical, reusable solutions.
Support adoption of common key performance indicators, calculation rules, targets, filters, and reporting hierarchies across EMEA.
Monitor trends, variances, and exceptions to surface material performance changes and areas requiring follow-up.
Validate and reconcile reporting outputs, investigate inconsistencies, and coordinate resolution with data owners.
Create clear summaries and visualizations that explain what changed, where it changed, and why it matters.
Help rationalize existing reports and dashboards, reducing duplication and improving consistency across EMEA.
Maintain reporting documentation, gather user feedback, support testing, and promote effective use of standardized reporting.


What Makes You Successful


Experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, sales operations, performance reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and recurring reports using Tableau or Power BI.
Strong understanding of reporting concepts, including metrics, filters, hierarchies, targets, trend analysis, and data validation.
Ability to use SQL, Excel, or comparable tools to analyse data, validate outputs, and investigate discrepancies.
Able to translate business questions into clear analyses, concise visualizations, and practical commentary.
Structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable documenting logic, reconciling outputs, and maintaining reporting consistency.
Effective collaborator with regional, country, business, data, and system stakeholders.
Proactive and execution-focused, able to manage recurring deadlines and follow through on open issues.
Experience in MedTech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated commercial environment is preferred.


What You’ll Get


A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
A full and comprehensive benefits program.
Growth opportunities on a global scale.
Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.


Travel Required


5-15%


Experience And Education Requirements


Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 2-5 years of related experience.


Flex/Hybrid Workplace

Your primary location will be your assigned Dexcom site but you may work part of the week from a home office. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically within an hour’s commute).

To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. Dexcom is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications.

AI in Hiring Notice: We may use AI supported tools to help make our hiring process more efficient, consistent, and accessible for candidates around the world. All hiring decisions are made by people.

At Dexcom, we are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process, and welcome candidates of all genders and gender identities to apply. If any wording in this description appears unintentionally gendered or exclusionary, please be assured this is not intentional.

Should a reasonable accommodation be necessary to aid a disability, requests should be sent to Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com.

The annualised base salary for this position is from €41,055.00 to €53,130.00 gross. Final offer will depend on your qualifications, competencies, and professional experience.

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Position Overview

We are looking to welcome yet another brilliant Senior Marketing Data Analyst into our Marketing Analytics team.

What You'll Do

Apply statistical methodologies to evaluate performance and account for uncertainties in major initiatives.
Proactively explore and prototype opportunities using AI-driven automation to streamline investigations and improve decision-making.


What You Bring


Demonstrated experience with some or all of the following: predictive modeling, statistics, experimental design, optimization, data visualization

Proven work experience in data analytics or data science roles

Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)

Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization


Qualifications


Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
Proficiency in Excel
Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona


You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
