Title: Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance
Description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will


Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May-June (reforecast).


🤔 What You Can Expect


A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.


➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You


Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.


At Qonto we understand that true diversity isn't just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick! Who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we've been searching for all along.

By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

Title: BUSINESS DATA ANALYST - GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION
Description:
En MANGO vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

Tu Nuevo Puesto

Tu objetivo será contribuir a la mejora de la distribución comercial y la gestión de stocks a través del análisis de datos y la participación en proyectos transversales. Trabajarás con los equipos de negocio, técnicos y de sistemas para identificar oportunidades, convertirlas en propuestas concretas y acompañar su implementación y seguimiento.

Tus Principales Responsabilidades


Extraer, preparar y cruzar datos de distintas fuentes con autonomía, asegurando la calidad y consistencia de la información utilizada en los análisis.
Desarrollar y mantener indicadores, dashboards y herramientas de análisis que faciliten el seguimiento del negocio y la toma de decisiones.
Analizar el comportamiento de las ventas, los stocks y la distribución, y elaborar modelos analíticos y escenarios que permitan identificar oportunidades, priorizar iniciativas y evaluar su impacto.
Participar en la definición y revisión de criterios y reglas de negocio para mejorar la asignación de producto, la reposición y la gestión del inventario.
Participar en la gestión y seguimiento de proyectos transversales del área. Acompañar la implementación de mejoras y realizar el seguimiento de sus resultados mediante los indicadores definidos, contrastando el impacto real con los objetivos previstos.
Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requerimientos claros para los equipos técnicos y de sistemas, colaborando en la validación de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Preparar presentaciones, conclusiones y recomendaciones que comuniquen de forma clara los resultados de los análisis.
Contribuir a la mejora continua de procesos, herramientas y automatizaciones.


Sobre Ti


Formación en Ingeniería, ADE, Estadística, Economía u otras disciplinas con una sólida base cuantitativa y analítica.
+/- 4 años de experiencia en roles analíticos con exposición a negocio, preferiblemente en entornos de retail, distribución o gestión de stocks.
Dominio de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con autonomía en la extracción, transformación y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos, en entornos como Databricks.
Nivel avanzado de Excel. Se valorará experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Looker.
Conocimiento práctico de Python valorable.
Capacidad para interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio y convertir los resultados en conclusiones y propuestas de acción.
Capacidad de organización, planificación y seguimiento de tareas.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y gestión de stakeholders, para presentar información compleja de forma clara y colaborar con perfiles de negocio y técnicos.
Nivel medio/alto de inglés.


Tus Beneficios


Disfruta de un horario flexible y trabajo híbrido que se adapta a tus necesidades. En MANGO, apostamos por la conciliación de la vida profesional y personal.
En MANGO, el fin de semana empieza el viernes a mediodía. Ofrecemos horario intensivo los viernes y vísperas de festivos.
Planifica tus vacaciones según tus preferencias. En MANGO, valoramos tu tiempo y queremos que disfrutes de cada momento.
Como parte del equipo de MANGO, tendrás descuento en todas nuestras líneas, ¡para que estés siempre a la última!
Disfrutarás de My Mango Benefits, nuestra plataforma de beneficios, desde la que podrás adaptar tu compensación a tu estilo de vida con ventajas fiscales, además de acceso a un portal de descuentos en múltiples marcas y servicios.
Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, catering y programa de guardería.
Transporte de empresa gratuito desde Barcelona y El Vallés.
En MANGO, invertimos en tu crecimiento personal y profesional. Accede a una oferta de formación variada, mentorías personalizadas, programas de desarrollo continuo y oportunidades de promoción interna que te impulsarán hacia el éxito. A nivel técnico, podrás formarte en el uso de diferentes plataformas tecnológicas, así como participar en workshops, meetups, comunidades de prácticas, team buildings y company meetings.
¡Piensa en grande! MANGO te ofrece oportunidades internacionales en más de 120 mercados para expandir tu horizonte y crecer junto con nosotros a nivel global.


En MANGO, creemos en una cultura inclusiva donde la creatividad y la innovación nos inspiran a llevar la moda más allá. Por ello, tenemos el compromiso de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades para todas las personas, valorando la autenticidad de cada individuo.

Title: Data Analyst – IA & Python
Description:
En MOBA ISE Mobile Automation, empresa especializada en soluciones de automatización industrial, buscamos un/a Data Analyst, con experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial y Python, para incorporarse al equipo de desarrollo y ayudarnos a acelerar la gestión y resolución de incidencias en MAWIS U2 mediante el uso de análisis avanzado de datos y modelos de IA.

El rol tendrá un impacto directo en la mejora del producto, la eficiencia operativa y la calidad del servicio, trabajando de forma transversal con desarrollo, soporte y producto.




Responsabilidades




Analizar datos de incidencias y uso de diferentes sensores de MAWIS U2 para detectar patrones, causas de problemas y mejoras.
Desarrollar y mantener modelos de IA / Machine Learning orientados a la detección de anomalías en sensónica, predecir desbordes en contenedores y la reducción de tiempos de resolución de problemas
Crear scripts y pipelines de datos en Python para automatizar procesos de análisis.
Trabajar con bases de datos y consultas SQL para la explotación de información operativa.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, soporte técnico y producto en la definición de mejoras.
Definir y seguir KPIs relacionados con incidencias y rendimiento del sistema.
Documentar procesos, modelos y resultados para asegurar su mantenimiento y escalabilidad




Requisitos




Dominio de programación en Python, siendo una competencia clave del puesto para el desarrollo de scripts, automatización de análisis y creación de modelos de IA.
Experiencia práctica en Inteligencia Artificial / Machine Learning en entornos reales.
Conocimientos básicos de SQL.
Experiencia analizando datos operativos y detección de incidencias
Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en un entorno técnico.
Nivel de inglés medio – alto (mínimo B2)
Experiencia en entornos industriales, automatización o software técnico.
IA aplicada a incidencias, tickets, logs o detección de anomalías.

Perfil buscado




Persona proactiva, con capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas.

Orientación a resultados y compromiso con la calidad del código.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.


Working at Tripledot


25 days paid holiday in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
Hybrid Working
20 days remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year.
Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit.

Title: Data Product Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Estamos buscando un/a Analista Senior de producto con una marcada visión de negocio y alta capacidad analítica para unirse a nuestro equipo.

Te incorporarás al equipo de Data & Insight y formarás parte del equipo de producto de InfoJobs, cuya misión es mantener la posición de líder en el mercado español búsqueda de empleo y talento.

Responsabilidades principales del puesto


Analizar e interpretar KPIs y Health Metrics de la empresa identificando tendencias, riesgos y oportunidades.
Realizar recomendaciones para optimizar y mejorar los diferentes proyectos de la empresa.
Con el equipo de Producto y de Data & Insights, participar en la identificación de puntos de mejora del site a partir de análisis de los principales indicadores del site
Seguir la competencia y el sector de Jobs y compartir los análisis con el resto de la empresa.
Gracias a estos análisis y a una colaboración con los distintos equipos, generar ideas de productos de datos y acompañar su desarrollo.
Hacer propuestas de soluciones posibles para estos productos de datos.
Gestión de los proyectos con los diferentes equipos implicados y medición del éxito.
Generar reports que permitan seguir tanto la evolución de los proyectos como para necesidades concretas o puntuales.


Requisitos de trabajo


Ser una persona proactiva, analítica, data-driven, te apasiona el mundo digital, y además necesitas trabajar en equipo.
Experiencia mínima de 2 años en eCommerce o en una empresa online. Idealmente con experiencia en marketaplaces y entornos B2B.
Acostumbrada a trabajar con equipos de producto, con data scientist y con ventas, marketing u otros stakeholders del negocio.
Experiencia en definición, implementación y medición de producto online.
Imprescindible que tengas capacidad de síntesis, sensible a la calidad del dato y orientación al cliente/usuario/stakeholder.
Capacidad analítica: saber interpretar los datos para extraer insights relevantes y ser capaz de traducir las preguntas de negocio a necesidades analíticas.
Pasión por la innovación en el mundo de los datos.


Stack tecnológico y herramientas analíticas

Se Valorará Positivamente


Habituado/a a trabajar con BBDD y experiencia y conocimiento avanzado de SQL.
Experiencia con DBT y Databricks.
Experiencia con Claude Code y Databricks Genie.
Experiencia con Python.
Habituado/a a realizar visualizaciones en dashboards con herramientas como Tableau.
Imprescindible: Usuario/a avanzado/a en herramientas de analítica (GA4, Big Query y Looker Studio).


¿Qué ofrecemos?


Seguro médico privado 100% cubierto, con amplias coberturas y reembolso de gastos médicos tanto en España como en el extranjero. Además, contarás con cobertura dental y visual.
Bienestar integral: Acceso a sesiones de psicología, recursos especializados de bienestar y asistencia profesional confidencial 24/7. También dispondrás de ayudas para actividades deportivas, fisioterapia y programas orientados a promover hábitos saludables.
Flexibilidad y conciliación: Modelo de trabajo híbrido con flexibilidad (2 dias presencial/semana), incluyendo hasta 4 semanas al año para trabajar desde cualquier lugar.
23 días de vacaciones, además de jornada intensiva durante el verano, Semana Santa y todos los viernes del año.
Beneficios flexibles: Opciones adaptadas a tus necesidades, incluyendo restaurante, transporte, guardería y otros beneficios con ventajas fiscales.
Oficina de Barcelona: Desayuno gratuito y menú de cantina a precio reducido para disfrutar de tu día a día en la oficina.

Title: Sales Performance Analyst
Description:
CELSA es el primer productor europeo de acero circular de bajas emisiones y constituye la cadena de suministro circular más grande de Europa. Recicla chatarra férrica para producir acero en hornos de arco eléctrico, usando la tecnología más sostenible y la más eficiente energéticamente.




Buscamos un perfil analítico sólido para incorporarse al área de Control Comercial y Business Performance, dando soporte directo al análisis de ventas, rentabilidad y performance del Grupo a nivel departamental, comité de dirección y consejo de administración, ubicado en nuestras oficinas centrales en Castellbisbal (Barcelona).




El rol está orientado exclusivamente a la generación de análisis estructurados, consistentes y accionables para la toma de decisiones de negocio en un entorno industrial complejo, con alto volumen de datos y múltiples fuentes de información.




Se requiere una persona con criterio analítico contrastado, elevada autonomía real en el tratamiento del dato y experiencia previa trabajando en entornos corporativos exigentes, donde la calidad del análisis es crítica para la toma de decisiones.




Tus funciones serán:




1. Análisis de performance comercial

Análisis de ventas por Unidad de Negocio (volumen, precio, mix y margen).
Seguimiento, explicación y consolidación de desviaciones vs presupuesto, forecast y cierre.
Identificación de drivers reales de evolución del negocio.
Contribución al análisis de rentabilidad y evolución del EBITDA.




2. Análisis de mercado y entorno competitivo

Recopilación, estructuración y análisis de información de mercado (precios, competencia, importaciones, share).
Elaboración de análisis comparativos entre mercados y competidores.
Identificación de cambios relevantes en el entorno competitivo y su impacto en negocio.
Transformación de datos en insights accionables para Dirección Comercial.




3. Control de actividad comercial y calidad del dato

Análisis de actividad comercial y productividad por equipo.
Control riguroso de coherencia, calidad y trazabilidad del dato en CRM y sistemas comerciales.
Identificación de inconsistencias relevantes en información comercial.
Soporte analítico a decisiones de pricing, mix y cross-selling.




4. Reporting financiero-comercial

Preparación de información para cierres mensuales comerciales.
Análisis de EBITDA, márgenes y KPIs comerciales clave.
Construcción y mantenimiento de cuadros de mando comerciales.
Asegurar consistencia total, trazabilidad y fiabilidad del dato utilizado en reporting ejecutivo.




5. Automatización, digitalización e inteligencia de datos (Advanced Analytics & AI)

Evolución y optimización de procesos de reporting y análisis con foco en eficiencia y escalabilidad.
Participación en la automatización de reporting y eliminación de tareas manuales de bajo valor.
Evolución de herramientas de Business Intelligence y modelos de datos comerciales.
Aplicación de analítica avanzada para:
detección de anomalías relevantes en ventas, precios y márgenes
identificación de patrones de comportamiento comercial con impacto en negocio
mejora de calidad de forecast mediante análisis histórico y señales de datos
Colaboración con IT en la mejora del modelo de datos, gobierno del dato y calidad de la información.




Perfil que requerimos:

Grado en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Estadística o similar.
3–5 años de experiencia real y demostrable en: control comercial, business performance / FP&A, sales analytics en entorno industrial o corporativo complejo
Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos, múltiples sistemas y fuentes heterogéneas.
Alta capacidad analítica con pensamiento estructurado y orientado a negocio (no solo reporting).
Nivel alto de Excel (uso avanzado real en análisis, no reporting básico).
Experiencia en herramientas de BI (Power BI u otras equivalentes).
Uso habitual de CRM y sistemas corporativos de reporting (SAP valorable).
Inglés alto en entorno profesional internacional.
Capacidad demostrada de trabajar con autonomía en análisis complejos sin necesidad de supervisión detallada.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Queremos que la persona que se incorpore haga carrera con nosotros, por ello, ofrecemos un contrato indefinido.
Formación continua subvencionada por la empresa.
Clases de idiomas gratuitas.
Acceso a la plataforma LinkedIn Learning.
Trabajar en una importante multinacional del sector industria.
Comedor de empresa con el 50% del coste subvencionado.
Teletrabajo 6 días/mes.
Parking en las instalaciones.
Otros beneficios sociales con ahorros fiscales: cheques gourmet, seguro de salud, formaciones...
Salario a determinar en función del perfil y experiencia de lxs candidatxs.

  • identificación de patrones de comportamiento comercial con impacto en negocio
  • mejora de calidad de forecast mediante análisis histórico y señales de datos

  • Grado en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería, Estadística o similar.
  • 3–5 años de experiencia real y demostrable en: control comercial, business performance / FP&A, sales analytics en entorno industrial o corporativo complejo
  • Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos, múltiples sistemas y fuentes heterogéneas.
  • Alta capacidad analítica con pensamiento estructurado y orientado a negocio (no solo reporting).
  • Nivel alto de Excel (uso avanzado real en análisis, no reporting básico).
  • Experiencia en herramientas de BI (Power BI u otras equivalentes).

  • Inglés alto en entorno profesional internacional.
  • Capacidad demostrada de trabajar con autonomía en análisis complejos sin necesidad de supervisión detallada.

Title: Senior Market Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Estamos buscando un/a Analista Senior de Market Intelligence con una marcada visión de negocio y alta capacidad analítica para unirse a nuestro equipo.

Tu objetivo principal será explorar, transformar e interpretar datos de mercado para generar insights de alto impacto. Diseñarás soluciones analíticas y de visual analytics enfocadas en entender la oferta, optimizar la captación de clientes y evaluar la dinámica competitiva, comunicando tus hallazgos directamente al equipo directivo (management) y a las áreas de negocio.

Tus responsabilidades


Inteligencia de mercado y análisis competitivo: Explorar y analizar de forma continuada los diferentes datos de anuncios en los marketplaces de España para identificar patrones, anomalías y oportunidades comerciales.
Visualización e insights para management: Diseñar y mantener dashboards estratégicos y cuadros de mando interactivos en Tableau. Transformar datos complejos en historias visuales claras (data storytelling) que faciliten la toma de decisiones directivas.
Analítica de captación: Liderar análisis avanzados de perfilado de empresas y optimización de recursos comerciales.
Soluciones analíticas de mercado: Desarrollar reglas y modelos analíticos para la detección de contenido duplicado o relaciones entre perfiles profesionales entre distintos portales del sector.
Modelado predictivo orientado a negocio: Aplicar técnicas estadísticas y de machine learning supervisado/no supervisado para responder preguntas de negocio específicas (predecir comportamiento de clientes, estimar demanda, etc.).
Comunicación e influencia estratégica: Traducir hallazgos técnicos en recomendaciones comerciales concretas, presentando resultados de forma clara a stakeholders no técnicos y al equipo directivo.
Criterio analítico y calidad del dato: Garantizar la fiabilidad y precisión de los análisis, aportando rigor metodológico y sabiendo alternar entre el detalle analítico y la visión macro estratégica.


Stack tecnológico y herramientas analíticas


Análisis y extracción de datos: Dominio avanzado de SQL y Python (pandas, NumPy) para la manipulación, consulta y análisis exploratorio de datos.
Business intelligence & visualización: Uso experto de Tableau Desktop y Tableau Cloud (diseño end-to-end de dashboards, desarrollo de KPIs, calculated fields, filtros avanzados).
Procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de datos (Big Data): Consultas e integración de datos a gran escala mediante PySpark sobre entorno Databricks Notebooks, datos en formato Delta Lake y almacenamiento en Amazon S3.
Analítica Avanzada y ML Aplicado: Uso práctico de scikit-learn, XGBoost y LightGBM para tareas de clasificación, regresión o clustering, apoyándote en MLflow para el seguimiento.
Procesamiento de texto (NLP Analítico): Tratamiento de texto descriptivo en anuncios (usando NLTK, spaCy o TF-IDF) para cálculo de similitudes y detección de duplicidades.
Entorno de trabajo y orquestación: Modificación y supervisión de ejecuciones analíticas en Apache Airflow, control de versiones con Git/GitHub.


Qué buscamos


Experiencia requerida: Más de 3 años de experiencia en roles de análisis de datos, business intelligence, analítica avanzada o market intelligence en entornos corporativos o digitales.
Perfil analítico y orientación a negocio: Alta capacidad para estructurar problemas complejos de negocio, extraer conclusiones accionables y medir su impacto real.
Autonomía: Capacidad para gestionar proyectos analíticos de principio a fin sin requerir supervisión constante.
Inglés: Capacidad demostrable de presentación e iteración en inglés


Beneficios


Cuidamos de ti y de tu familia


Seguro médico privado financiado al 100 % por la empresa, con una amplia cobertura y reembolso de gastos médicos tanto en España como en el extranjero. Además, incluye cobertura dental y oftalmológica.


Bienestar integral


Acceso a sesiones de apoyo psicológico, recursos especializados en bienestar y asistencia profesional confidencial las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana. También contarás con ayudas para actividades deportivas, fisioterapia y programas orientados a fomentar hábitos saludables.


Flexibilidad y conciliación


Modelo de trabajo híbrido con flexibilidad según tu puesto y equipo, que incluye la posibilidad de trabajar desde cualquier lugar durante un máximo de 4 semanas al año.


Apoyo familiar


Políticas de conciliación ampliadas que incluyen permisos parentales, permisos para el cuidado de familiares y apoyo adicional durante el embarazo. También existe la posibilidad de disfrutar de un permiso antes del nacimiento, manteniendo el 100 % del salario.


Protección económica


Cobertura del 100 % del salario durante las bajas por enfermedad, accidentes y permisos relacionados con motivos familiares. Más tiempo para ti 23 días de vacaciones al año, además de una reducción de jornada durante el verano, la Semana Santa y todos los viernes del año.


Retribución flexible


Opciones adaptadas a tus necesidades, como vales de comida, transporte, guardería y otras ventajas fiscales. Ventajas y descuentos exclusivos Acceso a ofertas y descuentos especiales en viajes, compras, ocio y otros servicios gracias a nuestros acuerdos con diferentes empresas colaboradoras.


Oficinas en Barcelona


Desayuno gratuito y menú de comedor subvencionado para que tu experiencia diaria en la oficina sea aún mejor.

Herramientas para alcanzar tus objetivos


Te proporcionaremos todo el equipamiento necesario para desempeñar tu trabajo con éxito, incluido un ordenador portátil y un teléfono móvil de empresa.

Modelo híbrido, con dos días de trabajo presencial a la semana.

Title: Workforce Insights Analyst
Description:
About Ricoh

A global leader in digital services, recognised for innovation, sustainability and a people-first culture. We feature in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, are listed in the Global 100 Most Sustainable Companies, and have been named one of Forbes’ World’s Best Employers 2025.

At Ricoh, we believe people do their best work when they feel valued and supported. We create inclusive workplaces where you can grow, contribute, and make a positive impact while helping to build a more sustainable future.

Find your place. Transform your future

Our purpose is centred on understanding and improving how people work. By focusing on real working experiences, we support individuals to develop their skills, realise their potential and do work that feels meaningful.

People Transform When They Love What They Do

This belief sits at the heart of The Ricoh Promise. It guides how we recruit, how we support our people, and how we work together every day, creating an environment where you can grow, feel valued and make a difference.

When you join us, you are encouraged to share your ideas, challenge the way things are done, and work with others to build something better. If you are looking for a place where your voice is heard, your development is supported, and your work feels meaningful, you will feel at home at Ricoh.

What you will be doing

As part of the Workforce Insights team, this role partners with the business to create and develop the core set of workforce and talent data KPIs. The primary focus is to support the business with reporting, collect and interpret data to provide actionable insights, and translate reporting requirements into KPI tracking and dashboards.


Manage, prioritise, and deliver new insight requests from the business across the EMEA region.
Collect, analyse, and interpret workforce data to provide insights and recommendations that support business decision-making and strategic planning.
Translate business reporting requirements into standardized reporting, KPI tracking, and dashboard processes.
Implement and uphold business intelligence policies, including data definitions, data quality, and analytics standards.
Provide specialist advice on the interpretation of HR data, resolving queries and clearly explaining insights to stakeholders.
Maintain and create scalable workforce data models within Microsoft Fabric to establish a structured reporting foundation.
Working across Excel, PowerBI and Microsoft Fabric to create meaningful and impactful dashboards, insights and charts as required by the business




You will ideally have

We're looking for a data-driven professional who is passionate about transforming complex workforce data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making. You will combine strong analytical skills with the ability to communicate compelling data stories to senior stakeholders across the business.

Key Skills & Experience


Proven experience in HR Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with the ability to turn complex workforce data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Power BI, including the development of robust DAX measures, dashboards, and reports that drive business performance.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including data preparation, modelling, visualisation, and workspace management.
Strong understanding of data analytics, data architecture, and reporting best practices.
Demonstrated ability to identify trends, solve complex business problems, and drive continuous process improvement through data-led solutions.
Knowledge of data modelling, systems thinking, risk analysis, and business process optimisation.
Experience working with large, multicultural organisations and engaging effectively with senior leadership teams.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence audiences at all levels.
Strong planning, prioritisation, and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing demands.
Adaptable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment undergoing change.
Exposure to programming, automation, machine learning, or AI technologies would be advantageous.


Qualifications


Ideally educated to Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or another quantitative discipline. With studies in Finance, Economics, Human Resources, or related fields also considered, providing there is also strong technical expertise in business intelligence, data modelling, and analytics.




In return for your commitment, you can expect

At Ricoh, work should feel meaningful, supportive and fulfilling. The Ricoh Promise shapes your experience through four pillars that bring our culture to life.

Love to Connect

You become part of a global community built on openness, inclusion and genuine collaboration.

Across teams, countries and roles, you'll find people who listen, involve and encourage you - helping you feel valued and able to be yourself every day.

Love to Grow

Your development truly matters to us. With access to learning pathways, mentoring and career opportunities across functions and countries, you'll be supported to stretch your skills, explore new directions and stay future-ready in a changing world.

Love to Give Back

Purpose is part of how we work. You'll have opportunities to make a difference through volunteering, sustainability initiatives and community programmes that reflect our shared values and commitment to positive impact.

Love to Succeed

Success at Ricoh is something we pursue together. You'll benefit from fair rewards, flexible working, wellbeing resources and real recognition - including programmes such as the Imagine. Change. Awards, where colleagues celebrate each other's achievements.

We are an equal opportunities employer

We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential, and we are committed to creating a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment journey, please let us know and we will support you to bring your best self forward.

Ready to love what you do? Apply now and help us shape what comes next.

Title: Senior IT Data Analyst Expert
Description:
Job description:



 

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Finance and Controlling team and bring your passion and talent to work.

 

Senior IT Data Analyst 100%

 

Barcelona, Spain

 

Your contribution

 

In this challenging and important role, you will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company’s SAP Datasphere and BW data landscape. Your responsibility is to ensure, from the definition of business requirements through to implementation and delivery, that data solutions are reliable, scalable, and aligned with business needs. You will work closely with business teams and IT to design and deliver high-quality data models, reporting solutions, and analytics capabilities.

 

The objectives and scope of the job are the following:

DataSphere and BW System ownership with administration, maintenance and development
Build, optimize, and maintain DataSphere models and reporting solutions.
Drive global reporting solutions across system landscape.
Integrate data from ERP, CRM, finance, and other systems.
Partner with business teams to design effective analytics solutions.
Analyze and visualize business data to support decisions
Create dashboards and KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and explore new BI tools.
Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance (e.g., GDPR)
Lead or support BI and digital transformation projects.
Apply strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere and SAP ERP (S/4).

 

Responsibilities

Ensure availability, quality, consistency, and compliance of company data (incl. data protection and governance).
Support the strategic development of Tecan’s data landscape across platforms
Advise management and business units on data-driven decisions.
Prioritize, implement, and monitor analysis requirements.
Create data models, ETL processes, and related standards.
Provision of technical documentation and knowledge transfer within the team.
Support cross-functional projects throughout the full lifecycle (Design, Implementation, Testing, Go-live and Hypercare).
Enforce consistent application of tools, methods, and standards in data & analytics.
Provide documentation, training, and knowledge transfer to colleagues and business users.

 ·      

Your background

 

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

Extensive experience as a BI specialist/data analyst in SAP HANA.
Strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere, SAP ERP (S/4), SAP Analytics Cloud, and ETL Tools.
Experience in data modelling, SQL Scripts and performance optimization.
Understanding of SAP S4 data structures (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP)
Excellent analytical, communication and project management skills.
Hands on experience in Project Management.
Fluent in English and Spanish; German is a plus.
Team player with a structured, independent work style.
Degree  in Business IT, data science or similar is a nice to have.
Experience with OneStream, Salesforce, TableauNext, Power BI would be a plus.

 

What makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

Working in an international and diverse environment
The chance to grow your career within the company
Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture
Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

 

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

 

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).



 



We offer:


Hybrid remote working model
Ticket restaurant
Private health insurance
30 working days of annual leave
Flexible working hours

Description:
En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con tu desarrollo profesional y valoramos tu experiencia y compromiso con la Firma, por eso queremos acompañarte para que sigas creciendo con nosotros bajo nuestro programa de Movilidad Interna.

Presentar los resultados y las estrategias definidas al equipo directivo
Capacidad de detectar necesidades de clientes en referencia a la Inteligencia Artificial y entender las posibles soluciones técnicas (valorable)
Entender el entorno tecnológico de los clientes y mantenerse al día sobre las últimas tendencias y herramientas de análisis de datos


REQUISITOS SOLICITADOS PARA EL PUESTO


Alto conocimiento técnico: Conocimientos sólidos en herramientas y técnicas de análisis de datos. Esto incluye experiencia avanzada en el uso de herramientas de SQL, Python o R. Conocimientos de herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau o Qlik. Se valorará tener nociones de Adobe Analytics o Google Analytics.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - Stumble Guys!
Description:
Are you passionate about using data to shape products played by millions of people around the world? Do you enjoy uncovering player insights, designing experiments, and influencing product decisions with data? If so, we'd love to meet you!

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to help shape the future of Stumble Guys, one of the world's leading mobile games. You'll join a team of Product Analysts and Analytics Engineers, partnering closely with Product Managers, Game Designers, Data Engineers, and Developers to turn player behavior into actionable insights.

From event instrumentation and data modeling to A/B testing and deep-dive analyses, you'll help answer our most challenging product questions and directly influence the future of the game.

If you're excited about working on a game played by millions of daily active users (just ask your younger cousins - they're probably already playing!), we'd love to hear from you!

We also work with a modern analytics stack including Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker and Hex.

What You Will Do


Analyze large and complex datasets to understand the behavior of millions of players and answer strategic product questions.
Partner closely with Product, Game Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Leadership to drive data-informed decisions.
Design, analyze, and communicate A/B tests to evaluate new features and optimize player experiences.
Develop frameworks, dashboards, and analytical tools that empower teams to make better product decisions.
Generate actionable insights that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and overall game performance.
Define and validate event tracking to ensure high-quality product analytics.
Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership


What We're Looking For


Significant experience working as a Product Analyst, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or other consumer digital products.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Experience with experimentation (A/B testing), product analytics, and statistical analysis.
Intellectual curiosity with a passion for solving complex business problems through data.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills—you can translate complex analyses into clear recommendations.
Python or R experience is a plus.
Fluent English, written and spoken.


Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Title: Lead Data Analyst | €61K - €75K
Description:
One of the companies we work with at Joppy is looking for a Lead Data Analyst / Marketing (SEM) to join the team.




Working arrangement: HYBRID in Barcelona (2 days a week in the office).




Join Marketing Analytics as a senior individual contributor focused on Search Engine Marketing (SEM) to lead paid search analytics for Rover globally. You'll shape how we measure and optimize acquisition across our growing portfolio of brands and markets.




As a key thought partner for SEM leaders, Finance, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering, you'll set the analytical agenda and stay hands-on with the analysis. A central question: when our brands compete for the same searches, how do we know if we have grown the business as a whole?




This role is based in our Barcelona office in Poblenou, with two office days per week (Mondays and Thursdays). You must be based in Barcelona or be willing to relocate.




Your impact




Guide bidding and investment across brands. Evaluate spend allocation, marginal returns, customer lifetime value (LTV), and payback. Help SEM teams assess cross-brand cannibalization and identify where additional spend generates incremental growth.
Lead experimentation and incrementality. Design and analyze channel tests, geo-split experiments, and multibrand tests. Choose appropriate methods, assess statistical power and uncertainty, and turn results into recommendations on bidding and spend.
Explain performance and identify opportunities. Diagnose changes in acquisition cost, conversion, and return on ad spend (ROAS). Translate auction dynamics, customer behavior, and marketplace conditions into clear recommendations that lead to action.
Strengthen attribution and reporting. Reconcile platform and internal measurement, distinguish attributed results from incremental growth, and build trusted dashboards. Partner with engineering and Data Science on data quality, conversion signals, and customer-value inputs.
Own the SEM analytics roadmap. Identify important questions, challenge assumptions, and prioritize by business impact. Build learning agendas for different markets and lead stakeholders toward decisions grounded in evidence and clear trade-offs.
Raise the team's analytical standards. Mentor analysts, review SQL and analytical methods, and develop reusable tools and documentation. Balance statistical rigor with business needs.




Your qualifications




6+ years of analytics experience, with a track record of turning complex analysis into business decisions and measurable outcomes.
Advanced SQL and strong statistical analysis skills in Python or R, including reviewing others' code and collaborating with engineering on data models.
Proven experimental design and A/B testing experience, including applying causal inference or geo-based methods and explaining their limitations.
Experience independently leading large analytical initiatives, managing stakeholder expectations and timelines, and influencing strategy across functions.
Clear communicator with technical and non-technical audiences, who is able to shape compelling data narratives through analysis and data visualization.




Nice to have




Strong understanding of marketing attribution and acquisition economics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), LTV, ROAS, and payback.
Experience with multibrand businesses, international markets, or a two-sided marketplace.
Experience with marketing mix modeling (MMM), customer LTV modeling, or transformation tools such as dbt.
Experience using AI tooling to move faster on routine work and to check your own reasoning. You can also explain and defend every line of analysis you ship.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you, even if you don't bring every nice-to-have.




Benefits




Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office

Title: Sales Force Effectiveness Professional
Place: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Sales Effectiveness Analyst (CRM Support), you will serve as a core technical analytics and field enablement resource within the Commercial Excellence subchapter. Reporting hierarchically to the Commercial Excellence Lead and receiving functional direction from the Sales Effectiveness Specialist, your mission will be to build interactive BI dashboards, perform data quality audits, generate standard performance reports, and deliver hands-on CRM sales support to enable field excellence.

Your Main Responsibilities

BI Dashboard Engineering & Maintenance: Design, build, publish, and maintain interactive commercial analytics dashboards (Power BI / Salesforce) tracking sales performance, pipeline metrics, and conversion rates
Data Quality Auditing & Error Controls: Execute routine data audits and validation checks across commercial data sets to detect anomalies and enforce data entry rules (Calidad e Integridad de la Información)
Operational CRM Sales Support & Field Enablement: Provide direct operational and workflow support to field sales representatives, assisting with opportunity tracking, account updates, and CRM query resolution
Standard Commercial Reporting: Generate, format, and distribute standard weekly and monthly sales reports for Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Customer Service
Process Mapping & Documentation Support: Assist the Senior Specialist in mapping commercial workflows between Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and Finance, while documenting standard operating procedures
Pipeline & Activity Analytics: Analyze lead-to-opportunity conversion rates, activity volume, and customer engagement metrics to highlight key trends and insights



Who You Are

Education: University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field
Experience: 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in data analytics, commercial reporting, business intelligence, or sales operations
Technical Expertise: Proficient with BI visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau), advanced Excel / data modeling, and familiar with CRM platforms (Salesforce)
Core Competencies: Strong numerical acumen, rigorous attention to detail, customer-service orientation, and a collaborative mindset
Languages: Fluent in both Spanish and English



What Is Here For You

Impactful Work: Contribute directly to commercial decision-making and field success within a global leader in healthcare and diagnostics
Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning, cross-functional collaboration (across Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and Finance), and career advancement within Commercial Excellence
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a supportive team dedicated to innovation, high standards, and empowering healthcare solutions


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Online Marketing Principal Analyst - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Online Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Online Marketing Data Analyst team in Barcelona to solve complex measurement challenges and drive meaningful business outcomes. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Online Marketing Analytics Manager in the Online Marketing Data Analyst team you will be in charge of:


Partner with media stakeholders to understand business objectives and identify where measurement or deeper analysis can improve decision-making.
Independently lead end-to-end analytical projects, from translating business problems into structured analytical approaches through analysis execution, insight generation and stakeholder communication.
Present evidence-based recommendations, clearly articulating expected business benefits, trade-offs, risks and limitations, and drive their adoption across the business.
Proactively identify and propose new analytical projects, experiments and optimisation initiatives that improve business performance.
Overseeing the design of a cross-platform test-and-learn agenda and supporting its implementation.
Develop measurement plans and analytical frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing investments.
Work closely with Data Engineering to continuously improve the marketing data landscape by identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, reliability and completeness, and enable new reporting views, datasets and data sources.
Collaborate with the Tracking and Data Activation teams to strengthen the quality, availability and usability of marketing data across platforms.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


At least 8 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, ideally within a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
Strong SQL skills, including writing efficient, complex queries across large datasets.
Strong Python skills for data processing, analysis, automation and data visualisation.
Experience designing and conducting complex analytical projects from problem definition through to business recommendation.
Strong analytics knowledge, with the ability to select and apply appropriate analytical methodologies to different business questions.
Experience with experimentation and causal measurement techniques such as A/B testing, incrementality measurement, causal inference or quasi-experimental methods.

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Title: Senior Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Senior Fraud Data Analyst, you'll handle one of the most critical challenges in digital payments: keeping millions of transactions safe in real time.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimising the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimise the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalise machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyse security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Who We're Looking For

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.


Experience – You have at least 6 years’ experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.


Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:


❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth

Title: Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Senior Supply Chain Data Analyst, you work on global transformation and optimizing projects in Supply Chain. You contribute to successful project outcomes by focusing on the end-to-end data roadmap, from data querying and data quality review to data analysis, dashboarding, data modelling and communication with client business and IT teams.

In This Role You Will


Support master data management and data governance activities, including data preparation, validation, documentation and stakeholder alignment.
Query, analyse and model supply chain data, and review data quality across large datasets.
Support data architecture and integration between ERP, APS and reporting environments, including data migration, data factories and data warehousing.
Create dashboards and analyses that translate data into business insights.
Work closely with project teams, client business and IT teams, and support workshops to gather data requirements and promote best practices.


Job Requirements

About you


3+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics, data consulting or a related field, preferably working with large datasets from ERP or APS systems. Experience with OMP, Kinaxis or S/4HANA is a plus.
You have good proficiency in data querying, analysis and dashboard creation using tools such as MS Excel, PowerQuery, SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Looker or QlikView.
You are familiar with master data management, data governance best practices, data factories, data architecture and integration.
You have strong problem-solving skills, an analytical mindset and an understanding of the business and customer context.
You have persuasive communication skills, are comfortable working with clients and can prioritize workload and communicate progress in a fast-paced international environment.
You like to learn and develop, are curious about how AI can improve data quality and integration, and are willing to stay hands-on with traditional master data work.
You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, are fluent in English and are willing to travel globally and work in a hybrid setup from Barcelona. Spanish is a plus.
You feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together move fast and be kind!


Why join us?


You join a company built around supply chain transformation rather than broad, generalist consulting.
You become part of our supply chain data community, with different growth paths depending on what you want to deepen: data analysis, data quality, data modelling, data architecture, dashboarding, or people and process focused work.
You work on international supply chain projects where you do not only analyse data, but also help structure, cleanse, model, integrate and visualize it.
You leverage your expertise in a pioneering role, with the full support of our international team of supply chain and data experts to drive Barcelona’s success.
You are part of a global network spanning Belgium, the USA, Switzerland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Australia and Singapore, working on impactful international projects.
You have opportunities to travel to client sites, making your work truly international and engaging across borders.
You work on data that directly supports supply chain decisions, transformation projects and the successful implementation of planning solutions.
You work in a flexible and hybrid environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
You benefit from a competitive salary package.


About us

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

Within the Supply Chain Plan business unit, we have built up specific expertise in three main areas: Life sciences/pharma, CPG&CH and Chemicals&Industries. In these industries, we support a range of global leaders in their E2E planning transformation journey such as Bayer, Johnson&Johnson, BASF and Bridgestone.

During these E2E supply chain planning transformations, our experts support our customers in every step of their journey. We partner up to define a vision and review the operating model to create a strong and agile basis for the future.

The Plan business unit designs & implements our customers’ business transformation by defining the future organizational operating model, designing new ways of working & solutions advanced planning systems (APS), feeding their data factory, accelerating their setup towards agile S&OP or guiding them through their end-to-end supply chain planning. We do not work for them but rather with them, and we stand by their side the entire time. That is the only way to make changes stick and flourish.

Title: BUSINESS DATA ANALYST - GLOBAL DISTRIBUTION
Description:
En MANGO vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. Nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo.

Tu Nuevo Puesto

Tu objetivo será contribuir a la mejora de la distribución comercial y la gestión de stocks a través del análisis de datos y la participación en proyectos transversales. Trabajarás con los equipos de negocio, técnicos y de sistemas para identificar oportunidades, convertirlas en propuestas concretas y acompañar su implementación y seguimiento.
