Extraer, preparar y cruzar datos de distintas fuentes con autonomía, asegurando la calidad y consistencia de la información utilizada en los análisis.
Desarrollar y mantener indicadores, dashboards y herramientas de análisis que faciliten el seguimiento del negocio y la toma de decisiones.
Analizar el comportamiento de las ventas, los stocks y la distribución, y elaborar modelos analíticos y escenarios que permitan identificar oportunidades, priorizar iniciativas y evaluar su impacto.
Participar en la definición y revisión de criterios y reglas de negocio para mejorar la asignación de producto, la reposición y la gestión del inventario.
Participar en la gestión y seguimiento de proyectos transversales del área. Acompañar la implementación de mejoras y realizar el seguimiento de sus resultados mediante los indicadores definidos, contrastando el impacto real con los objetivos previstos.
Traducir las necesidades de negocio en requerimientos claros para los equipos técnicos y de sistemas, colaborando en la validación de las soluciones desarrolladas.
Preparar presentaciones, conclusiones y recomendaciones que comuniquen de forma clara los resultados de los análisis.
Contribuir a la mejora continua de procesos, herramientas y automatizaciones.


Sobre Ti


Formación en Ingeniería, ADE, Estadística, Economía u otras disciplinas con una sólida base cuantitativa y analítica.
+/- 4 años de experiencia en roles analíticos con exposición a negocio, preferiblemente en entornos de retail, distribución o gestión de stocks.
Dominio de SQL y capacidad para trabajar con autonomía en la extracción, transformación y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos, en entornos como Databricks.
Nivel avanzado de Excel. Se valorará experiencia con herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Looker.
Conocimiento práctico de Python valorable.
Capacidad para interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio y convertir los resultados en conclusiones y propuestas de acción.
Capacidad de organización, planificación y seguimiento de tareas.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y gestión de stakeholders, para presentar información compleja de forma clara y colaborar con perfiles de negocio y técnicos.
Nivel medio/alto de inglés.


Tus Beneficios


Disfruta de un horario flexible y trabajo híbrido que se adapta a tus necesidades. En MANGO, apostamos por la conciliación de la vida profesional y personal.
En MANGO, el fin de semana empieza el viernes a mediodía. Ofrecemos horario intensivo los viernes y vísperas de festivos.
Planifica tus vacaciones según tus preferencias. En MANGO, valoramos tu tiempo y queremos que disfrutes de cada momento.
Como parte del equipo de MANGO, tendrás descuento en todas nuestras líneas, ¡para que estés siempre a la última!
Disfrutarás de My Mango Benefits, nuestra plataforma de beneficios, desde la que podrás adaptar tu compensación a tu estilo de vida con ventajas fiscales, además de acceso a un portal de descuentos en múltiples marcas y servicios.
Paquete de retribución flexible con ventajas fiscales: seguro médico, formación, catering y programa de guardería.

Data Management & Engineering


Data modeling and semantic layer development.

Title: Lead Data Analyst | €61K - €75K
Description:
One of the companies we work with at Joppy is looking for a Lead Data Analyst / Marketing (SEM) to join the team.




Working arrangement: HYBRID in Barcelona (2 days a week in the office).




Join Marketing Analytics as a senior individual contributor focused on Search Engine Marketing (SEM) to lead paid search analytics for Rover globally. You'll shape how we measure and optimize acquisition across our growing portfolio of brands and markets.




As a key thought partner for SEM leaders, Finance, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering, you'll set the analytical agenda and stay hands-on with the analysis. A central question: when our brands compete for the same searches, how do we know if we have grown the business as a whole?




This role is based in our Barcelona office in Poblenou, with two office days per week (Mondays and Thursdays). You must be based in Barcelona or be willing to relocate.




Your impact




Guide bidding and investment across brands. Evaluate spend allocation, marginal returns, customer lifetime value (LTV), and payback. Help SEM teams assess cross-brand cannibalization and identify where additional spend generates incremental growth.
Lead experimentation and incrementality. Design and analyze channel tests, geo-split experiments, and multibrand tests. Choose appropriate methods, assess statistical power and uncertainty, and turn results into recommendations on bidding and spend.
Explain performance and identify opportunities. Diagnose changes in acquisition cost, conversion, and return on ad spend (ROAS). Translate auction dynamics, customer behavior, and marketplace conditions into clear recommendations that lead to action.
Strengthen attribution and reporting. Reconcile platform and internal measurement, distinguish attributed results from incremental growth, and build trusted dashboards. Partner with engineering and Data Science on data quality, conversion signals, and customer-value inputs.
Own the SEM analytics roadmap. Identify important questions, challenge assumptions, and prioritize by business impact. Build learning agendas for different markets and lead stakeholders toward decisions grounded in evidence and clear trade-offs.
Raise the team's analytical standards. Mentor analysts, review SQL and analytical methods, and develop reusable tools and documentation. Balance statistical rigor with business needs.




Your qualifications




6+ years of analytics experience, with a track record of turning complex analysis into business decisions and measurable outcomes.
Advanced SQL and strong statistical analysis skills in Python or R, including reviewing others' code and collaborating with engineering on data models.
Proven experimental design and A/B testing experience, including applying causal inference or geo-based methods and explaining their limitations.
Experience independently leading large analytical initiatives, managing stakeholder expectations and timelines, and influencing strategy across functions.
Clear communicator with technical and non-technical audiences, who is able to shape compelling data narratives through analysis and data visualization.




Nice to have




Strong understanding of marketing attribution and acquisition economics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC), LTV, ROAS, and payback.
Experience with multibrand businesses, international markets, or a two-sided marketplace.

Working arrangement: HYBRID in Barcelona (2 days a week in the office).


Join Marketing Analytics as a senior individual contributor focused on Search Engine Marketing (SEM) to lead paid search analytics for Rover globally. You'll shape how we measure and optimize acquisition across our growing portfolio of brands and markets.


As a key thought partner for SEM leaders, Finance, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering, you'll set the analytical agenda and stay hands-on with the analysis. A central question: when our brands compete for the same searches, how do we know if we have grown the business as a whole?


This role is based in our Barcelona office in Poblenou, with two office days per week (Mondays and Thursdays). You must be based in Barcelona or be willing to relocate.


Your impact


  • Guide bidding and investment across brands. Evaluate spend allocation, marginal returns, customer lifetime value (LTV), and payback. Help SEM teams assess cross-brand cannibalization and identify where additional spend generates incremental growth.

Title: Fraud Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay

Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content.

Role Overview

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based.

Key Responsibilities


Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.
Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time.
Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process.
Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help.


Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team.
Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve.
The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls.


Working at Tripledot


25 days paid holiday in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year
Hybrid Working
20 days remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year.
Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit.
Private Medical Cover: Have peace of mind with private medical cover, ensuring your health is in good hands.
Life & Critical Illness Cover: Protect your future with our life and critical illness cover.
Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy]
Employee Assistance Program: Access confidential support anytime through our Employee Assistance Program.
Sport Compensation: Stay fit and active with our sport compensation benefit.
Meal and Transport Vouchers: Save on meals and transport with our convenient vouchers.
English & Spanish Classes: Enhance your English and Spanish skills with our provided language classes.
Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development.

Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Sales Effectiveness Analyst (CRM Support), you will serve as a core technical analytics and field enablement resource within the Commercial Excellence subchapter. Reporting hierarchically to the Commercial Excellence Lead and receiving functional direction from the Sales Effectiveness Specialist, your mission will be to build interactive BI dashboards, perform data quality audits, generate standard performance reports, and deliver hands-on CRM sales support to enable field excellence.

Your Main Responsibilities

BI Dashboard Engineering & Maintenance: Design, build, publish, and maintain interactive commercial analytics dashboards (Power BI / Salesforce) tracking sales performance, pipeline metrics, and conversion rates
Data Quality Auditing & Error Controls: Execute routine data audits and validation checks across commercial data sets to detect anomalies and enforce data entry rules (Calidad e Integridad de la Información)
Operational CRM Sales Support & Field Enablement: Provide direct operational and workflow support to field sales representatives, assisting with opportunity tracking, account updates, and CRM query resolution
Standard Commercial Reporting: Generate, format, and distribute standard weekly and monthly sales reports for Sales Leadership, Marketing, and Customer Service
Process Mapping & Documentation Support: Assist the Senior Specialist in mapping commercial workflows between Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and Finance, while documenting standard operating procedures
Pipeline & Activity Analytics: Analyze lead-to-opportunity conversion rates, activity volume, and customer engagement metrics to highlight key trends and insights



Who You Are

Education: University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field
Experience: 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in data analytics, commercial reporting, business intelligence, or sales operations
Technical Expertise: Proficient with BI visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau), advanced Excel / data modeling, and familiar with CRM platforms (Salesforce)
Core Competencies: Strong numerical acumen, rigorous attention to detail, customer-service orientation, and a collaborative mindset
Languages: Fluent in both Spanish and English



What Is Here For You

Impactful Work: Contribute directly to commercial decision-making and field success within a global leader in healthcare and diagnostics
Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning, cross-functional collaboration (across Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and Finance), and career advancement within Commercial Excellence
Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a supportive team dedicated to innovation, high standards, and empowering healthcare solutions


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Analizar información cuantitativa y cualitativa de sostenibilidad, identificando inconsistencias, riesgos y oportunidades de mejora.

Valorable conocimiento de herramientas de cálculo de huella, gestión de datos ESG o plataformas de reporting.

Modelo de trabajo híbrido, con flexibilidad según proyecto y equipo.

Entorno dinámico, colaborativo e inclusivo.

Title: BI Expert
Description:
We are currently looking for a Power BI Expert/Developer to join one of our key global clients based in Barcelona. The selected candidate will join the Digital Markets & Analytics team, partnering with business and technical stakeholders to deliver data-driven insights, reporting solutions, and analytical support across the organization.

This is an excellent opportunity to work in a highly international environment where data plays a key role in business decision-making.



Project Environment




This is a highly collaborative role combining data analysis, dashboard development, and stakeholder engagement to support business decision-making within a fast-paced digital environment.



Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards using multiple data sources.
Write advanced SQL queries to support reporting and business analysis.
Analyze complex datasets and deliver clear, actionable insights.
Create reports and dashboards to monitor KPIs and business performance.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements.
Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and performance drivers.
Ensure data quality and address gaps or inconsistencies in reporting.
Translate analytical findings into recommendations for business teams.


Required Skills


4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or similar roles.
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI, including dashboard development and data visualization.
Advanced SQL skills (PostgreSQL experience is highly desirable).
Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Experience working with large-volume datasets and KPI reporting.
Proven ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent English.


Nice to Have


Experience with web analytics and digital performance metrics.
Background in technology, software, internet, or digital businesses.
Experience with data governance, data quality, and reporting best practices.
Consulting or stakeholder-facing analytics experience.
Experience influencing decision-making through data-driven insights.
Role Title: Power BI Expert
Location: Barcelona (Hybrid, 2 days per week onsite)
Start Date: ASAP
Duration: Until the end of January 2027 + possible extension
Workload: 40 hours/week


If you're interested or know someone who could be a great fit, feel free to reach out.

Title: ANALISTA DE CIBERSEGURIDAD PARA PREVENCIÓN DEL FRAUDE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

En CyberSecurity Analytics somos responsables de definir, gobernar y controlar el ecosistema de prevención de ciberfraude. Nuestra misión es identificar, mediante decisiones data-driven, nuevas amenazas, tendencias y vectores de ataque para diseñar controles que protejan al negocio, a nuestros empleados y a nuestros clientes.

Trabajamos sobre un alcance omnicanal que cubre todo el ciclo de vida de empleados y clientes, analizando grandes volúmenes de información procedentes de canales digitales, aplicaciones, sistemas corporativos y plataformas de ciberseguridad. Participarás en iniciativas de detección de fraude, prevención de ataques, monitorización de controles, análisis de riesgo y mejora continua de los modelos analíticos utilizados por la entidad.

Requisitos mínimos
Experiencia en análisis y explotación de datos mediante herramientas analíticas corporativas (Datapool, DataNow o equivalentes).
Conocimientos de SQL y tratamiento de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Capacidad para analizar y correlar información procedente de fuentes heterogéneas: logs de negocio, logs de ciberseguridad y datos de terceros.
Experiencia en elaboración de análisis, indicadores y casos de uso basados en datos.
Capacidad para traducir hallazgos analíticos en requerimientos funcionales para la implantación de nuevos controles o mejoras tecnológicas.
Se valorarán conocimientos en ciberseguridad, prevención de fraude, gestión del riesgo o analítica avanzada.
¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

Title: Data Analyst Looker
Description:
¡Hola! 🙋




¿Todavía no conoces hiberus? Somos una empresa de #tecnología construida con un ingrediente diferencial, la HIPERESPECIALIZACIÓN.




Formar parte de hiberus significa crecimiento, pasión por la tecnología, interés por la innovación, ambiente laboral flexible y colaborativo, compañerismo, aprendizaje, formación continua, motivación y superación ante nuevos retos... y esto es solo el principio.




Contamos con un equipo de más de 4.500 profesionales, 46 áreas de especialización y 35 hubs de desarrollo en España, Europa, Latinoamérica, Estados Unidos y África. Somos la primera empresa tecnológica española de capital privado. En los últimos cuatro años, hemos experimentado un crecimiento exponencial, duplicando nuestro volumen de negocio año tras año. Esto nos ha permitido consolidarnos como un actor clave en el ecosistema tecnológico español y mantenernos competitivos frente a los líderes internacionales ¡Estamos redefiniendo el mapa tecnológico mundial! 🌐💻




Trabajamos muy duro, para transformar nuestra vida a través de la tecnología y queremos contar contigo para seguir creciendo. Si lo tuyo es el mundo IT, te gusta estar al día en las últimas tecnologías y quieres asumir un nuevo reto profesional ¡Sigue leyendo, te estamos buscando!




🔎¿Qué estamos buscando?

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst Senior con experiencia en Looker y Power BI, capaz de transformar necesidades de negocio en modelos analíticos, métricas y cuadros de mando de alto impacto. Queremos una persona con una sólida base en modelado de datos, orientación al cliente y capacidad para convertir información compleja en insights accionables para la toma de decisiones.

Buscamos una persona que nos ayude a seguir creciendo, con ganas de aportar y seguir evolucionando de la mano de los mejores profesionales, pero, sobre todo... ¡en hiberus buscamos buena gente! 😉




💻Algunas de tus funciones

Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos analíticos orientados a negocio.
Definir métricas, KPIs y estructuras de reporting junto a equipos de negocio.
Desarrollar, evolucionar y optimizar dashboards en Looker y Power BI.
Traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones analíticas escalables.
Participar en la recogida de requisitos, validación funcional y presentación de resultados a clientes.
Analizar datos y generar insights que aporten valor real al negocio.
Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Arquitectura y Negocio para garantizar la calidad y consistencia del dato.
Proponer mejoras funcionales, analíticas y técnicas de manera proactiva.
Utilizar herramientas de IA para acelerar procesos de desarrollo y análisis.




💻💪🏻Habilidades y requisitos

Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años como Data Analyst o roles similares.
Experiencia demostrable en modelado de datos (dimensional, analítico o reporting).

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Power BI, incluyendo:

Diseño de dashboards.
Modelado semántico.
Definición de KPIs y métricas.
Desarrollo con DAX.

Al menos 1 año de experiencia con Looker, incluyendo:

Desarrollo y mantenimiento de modelos en LookML.
Creación de Explores y vistas.
Desarrollo de cuadros de mando y reporting.
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL para explotación y análisis de datos.
Experiencia trabajando directamente con clientes y stakeholders de negocio.
Capacidad para comunicar resultados y presentar soluciones analíticas.
Perfil autónomo, proactivo y orientado a la resolución de problemas.
Capacidad analítica y pensamiento estructurado.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.




🙌¿Qué te ofrecemos?

💼 Contrato indefinido en una compañía puramente tecnológica, que forma parte de un gran grupo, solvente y en crecimiento.

💰 Salario fijo competitivo

🏖️ Ambiente familiar, cercano, ¡como una gran familia!

Title: Analista de Datos
Place: Santa Cruz de Bezana, Cantabria, Spain
Description:
En LISDATA transformamos datos en conocimiento útil para las empresas. Somos una ingeniería especializada en analítica avanzada, Industria 4.0, Big Data e Inteligencia Artificial, y trabajamos codo con codo con nuestros clientes para impulsar la evolución de su negocio.




Creemos que los mejores resultados llegan cuando las personas están en el centro. Por eso fomentamos un entorno cercano, donde el talento, el bienestar y el crecimiento profesional son una prioridad, algo que nos valió el Premio a la Calidad en el Empleo en Cantabria en 2022.




Buscamos incorporar Analistas de Datos con curiosidad, visión de negocio y ganas de seguir aprendiendo. Formarás parte de nuestro equipo ubicado en Cantabria, donde participarás en proyectos a medida de análisis de datos e Inteligencia Artificial.




¿Qué harás en LIS?




Colaborarás con el equipo de proyectos y con cliente para entender sus necesidades y traducirlas en preguntas que los datos puedan responder.
Extraerás, depurarás y prepararás datos de distintas fuentes mediante SQL y Python.
Realizarás análisis exploratorios y estadísticos para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.
Diseñarás y desarrollarás dashboards e informes que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Definirás y harás seguimiento de indicadores clave (KPIs) de los proyectos.
Comunicarás los resultados de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.




¿Qué valoramos de ti?




Imprescindible:

Conocimientos de SQL en bases de datos como SQL Server o PostgreSQL.
Programación en Python para análisis de datos (NumPy, Pandas) y visualización (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Qlik Sense o Tableau.




Valorable:

Conocimientos de bases de datos NoSQL (MongoDB).
Experiencia en el tratamiento de datos en cloud con Azure (Blob Storage, Synapse), PySpark y Databricks.
Conocimientos de Data Mining y Machine Learning con librerías como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow o PyTorch, y Azure ML.
Conocimientos de Java/Spring o FastAPI.
Familiaridad con Git u otros sistemas de control de versiones.
Proactividad, compromiso y capacidad de resolución de problemas.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo, también en entornos con cliente.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




Plan de carrera personalizado, orientado a tu desarrollo profesional.
Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Flexibilidad horaria.
23 días hábiles de vacaciones.
Jornada intensiva los viernes, en verano y durante la Navidad.
Gimnasio gratuito.




Si te gusta hacer las preguntas correctas y encontrar las respuestas en los datos, en LIS tienes mucho por descubrir. ¡Te esperamos!

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

What you'll do


Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.


Who you are


Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
You're fluent in SQL and Python.
You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.


🤝 What we offer

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🍱 Healthy meals: No more boring tupperware – enjoy daily meals with Nora Foods. We cover 50% of each order!

💳 Cobee card: Flexible compensation for transport and restaurants, so you can make the most of your net salary.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office in Poblenou, surrounded by a thriving tech scene, and 2 days of remote work. But if there’s one thing that defines us, it’s flexibility: we trust you to organize your time and space in the way that helps you do your best work.

Our Process

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
Fundada hace 16 años por Stanford Alumni, Bravo se ha convertido en un actor destacado en el panorama financiero, ofreciendo soluciones crediticias a consumidores sobreapalancados que se encuentran en dificultades. Tenemos operaciones en seis países diversos: México, Colombia, España, Italia, Portugal y Brasil. Nuestro viaje se define por un compromiso incesante de capacitar a las personas para que paguen sus deudas y recuperen la libertad financiera.




Nuestro compromiso con la excelencia y el trabajo duro nos ha llevado a un historial de crecimiento sostenido de dos dígitos durante la última década, posicionándonos como líderes en la industria. A partir de 2023, gestionamos más de 600 millones de euros de deuda de clientes, brindando a las personas la orientación que necesitan para pagar sus deudas de manera efectiva. Seguimos estableciendo objetivos ambiciosos para el futuro mientras buscamos crecer más de 3 veces en los próximos cinco años ampliando nuestros mercados actuales y expandiéndonos a otras geografías.




¿A quién buscamos?




Queremos gente apasionada por los datos, los nuevos retos y que disfrute resolviendo problemas complejos de negocio. Buscamos personas curiosas, organizadas, atentas al detalle, proactivas y con alta tolerancia a la frustración, capaces de hablar tanto con el equipo técnico como con la dirección.

Formación: Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería (Industrial, Informática, Telecomunicaciones), Economía o carreras afines con fuerte base cuantitativa.
Herramientas clave: Dominio de SQL y fundamentos de programación en Python o R. Soltura en herramientas de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similares) y un uso avanzado de Excel.
Mindset: Interés genuino en aprender sobre modelado estadístico, Machine Learning y automatización de flujos de trabajo.




La experiencia previa es valorable, pero no indispensable. ¡Lo que más nos importa es tu curiosidad analítica y que nos muestres lo que sabes hacer (proyectos propios, GitHub, competiciones de Kaggle o tu TFG)!




¿Qué harás?




Extracción y limpieza de datos (ETL): Recopilarás, estructurarás y validarás la calidad de la información comercial proveniente de distintas fuentes para prepararla para su análisis.
Análisis Exploratorio: Buscarás patrones, correlaciones y tendencias ocultas en los datos para responder a preguntas estratégicas del negocio (ej. ¿por qué un producto funciona mejor en una zona que en otra?).
Data Storytelling: Traducirás modelos y análisis complejos en conclusiones visuales, claras y accionables para la Gerencia y Dirección.
Ecosistema de BI: Diseñarás, automatizarás y mantendrás vivos los dashboards de control del área, garantizando que el dato sea único y fiable.
Innovación analítica: Propondrás mejoras en los procesos de reporting y lanzarás pequeñas pruebas de concepto de analítica avanzada (ej. modelos de segmentación de clientes o predicción de ventas).




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Nuestro horario es de L-V de 10.00 a 19.00 y estamos ubicados en una de las mejores zonas de Madrid (Calle Velázquez) para que disfrutes también de todo lo que ofrece el barrio (tiendas, cafeterías, restaurantes, bares...).




Tendrás un contrato indefinido a tiempo completo y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro del equipo.




Al incorporarte a nuestra empresa optarás a grandes beneficios como acceso a Wellhub, disponer inmediatamente del salario generado a través de Payflow y descuentos con otras de nuestras empresas partners en alimentación, formación, descuentos en compras, etc.




Adicionalmente podrás disfrutar del día a día de nuestro ambiente joven, multicultural y dinámico en el que aprender y crecer en tu camino profesional. También contarás con una formación especializada para enseñarte todo lo que necesitas para el puesto de trabajo, y además nos encantará que te apuntes a todas nuestras actividades como los famosos afterwork, equipo de fútbol, celebración de fiestas y eventos en la ofi o incluso las que tú quieras implementar!




¡En Bravo estamos emocionados de recibir tu candidatura y descubrir cómo puedes contribuir a nuestro crecimiento!

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Customer Success Operations)
Description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Customer Success organisation serves hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals across 13 markets. Two global business lines sit at the centre of that effort, Individual Doctors and Clinics, each led by a VP who needs sharp, reliable analytics to grow their business and make decisions with confidence.

This role sits within Global Customer Success Operations & Analytics, the team that acts as the connective layer between the business and Docplanner's data organisation: BI (dashboard and data standardisation), Data Platform (infrastructure, architecture, DWH), and Product Analytics (product launches and opportunities).

This role is dedicated to one business line, partnering closely with that VP and their leadership team on the deep dives, data models, dashboards, and experiments needed to run and grow the business across our 13 markets.

You'll report to the Global CS Ops analytics manager, who sets the team's priorities and supports big projects the team takes on. Within that frame, you own how your own time is spent day to day, prioritizing incoming asks, sequencing your backlog, and deciding what needs your manager's input versus what you can resolve directly with your business and data stakeholders.

How will you make an impact?

Reporting, dashboards & data models


Build and maintain the recurring reporting, dashboards (Tableau, superset), and data models your business line runs on
Build and maintain automations that scale across markets
Keep outputs consistent with BI's dashboard and data standards, escalating gaps rather than working around them


Analytical models: statistics & prediction (a growing focus)


Today, most of your time goes to reporting and execution. Over the next year, we expect a meaningful shift toward analytical modelling (statistics and prediction)
Review, update, and improve the statistical and predictive models your business line already relies on
Build MVPs for new predictive or statistical use cases, handing them off to Data Science once validated
Bring regression, forecasting, and other statistical techniques into your day-to-day analysis, not just descriptive reporting


AI-first execution


Work AI-first: use AI to query, code, and analyse faster and more consistently
Use and contribute to the team's shared libraries, reusable code, and architecture (e.g. GitHub-based repositories)


Bridging business and data teams


Act as the translation layer between your business line and Docplanner's data organisation: BI, Data Platform, and Product Analytics
Bring the right requirements to each team, and flag when scope or timelines don't match business priority


Driving analytics for your business line


Partner directly with the VP of your assigned business line and their team to understand the business, identify gaps, and surface opportunities
Lead deep dives that go beyond describing what happened to explain why, and what do next
Propose, run, and analyse experiments (A/B tests and beyond) that inform business decisions


Prioritisation & stakeholder alignment


Own the day-to-day sequencing of your own workload: triage incoming requests, judge urgency and impact, and decide what to tackle first without waiting to be told
Align directly with assigned business and data stakeholders on what matters and when
Escalate cross-team or resourcing trade-offs to your manager, who owns prioritisation of the team's big projects


Qualifications

What will help you thrive?


Degree in a quantitative field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar)
+3-5 years of relevant analytics experience as an individual contributor
Very good SQL skills (Amazon Redshift preferred); solid Python, especially for statistical and predictive modelling
Working knowledge of statistical modelling (regression analysis, forecasting/prediction, A/B testing)
Hands-on experience with Superset and/or Tableau, building dashboards for non-technical audiences

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Analyst to join our Claims Team.

This team is present for our customers when they need us most.

As a Data Analyst for our Claims Team, you will be more than just a "report generator." You will be a strategic partner, acting as the bridge between raw data and operational excellence. Your mission is to take full ownership of our claims insights to optimize the most critical moment for our customers.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


You will become a "go-to" person for the Claims team. You won't just provide data; you will interpret it, providing actionable insights and recommending specific business moves to improve efficiency.
We are looking for someone to take the lead on ETL processes. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines to ensure our claims datasets are robust, scalable, and accurate.
You will design high-impact Tableau dashboards that are both visually impeccable and highly functional. Your goal is to tell a clear story that allows stakeholders to make informed decisions at a glance.
You will collaborate closely with Pricing, Product, and Engineering to ensure a 360-degree view of the business, aligning claims performance with our overall growth strategy.
You will identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, freeing up the team to focus on high-value decision-making.


What We’re Looking For


Strong experience in data manipulation and extraction using SQL (MySQL, Redshift, or PostgreSQL).
Familiarity with building and maintaining ETL pipelines. You know how to transform raw data into structured, clean datasets.
2-3 years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a fast-paced environment (Consulting, Fintech, or Insurtech).
Proven track record of creating advanced models and dashboards in Tableau or similar BI tools.
Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or Business Administration).
Full professional proficiency in English and Spanish.


Nice-to-have


Ownership & Initiative: You don't wait for instructions; you identify gaps and propose solutions.
Communication & Influence: You can translate complex technical findings into clear business recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability: You thrive in a dynamic, ever-changing environment and can pivot your focus as business needs evolve.


€32,000 - €35,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵Competitive compensation: we offer a performance-based bonus up to 5.000€ for this role.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - User Acquisition (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our User Acquisition team. You'll own the measurement of how we acquire users across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties — from attribution and channel performance to cohort LTV and payback — and turn that into clear recommendations on where to spend the next dollar.

The ideal candidate has exceptional analytical skills, strong SQL and Python skills, deep familiarity with mobile app marketing data, and can bring rigor to data quality, analysis and storytelling.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own UA performance measurement across paid channels (e.g., Meta, Google, TikTok, AppLovin, Unity), including CPI/CAC, ROAS, retention, and payback by channel, campaign, geo, and creative

Experience with SAP Integrated Business Planning (SAP IBP) Demand Planning.

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst

LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

You’ll help define what we build versus buy, establish better product analytics foundations, and turn usage data into insights that inform pricing, packaging and growth decisions. Build and evangelise product analytics foundations, delivering actionable insight for GTM, Finance, Marketing, Product and Engineering teams on how the product is being bought and used (across PLG and SLG channels)

Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes that impact the product success
Understand how data currently flows at LocalStack and work with technical teams to develop enrichment to deliver the product analytics vision
Develop insights that prove out the value proposition / ROI for customers in collaboration with customers and customer facing teams

7+ years in data analytics role with a strong focus on product analytics
Experience modelling a unified system, showcasing architecture level thinking
Strong experience with complex SQL and ideally programming languages such as Python.
Experience with web and product analytics tools such as Posthog, GA4, Segment, RudderStack, Heap, Amplitude, Contentsquare, or equivalent
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.

Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.

Fully remote
Competitive salary
Annual company retreat
2 extra company-wide holidays

Yearly bonus

Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role Overview

We are looking for a Content Partners Data Analyst to analyse how advertising drives user acquisition, engagement and retention for streaming, CTV, gaming and other content-app brands.

This is a client-facing role combining strong SQL and data visualisation skills with deep knowledge of the content-app market. You will analyse advertising, audience and app-usage data, build clear measurement frameworks and dashboards, use AI tools to accelerate insight generation, and present actionable recommendations to clients and senior stakeholders.

Key responsibilities:


Measure Advertising Performance: Analyse campaign exposure and performance across CTV, streaming, gaming and other content-app environments
Connect Ads to Outcomes: Measure how campaigns influence app usage, acquisition, engagement, retention and re-engagement
Build Client Insights: Turn complex behavioural and advertising data into clear, commercially relevant stories and recommendations
Develop Measurement Frameworks: Define KPIs and repeatable approaches for reach, frequency, incrementality, conversion and engagement measurement
Create Dashboards & Reporting: Build scalable visualisations and reporting that make campaign and audience performance easy to understand
Use AI to Accelerate Analysis: Apply tools such as Claude to speed up exploration, QA, insight generation and reporting workflows
Present to Stakeholders: Lead analysis readouts and confidently present findings to clients, partners and senior internal teams
Understand the Content Market: Track CTV, streaming and gaming trends and translate market changes into better measurement and client recommendations


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


5+ years of experience in advertising measurement, analytics or insights within streaming, CTV, digital content, gaming or a closely related industry
Strong SQL skills: Able to independently query, join and analyse large behavioural and advertising datasets
Advertising measurement expertise: Experience with campaign performance, reach/frequency, attribution, incrementality, conversion and engagement metrics
Content-app experience: Strong understanding of streaming, broadcaster, FAST, gaming or other digital content businesses and their growth and engagement goals
Data visualisation skills: Hands-on experience with tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Looker or Power BI and a strong eye for clear analytical storytelling
AI-enabled analytics: Comfort using tools such as Claude, Amazon Bedrock or similar LLM platforms to improve analytical productivity and insight generation
Excellent presentation skills: Confident explaining analysis and recommendations to both technical and non-technical internal and external stakeholders
Analytical curiosity: A genuine love of content, strong commercial judgement and the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations; Python is a plus


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Data Analyst Demand Planning
Description:
Job Summary

Are you passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve planning performance and drive better business decisions?

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Demand Planning to support our global planning organization through advanced analytics, performance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will partner with Demand Planning, Commercial, Supply Planning, Finance, Information Technology, and external stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights that enhance forecast accuracy, business performance, and planning maturity. The position supports a fully remote working model and offers the opportunity to contribute to global transformation and data-driven decision-making initiatives.

Job Description

Global Operations

Ensuring excellence in execution across the value chain through operational effectiveness, supply chain performance, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Team Description

You will join a collaborative, analytical, and globally connected planning organization focused on enabling smarter business decisions through data, insights, and performance management. The team partners across regions, functions, and business units to improve planning outcomes, strengthen forecasting capabilities, and support business growth through fact-based decision-making.

Where You'll Make a Difference


Monitor and analyze demand planning performance indicators, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Forecast Value Add, and other planning metrics.
Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance monitoring solutions that support business reviews and decision-making.
Perform root cause analysis on forecast deviations, planning gaps, and operational performance issues to identify improvement opportunities.
Analyze demand patterns, customer trends, product performance, and key business drivers to generate actionable insights.
Consolidate and validate data from multiple sources while ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of planning information.
Support monthly Demand Review and business review processes through data-driven recommendations and performance reporting.
Partner with planners, commercial teams, finance, supply planning, and technology stakeholders on reporting, analytics, and planning initiatives.
Contribute to planning transformations, new capability deployments, process improvements, testing activities, and business adoption efforts.
Document reporting methodologies, key performance indicator definitions, governance standards, and analytical processes.


What Makes You The Right Fit


Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience working with large datasets, reporting solutions, and performance measurement frameworks.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence and data visualization tools.
Knowledge of data analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and performance management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex insights for diverse stakeholders.
Fluent written and verbal English communication skills.


How Would You Stand Out


Experience with SAP Integrated Business Planning (SAP IBP) Demand Planning.
Knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and Demand Review processes.
Experience with SQL and advanced data querying techniques.
Familiarity with forecasting performance metrics, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, and Forecast Value Add.
Experience within global, matrixed organizations supporting cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience supporting OTC Scent & Taste and/or PWB business processes.
Knowledge of MyBIS reporting environments, analytics solutions, and planning data structures.


Why Choose Us

At IFF, your work helps transform complex data into meaningful business outcomes. We value curiosity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning, creating an environment where analytical professionals can make a visible impact on global operations.

What We Offer


Fully remote work environment.
Opportunities to collaborate with global teams and stakeholders.
Exposure to planning transformation and digital improvement initiatives.
Continuous learning, training, and professional development opportunities.
Inclusive and collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives.
The opportunity to help shape a more data-driven planning organization

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - Monetization (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our Monetization team. You'll own how we measure and grow revenue across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties, spanning subscriptions, in-app purchases, advertising, and partner offers, and turn that into clear recommendations on pricing, packaging, and revenue mix. The ideal candidate has exceptional SQL and Python skills, hands-on experience with consumer subscription apps, and the rigor to design pricing experiments that hold up.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own revenue and monetization metrics across the portfolio, including ARPU/ARPDAU, LTV, trial-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn rates, refunds, and revenue mix by source
Design and analyze pricing, packaging, and paywall experiments (price points, trial length, plan structure, paywall placement and copy), and read results with statistical rigor
Build subscription cohort and LTV models that inform pricing decisions and feed back into UA bidding and payback targets
Analyze ad monetization performance, including eCPM, fill rate, impressions per user, and mediation/bidding setup, and balance ad revenue against retention and user experience
Measure the economics of partner offers and rewards, including revenue earned vs. rewards paid out, to keep the rewards model profitable
Reconcile revenue data across app stores, subscription platforms, ad networks, and internal systems, and investigate discrepancies
Partner with Monetization, Product, and GMs on revenue forecasting, opportunity sizing, and roadmap prioritization
Communicate analytical findings through clear, compelling narratives to drive alignment, inform prioritization, and deliver measurable business impact


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights

Title: DATA ANALYST - EXPERIENCIA DE CLIENTE
Description:
Descripción del puesto:

¿Qué proyectos desarrollamos?

Buscamos un Data Analyst para impulsar el desarrollo de la capa informacional del banco y aportar valor directo al negocio y a la dirección. Su misión será transformar datos - estructurados y no estructurados - en conocimiento útil que permita entender mejor el negocio, el mercado y nuestros clientes, así como identificar oportunidades de mejora y crecimiento.

La persona seleccionada formará parte de un equipo transversal y tendrá un rol clave como analista end‑to‑end, combinando análisis ad‑hoc, automatización de procesos, definición de KPIs, construcción de dashboards y participación activa en la migración de nuestros procesos y proyectos al entorno cloud.

Este rol es ideal para alguien con iniciativa, fuerte capacidad analítica, curiosidad y ganas de asumir un papel amplio y de impacto dentro del equipo.

 

Sus responsabilidades incluyen:

 

Gestión de la relación con los clientes (dirección y áreas de negocio)

Interlocución habitual con dirección y áreas de negocio para entender necesidades y traducirlas en soluciones basadas en datos.
Priorización y planificación de los proyectos y peticiones recurrentes.
Gestión de expectativas, seguimiento y comunicación de resultados.

 

Realización de proyectos en los que se aborda el ciclo completo de análisis de información

Toma de requerimientos de información de negocio
Exploración de datos en Datapool y/o fuentes externas. Desde la búsqueda hasta el tratamiento de los datos hasta generar la información necesaria
Propuesta y generación de KPIs
Construcción de los informes / análisis para presentar la información
Comunicación de resultados a los clientes
Diseño, elaboración, mantenimiento y automatización los procesos para seguimientos recurrentes o peticiones puntuales.

 

Para realizar estas funciones, será necesario:

Tener conocimientos técnicos para llevar a cabo los informes que se requieran desde negocio
Tener cualidades analíticas que permitan entender la lógica de negocio y proponer nuevas ideas o estrategias que ayuden a impulsarlo
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, así como creatividad y atención a los detalles en la visualización y comunicación de información.
Requisitos mínimos
Licenciatura en carreras de ciencias o ingenierías.
Fuertes capacidades de análisis y gestión de datos, con uso de herramientas de análisis y explotación de Bases de datos: alto nivel en SQL, fluidez en Data Discovery y Análisis Estadísticos, Python, GIT, Airflow.
Formación en lenguajes de programación.
Generación de dashboards con herramientas de visualización como QlikSense, Looker, etc.
Nivel avanzado herramientas de ofimática (Excel, Power Point, etc).

 

Se valorará positivamente:

Experiencia trabajando o analizando experiencia de cliente (NPS, touchpoints, etc.)
Experiencia previa en Google Cloud o en otras plataformas cloud (AWS, etc.).
Experiencia previa en Banca en departamentos de analítica/BI.

 

Competencias Clave

 

Gestión de grandes volúmenes de datos
Gestión de proyectos de información (relación con clientes y proveedores)
Capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en especificaciones técnicas
Persona resolutiva, con entusiasmo y compromiso, colaborativa
Perfil flexible, con capacidad de adaptación al cambio
Buenas habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales
Orientación al negocio y a la experiencia de cliente
Definición y seguimiento de KPI’s comerciales

 

¿Qué ofrecemos?
Formar parte del Banco más innovador en Europa Occidental, según los premios The Innovators de la revista estadounidense Global Finance.
Programa de onboarding y acompañamiento personalizado para tu desarrollo profesional.
Itinerario formativo individual con acceso a nuestra plataforma online, que ofrece un extenso catálogo de recursos de autoaprendizaje para fomentar tu crecimiento continuo.
Dispondrás de un seguro de salud completo totalmente gratuito para ti. Además, quedarás adherido al Plan de Pensiones, al que CaixaBank realizará aportaciones pensando ya en tu futuro.
Retribución flexible aplicada a transporte, formación, idiomas, guardería, entre otros.
Medidas de flexibilidad (trabajo en remoto, flexibilidad entrada)
Contamos con la certificación Top Employer, que nos reconoce como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

At Cognizant Netcentric, we create memorable digital experiences for the world’s leading brands. We are a diverse, global community of 1,500+ Adobe experts working across countries, cultures, and technologies.


Our inclusive culture blends the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the stability, resources, and learning opportunities of a global organisation.


With Holacracy at our core, every individual is empowered to make an impact.


Overview:


We are looking for a Data Analyst to support fast-paced AI-driven initiatives, such as digital assistants, voice bots and other next-gen support tools. These roles combine a strong foundation in Data Analytics (70%) with an affinity for Data Science (30%) and will help in defining success metrics, improving data quality, reporting, and generating insights that influence strategic decisions. The ideal candidate brings a deep curiosity for user behavior, proficiency in product analytics, and a customer-first mindset that drives actionable insights.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide accurate and relevant data analysis to support informed business decisions.
  • Determine and prioritize the data requirements necessary to address business challenges and objectives.
  • Source, evaluate, and integrate new data sources to enhance analysis and insights.
  • Analysis, Insights gathering and recommendations for actions
  • Ensure that the data used for analysis is accurate, complete, and readily accessible.
  • Create clear and impactful visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate data insights effectively
  • Present and explain data findings to stakeholders in a way that is understandable and actionable.
  • Monitor and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress against business goals
  • Design and execute A/B tests and apply statistical methods to support data-driven decision-making.


Requirements:

  • +3 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, ideally with exposure to AI/ML use cases.
  • Knowledge of Tableau and Databricks.
  • Ability and willingness to understand the business context and “why” behind technical features.
  • Hands-on mindset, comfortable with day-to-day operational work and proactive engagement.
  • Strong communicator able to bridge business and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Product Analytics is a big plus.
  • Some knowledge of LLMs, chatbots, and AI customer service solutions is a plus.
  • Open to occasional travel across Europe.


Preferred Profile:

  • Someone with a strong analytical foundation, curiosity for AI and a customer-first mindset.
  • Comfortable in cross-functional, agile teams, ideally experienced with customer-facing products.
  • Experience working in nearshore teams for enterprise clients is advantageous


At Cognizant Netcentric you get:

  • Permanent contract
  • 30 working days of vacation
  • Flexible working hours
  • Recognition bonus system
  • Private health insurance
  • Apple work equipment
  • WFH equipment + welcome package
  • WFH monthly expenses compensation
  • Access to different courses
  • Adobe certification
  • Sponsored gym membership
  • Tax-free benefits (ticket restaurant, kindergarten and transport)
  • A dynamic and international team
  • Everyone has a voice; we are a Holacracy organisation


At Cognizant Netcentric, we embrace an inclusive workplace, one where diversity is not just respected but celebrated. We do not discriminate based on age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected status. Our doors are wide open to all those who meet our high standards, and we cherish the distinct individuality and unique perspectives in our teams.


We firmly believe that a diverse and equitable workforce is the catalyst for groundbreaking innovation, boundless creativity, and seamless collaboration. We are aware of bias and have established clear criteria to take them out of the decision-making process, ensuring all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst - Paper.io 2
Description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be onsite (Paris) or full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Title: Data Analyst
Place: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
En BETWEEN te ofrecemos las oportunidades que necesitas para alcanzar tus objetivos profesionales. Si quieres desarrollar tu carrera en IT e Ingeniería, ¡este es tu próximo destino!

Trabajamos con clientes líderes, desarrollando soluciones tecnológicas en Infraestructura, Cloud, Software, Project Management y muchas otras áreas.

Buscamos un/a Data Analyst para incorporarse a un entorno orientado a datos, participando en la recopilación, tratamiento, análisis y visualización de información, así como en la mejora y automatización de procesos analíticos.

Funciones


Recopilar, limpiar y estructurar datos de diferentes fuentes.
Elaborar reporting operativo y ejecutivo y análisis de KPIs.
Crear y mantener dashboards en Power BI, incluyendo DAX y Power Query.
Realizar consultas y transformación de datos mediante SQL.
Desarrollar análisis y automatizaciones con Python (Pandas, NumPy).
Identificar oportunidades de automatización utilizando Power Automate / Power Apps.
Participar en iniciativas de IA y Machine Learning aplicadas al negocio.
Trabajar con equipos de Business, PMO y Tecnología para traducir necesidades en soluciones de datos.


Condiciones


Tendrás horario flexible.
Te integrarás en un equipo internacional.
Trabajarás en modelo híbrido acudiendo 2 días/semana a la oficina de Sant Cugat del Vallès. Buena accesibilidad tanto en transporte público como aparcamiento.
Tendrás un PC y los periféricos necesarios para el desarrollo de tu trabajo.


Beneficios De Trabajar Con Nosotros En BETWEEN

🏥 Seguro médico: cobertura médica privada para empleados.

📚 Formación y desarrollo: acceso a formación a cargo de la empresa.

🤝 Acompañamiento personalizado: apoyo continuo del equipo de Talento y seguimientos mensuales.

💳 Retribución flexible: ventajas fiscales aplicables a restauración, transporte y guardería.

🏋️ Bienestar y actividad física: acceso a la aplicación Wellhub.

💸 Descuentos exclusivos: acceso al Club Inspiring Benefits.

🌐 Networking y comunidad: participación en BETWEEN Nights, torneos deportivos y otros eventos.

🎁 Programa de recomendación: incentivos económicos por referir talento a la compañía.

En BETWEEN, la igualdad de oportunidades es uno de nuestros valores. Nuestro compromiso es contratar al mejor talento independientemente de su raza, religión, sexo, edad y personas con otras capacidades y promover su desarrollo profesional y personal.

Requisitos

Mínimos


Formación en Ingeniería, Matemáticas, Estadística, Data Analytics, Informática o similar.
Dominio del inglés (avanzado/bilingüe) y español.
+2 años de experiencia en Data Analytics / BI.
Experiencia con:
Power BI, DAX y Power Query
SQL
Excel avanzado
Python (Pandas, NumPy)
Conocimientos básicos de IA / Machine Learning.
Capacidad analítica, atención al detalle y orientación a mejora continua.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo.


Valorables


Power Automate / Power Apps.
Microsoft Azure / Fabric, Azure Data Factory o Azure SQL.
Scikit-learn, modelos predictivos o forecasting.
Experiencia con otros entornos cloud (AWS / GCP).
