Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Retail Data Analyst
Description:
ACERCA DE NOSOTROS

Title: Experienced Data Analyst - Digital Sales (m/f/d)
Description:
Your Tasks

This position is part of the Digital Sales Data Foundation team, which drives data-driven decision making across our digital platforms by analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and measuring the impact of strategic initiatives with a strong focus on A/B testing to enhance customer experience and business performance. You will work closely with other Data Analysts, Data Engineers, a dedicated Product Owner, and colleagues from global and local business departments.

Your tasks:


Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve analytics, tracking, and experimentation initiatives across digital areas.
Design, optimize, and document scalable tracking and measurement concepts, ensuring data quality, consistency, and usability for reporting, analysis, experimentation, and third-party integrations.
Define relevant KPIs, build dashboards, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support product optimization and data-driven decision-making.
Support and improve experimentation processes, including A/B test design, sample size planning, KPI alignment, analysis methodology, result interpretation, and rollout recommendations.
Contribute to scalable experimentation practices, tooling, automation, and knowledge management to support a growing number of experiments across markets, platforms, and product areas.
Work hands-on with complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics tools, while collaborating closely with developers and data teams.
Act as a trusted sparring partner for stakeholders, working independently or within cross-functional teams, and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


Your Profile


Several years of experience in digital analytics, conversion analysis, product analytics, experimentation, or a similar data-focused role, ideally in an e-commerce or digital product environment.
Strong understanding of tracking concepts, KPI frameworks, data quality, reporting, and analytics tools such as Google Data Studio, Adobe Analytics, Firebase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong experience with A/B testing or experimentation methodologies, including test setup, sample size considerations, KPI definition, statistical evaluation, interpretation of results, and communication of conclusions.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud or data warehouse technologies such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, or similar solutions.
Experience working with developers and technical teams, including documentation of requirements, tracking concepts, data flows, and implementation logic.
Familiarity with modern collaboration and productivity tools such as GitHub, GitHub Copilot, AI agents, reusable skills/workflows, or similar tools.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions and explain complex topics clearly.
High level of ownership, self-organization, curiosity, and ability to work both independently and as part of technical and cross-functional teams.


About Us

MediaMarktSaturn is Europe’s leading consumer electronics retailer. It sees itself as a partner, daily companion and navigator for its customers in the digital world. Its over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores are closely integrated with their online shops. MediaMarktSaturn has a total headcount of more than 60,000.

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working on making Europe's number one consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its sector. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 11 countries.

Technology Hub located in Barcelona, is one of the service units of MediaMarktSaturn Technology to deliver adequate staffing and engineering skills for the agreed deliveries of the global deployment plan for the entire group.

(*) Diversity and equal opportunities are important to us. Research shows that women and people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. If you are interested in this position but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Additional Benefits


Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model
You'll have a 10% discount on the entire MediaMarkt website, so you can treat yourself at a lower price whenever you want!
On top of your compensation package, you can request Flexible Pay “MediaFlex program” (a.e. Ticket Restaurant, Private Health Insurance with Adeslas, …)
Flexible working time and possibility to combine home office / presential working. Intensive workday every Friday and during summer
The possibility to choose between 2 offices: The first one is the MediaMarkt Spain HQ with a very attractive menu at a price. You'll eat for less than €4! And the second office is located at Pier01, in Barceloneta, right in the center of Barcelona.
There is a training budget so you can continue developing the skills you need most to keep growing professionally and personally!
We offer language classes: English, Spanish, and German
On your birthday, you won't work! It's a day for you to enjoy without thinking about work
You'll be working with the most cutting-edge technological stack of the moment

¡En Ayesa Digital crecemos Contigo!




Cada profesional de nuestra empresa es importante para nosotros, nos ayudan a crecer de manera diversa y gracias a ellos somos más de 11.000 personas trabajando con el mismo objetivo internacionalmente.




Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!




Buscamos ampliar nuestro equipo con un/a Data Analyst / BI Consultant, para participar en proyectos de analítica de datos, reporting y evolución del ecosistema analítico corporativo. La persona seleccionada trabajará en modalidad de teletrabajo híbrido en Madrid.




¡Anímate a dar el salto! ¡Te estamos esperando!




¿Qué vas a hacer?

Actuar como referente analítico y nexo entre las áreas de Negocio y Tecnología.
Gestionar la transformación, modelado y explotación de datos, garantizando la calidad y disponibilidad de la información para la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y mantener modelos de datos orientados a negocio.
Definir, documentar y evolucionar KPIs, métricas e indicadores de gestión.
Desarrollar lógica de negocio mediante DAX y modelos semánticos.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes en Power BI.
Construir visualizaciones que faciliten el análisis y la toma de decisiones de las distintas áreas de negocio.
Asegurar la correcta integración y explotación de datos entre BigQuery y Power BI.
Recopilar, analizar y documentar requisitos funcionales de las áreas usuarias.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en soluciones analíticas y de reporting.
Participar en la migración de procesos y modelos actualmente desarrollados en SAS hacia tecnologías Google Cloud y Microsoft.
Colaborar en la evolución de la arquitectura analítica y en la mejora continua de herramientas, procesos y modelos de datos.
Establecer mecanismos de control y seguimiento de la calidad del dato.
Identificar incidencias, inconsistencias y riesgos asociados a la información.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are




Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.




Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.




What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued




So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
LocalStack - the Local Cloud Sandbox for Developers and AI Agents

We are a fast-growing Series A startup building cutting-edge technology to revolutionize cloud development processes and support highly efficient dev&test feedback loops. We’ve closed our last $25mil round in Q4 2024, led by Notable Capital, CRV and Heavybit.

LocalStack is a local cloud development platform. LocalStack makes it easier, faster, and less expensive for software teams to ship reliable, high-quality applications to the cloud.

The cloud was built to run software, not to support AI-native development workflows. As the world's leading local cloud development platform, LocalStack provides secure local sandboxes that simulate cloud environments, enabling AI agents and software developers to find and fix risks faster and more effectively than they can in the cloud.

Our customer base ranges from SMBs to Global Fortune 500 companies. Our clients include companies like NASA, Harness, IBM, Workday, Comcast, Apple, 3M, Block and many more.

We are sustainably growing our globally distributed teams across GTM, operations and engineering. In 2025 we almost doubled in size and continue to grow across all areas in 2026.

LocalStack is headquartered in Zurich/Switzerland 🇨🇭, with a small engineering office in Vienna/Austria 🇦🇹 and remote team members from 25 countries including 🇺🇸the US, 🇫🇷FR, 🇬🇧UK, 🇨🇦CA, 🇪🇸ES, and many more!

👉Check our Notion Candidate Handbook and our GitHub!

✅ About the role

Data is highly valued at LocalStack, and this role is an opportunity to shape our product analytics strategy as we scale. You’ll connect fragmented data and user identities across the Emulator, CLI, VS Code extension, web app and docs, using rich product telemetry to understand how behaviour drives conversion, expansion and churn. You’ll help define what we build versus buy, establish better product analytics foundations, and turn usage data into insights that inform pricing, packaging and growth decisions. You’ll work closely with highly technical teams and have significant ownership in shaping how product analytics, data tooling and AI-assisted ways of working evolve at LocalStack.

✅ We Expect you to accomplish in this role:


Build and evangelise product analytics foundations, delivering actionable insight for GTM, Finance, Marketing, Product and Engineering teams on how the product is being bought and used (across PLG and SLG channels)
Connect the user journey across the Emulator, CLI, VS Code extension, console, docs site, website, offering a 360 degree customer view view into customer behaviour (for all types: human, CI, AI agent) and composites (e.g. human + AI)
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes that impact the product success
Understand how data currently flows at LocalStack and work with technical teams to develop enrichment to deliver the product analytics vision
Develop insights that prove out the value proposition / ROI for customers in collaboration with customers and customer facing teams


✅ Specialist Skills/ Experience


7+ years in data analytics role with a strong focus on product analytics
Experience modelling a unified system, showcasing architecture level thinking
Strong experience with complex SQL and ideally programming languages such as Python.
Experience with web and product analytics tools such as Posthog, GA4, Segment, RudderStack, Heap, Amplitude, Contentsquare, or equivalent
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.


🌱 Values we hold in LocalStack


Care: we create with compassion. We prioritize empathy and understanding in every interaction. By genuinely caring for our team, customers, and community, we create an environment where people thrive and impactful work flourishes
Ownership: we own the outcome. We take responsibility for our work and are passionate about its impact. We foster autonomy, inspire ambition, encourage ownership, and empower everyone to unlock their potential and make an impact.
Openness: we build trust together. We build trust through open communication and honest feedback. By sharing ideas and embracing diverse perspectives, we create stronger, more connected teams that work toward shared goals.
Courage: we dare to innovate. We embrace bold challenges and take calculated risks to move the needle. We step outside our comfort zones, experiment fearlessly, and turn setbacks into springboards for growth.
Excellence: we chase the extraordinary. We chase excellence by pushing boundaries and delivering results that go beyond the ordinary, constantly raising the bar and striving for greatness in everything we do. Excellence is not just the outcome, itʼs how we approach every task with purpose, passion, and a commitment to delivering exceptional value.


🎁 Benefits we offer:


Fully remote
Competitive salary
Annual company retreat
2 extra company-wide holidays
Friendly and inclusive workplace culture (community guilds and online company events)
Yearly bonus


Sounds like a good match?

We'd love to hear from you! Join us in shaping the future of cloud development at LocalStack.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst - Monetization (Remote)
Description:
Who We Are (Mode.Inc)

Mode is a fast-growing technology company building businesses at the intersection of AI, data, mobile apps, and digital experiences. Our portfolio of mobile apps and digital products reaches 100M+ monthly active users across a global audience. We continue to accelerate growth through product innovation, strategic acquisitions, and emerging business opportunities.

Mode was recognized by Deloitte as the #1 fastest-growing software company in North America on the 2023 Technology Fast 500. Today, we are building our next phase of growth, including expanding Mode's AI and data business and developing direct relationships with companies that can benefit from the data and capabilities we have built.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard-working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to be the analytical partner to our Monetization team. You'll own how we measure and grow revenue across our portfolio of mobile apps and web properties, spanning subscriptions, in-app purchases, advertising, and partner offers, and turn that into clear recommendations on pricing, packaging, and revenue mix. The ideal candidate has exceptional SQL and Python skills, hands-on experience with consumer subscription apps, and the rigor to design pricing experiments that hold up.

What You'll Do


Design, build, and maintain common datasets and data pipelines that strengthen self-service analytics and enable data-driven decision making across the organization
Improve data quality, accuracy, reliability, and documentation to strengthen self-service analytics
Own revenue and monetization metrics across the portfolio, including ARPU/ARPDAU, LTV, trial-to-paid conversion, renewal and churn rates, refunds, and revenue mix by source
Design and analyze pricing, packaging, and paywall experiments (price points, trial length, plan structure, paywall placement and copy), and read results with statistical rigor
Build subscription cohort and LTV models that inform pricing decisions and feed back into UA bidding and payback targets
Analyze ad monetization performance, including eCPM, fill rate, impressions per user, and mediation/bidding setup, and balance ad revenue against retention and user experience
Measure the economics of partner offers and rewards, including revenue earned vs. rewards paid out, to keep the rewards model profitable
Reconcile revenue data across app stores, subscription platforms, ad networks, and internal systems, and investigate discrepancies
Partner with Monetization, Product, and GMs on revenue forecasting, opportunity sizing, and roadmap prioritization
Communicate analytical findings through clear, compelling narratives to drive alignment, inform prioritization, and deliver measurable business impact


What You Bring to the Team


Analytical excellence to dissect complex, ambiguous problems and uncover actionable insights
Solid SQL and Python programming skills, and experience working with large-scale production data
Business acumen to translate data and analysis into business impact
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate in a highly cross-functional environment
4+ years in analytics, preferred background in monetization, pricing, or revenue analytics for consumer subscription apps & games
Experience with LTV modeling and revenue forecasting on subscription and ad monetized apps/games
Track record of designing and interpreting pricing or paywall A/B tests, including pitfalls like novelty effects, long conversion windows, and LTV vs. short-term conversion tradeoffs
Familiarity with app store subscription mechanics (App Store/Google Play billing, trials, grace periods, renewals, refunds) and subscription platforms (e.g., RevenueCat, Superwall, Adapty)
Nice to have: experience with ad mediation experience (AppLovin MAX, ironSource/Unity LevelPlay, AdMob), web checkout or web-to-app payments, rewards or loyalty program economics, Big Data tools (Redshift/Spark/Airflow), dashboarding tools (Looker, Tableau), experiment design, predictive modeling, log analysis, AI, or experience in tech or startup environments


Alignment with Our Core Values:

Title: Data Analyst Demand Planning
Description:
Job Summary

Are you passionate about transforming data into actionable insights that improve planning performance and drive better business decisions?

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Demand Planning to support our global planning organization through advanced analytics, performance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will partner with Demand Planning, Commercial, Supply Planning, Finance, Information Technology, and external stakeholders to deliver meaningful insights that enhance forecast accuracy, business performance, and planning maturity. The position supports a fully remote working model and offers the opportunity to contribute to global transformation and data-driven decision-making initiatives.

Job Description

Global Operations

Ensuring excellence in execution across the value chain through operational effectiveness, supply chain performance, quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Team Description

You will join a collaborative, analytical, and globally connected planning organization focused on enabling smarter business decisions through data, insights, and performance management. The team partners across regions, functions, and business units to improve planning outcomes, strengthen forecasting capabilities, and support business growth through fact-based decision-making.

Where You'll Make a Difference


Monitor and analyze demand planning performance indicators, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Forecast Value Add, and other planning metrics.
Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, reports, and performance monitoring solutions that support business reviews and decision-making.
Perform root cause analysis on forecast deviations, planning gaps, and operational performance issues to identify improvement opportunities.
Analyze demand patterns, customer trends, product performance, and key business drivers to generate actionable insights.
Consolidate and validate data from multiple sources while ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of planning information.
Support monthly Demand Review and business review processes through data-driven recommendations and performance reporting.
Partner with planners, commercial teams, finance, supply planning, and technology stakeholders on reporting, analytics, and planning initiatives.
Contribute to planning transformations, new capability deployments, process improvements, testing activities, and business adoption efforts.
Document reporting methodologies, key performance indicator definitions, governance standards, and analytical processes.


What Makes You The Right Fit


Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related analytical discipline.
Experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience working with large datasets, reporting solutions, and performance measurement frameworks.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience using Power BI or similar business intelligence and data visualization tools.
Knowledge of data analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and performance management.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex insights for diverse stakeholders.
Fluent written and verbal English communication skills.


How Would You Stand Out


Experience with SAP Integrated Business Planning (SAP IBP) Demand Planning.
Knowledge of Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and Demand Review processes.
Experience with SQL and advanced data querying techniques.
Familiarity with forecasting performance metrics, including Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, and Forecast Value Add.
Experience within global, matrixed organizations supporting cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience supporting OTC Scent & Taste and/or PWB business processes.
Knowledge of MyBIS reporting environments, analytics solutions, and planning data structures.


Why Choose Us

At IFF, your work helps transform complex data into meaningful business outcomes. We value curiosity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning, creating an environment where analytical professionals can make a visible impact on global operations.

Fully remote work environment.
Opportunities to collaborate with global teams and stakeholders.
Exposure to planning transformation and digital improvement initiatives.
Continuous learning, training, and professional development opportunities.
Inclusive and collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives.
The opportunity to help shape a more data-driven planning organization

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst - Paper.io 2
Description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position can be onsite (Paris) or full remote within CET time ±3h.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the world's largest and most successful hybrid publisher.

You will be joining one of our Live Studios, working on Paper.io 2.

With Paper.io2, we’re building an iconic game that players will never forget!

We're a small team of excellent people who take care of everything from ideas to testing, and we intend to grow while maintaining our high standards.

Role


Autonomously take ownership of the A/B testing cycle on Paper.io 2, validating feature values, refining key parameters, and optimizing monetization to drive core KPIs.
Lead analysis of large, complex datasets to uncover player behaviors and growth opportunities.
Translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations that shape game design and the product roadmap.
Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and developers to embed data-driven decisions throughout the game lifecycle.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that keep the team aligned on critical metrics.


Profile


4+ years in analytical roles within gaming, comfortable working with product teams.
Skilled in SQL and either R or Python; experience with complex, large datasets.
Strong grasp of A/B testing and statistical analysis methods.
Autonomous and pragmatic problem solver with a sharp analytical mind and attention to detail.
Thrives in fast-paced live-ops/product-driven environments with rapid iteration.
Creative thinker who challenges assumptions and sees beyond the obvious.
Player-first mindset with genuine interest in games and player behavior.
Excellent communicator who turns data into compelling, actionable stories.
Collaborative team player who adapts quickly to change and ambiguity.


Benefits


Best-in-class compensation
Other benefits based on your country of residence

Title: Data Analyst III (Remote)
Description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Data Analyst to join the Office of Adversary Strategy. As a Data Analyst in this organization, you have the privilege of working with various types of cybersecurity data to support our larger mission of stopping breaches from a purposefully adversarial mindset.

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our team and support the ability to make data-informed decisions across our portfolio. In this role, you will analyze large-scale security telemetry, threat intelligence feeds, and detection data to uncover patterns, improve operations, and support strategic initiatives. You'll work cross-functionally with various product and engineering teams to transform raw security data into actionable insights.

If you are a hands-on data nerd who loves to run queries all day and wants to operate at scale, apply & let's talk!

What You'll Do:


Analyze large volumes of security event data, endpoint telemetry, and threat intelligence feeds to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging threats
Design and maintain dashboards and reports that track key security metrics
Translate complex security data findings into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Build and maintain data pipelines and reporting workflows using SQL, Python, Logscale, or similar tools
Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility
Contribute to the development of KPIs and metrics frameworks for measuring security product performance and adoption
Stay current on cybersecurity trends, adversary behaviors, and industry best practices to inform analysis


What You'll Need:


Curiosity and a deep desire for continuous learning
Education: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Experience: 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, preferably within cybersecurity, IT, or related technical domains
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in querying large, complex, datasets, in particular graph databases
Experience with tools like Python or R for data analysis and automation
Familiarity with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar)
Experience working with large-scale, high-velocity datasets (logs, streaming telemetry, SIEM data)
Bonus: Understanding of security concepts (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK framework, security operations experience)
Analytical Skills:
Strong statistical analysis and quantitative reasoning skills
Ability to translate ambiguous business/security questions into structured analyses
Communication Skills:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

Market leader in compensation and equity awards
Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
Paid parental and adoption leaves
Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

Title: Experienced Data Analyst - Digital Sales (m/f/d)
Description:
Your Tasks

This position is part of the Digital Sales Data Foundation team, which drives data-driven decision making across our digital platforms by analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and measuring the impact of strategic initiatives with a strong focus on A/B testing to enhance customer experience and business performance. You will work closely with other Data Analysts, Data Engineers, a dedicated Product Owner, and colleagues from global and local business departments.

Your tasks:


Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve analytics, tracking, and experimentation initiatives across digital areas.
Design, optimize, and document scalable tracking and measurement concepts, ensuring data quality, consistency, and usability for reporting, analysis, experimentation, and third-party integrations.
Define relevant KPIs, build dashboards, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support product optimization and data-driven decision-making.
Support and improve experimentation processes, including A/B test design, sample size planning, KPI alignment, analysis methodology, result interpretation, and rollout recommendations.
Contribute to scalable experimentation practices, tooling, automation, and knowledge management to support a growing number of experiments across markets, platforms, and product areas.
Work hands-on with complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud environments, and analytics tools, while collaborating closely with developers and data teams.
Act as a trusted sparring partner for stakeholders, working independently or within cross-functional teams, and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


Your Profile


Several years of experience in digital analytics, conversion analysis, product analytics, experimentation, or a similar data-focused role, ideally in an e-commerce or digital product environment.
Strong understanding of tracking concepts, KPI frameworks, data quality, reporting, and analytics tools such as Google Data Studio, Adobe Analytics, Firebase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong experience with A/B testing or experimentation methodologies, including test setup, sample size considerations, KPI definition, statistical evaluation, interpretation of results, and communication of conclusions.
Strong hands-on experience with SQL, complex datasets, data pipelines, cloud or data warehouse technologies such as Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, or similar solutions.
Experience working with developers and technical teams, including documentation of requirements, tracking concepts, data flows, and implementation logic.
Familiarity with modern collaboration and productivity tools such as GitHub, GitHub Copilot, AI agents, reusable skills/workflows, or similar tools.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions and explain complex topics clearly.
High level of ownership, self-organization, curiosity, and ability to work both independently and as part of technical and cross-functional teams.


About Us

MediaMarktSaturn is Europe’s leading consumer electronics retailer. It sees itself as a partner, daily companion and navigator for its customers in the digital world. Its over 1,000 MediaMarkt and Saturn stores are closely integrated with their online shops. MediaMarktSaturn has a total headcount of more than 60,000.

MediaMarktSaturn Technology is working on making Europe's number one consumer electronics retailer the technology leader in its sector. To this end, several hundred developers, UX designers and system architects using state-of-the-art technology work hand in hand with business owners in agile teams to develop customer-focused technology solutions for more than 6 million customers every day in 11 countries.

Technology Hub located in Barcelona, is one of the service units of MediaMarktSaturn Technology to deliver adequate staffing and engineering skills for the agreed deliveries of the global deployment plan for the entire group.

(*) Diversity and equal opportunities are important to us. Research shows that women and people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. If you are interested in this position but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Additional Benefits


Young environment, where not everything is written in stone, and where you are expected to contribute and co-create the culture of the Tech Hub and international collaboration model
You'll have a 10% discount on the entire MediaMarkt website, so you can treat yourself at a lower price whenever you want!
On top of your compensation package, you can request Flexible Pay “MediaFlex program” (a.e. Ticket Restaurant, Private Health Insurance with Adeslas, …)
Flexible working time and possibility to combine home office / presential working. Intensive workday every Friday and during summer
The possibility to choose between 2 offices: The first one is the MediaMarkt Spain HQ with a very attractive menu at a price. You'll eat for less than €4! And the second office is located at Pier01, in Barceloneta, right in the center of Barcelona.
There is a training budget so you can continue developing the skills you need most to keep growing professionally and personally!
We offer language classes: English, Spanish, and German
On your birthday, you won't work! It's a day for you to enjoy without thinking about work
You'll be working with the most cutting-edge technological stack of the moment

Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones

2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados

Nice-to-have:

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are




Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.




Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.




What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued




So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Senior Mobility Data Analyst
Description:
Somos una compañía global especializada en la distribución eficiente de vehículos, con más de 47 años de experiencia en el sector de la automoción, con origen y sede central en Madrid, España.

Nuestro enfoque de negocio, combina un profundo conocimiento de la industria, tecnología propia, digitalización e inteligencia de datos para entender las necesidades reales de movilidad y ofrecer soluciones flexibles y personalizadas a particulares, empresas y administraciones públicas.

Hoy, estamos presentes en 18 países de Europa y Latinoamérica, representando cerca de 40 marcas oficiales de vehículos a través de una red de más de 3.200 puntos de venta y servicio independientes. Pensamos de forma global y actuamos con un fuerte enfoque local, adaptando nuestro modelo a cada mercado y estableciendo, relaciones a largo plazo con fabricantes, clientes y socios financieros. En 2025, generamos una facturación de 5.500 millones de euros y vendimos 220.000 vehículos nuevos.

Move. It’s your right.

En Astara apostamos por la igualdad de oportunidades, la inclusión y la diversidad. ¡Animamos a todas las personas, incluidas aquellas con discapacidad, a unirse a nuestro equipo! Si necesitas alguna adaptación durante el proceso de selección, no dudes en contárnoslo

Astara Intelligence

En Astara Intelligence transformamos datos en decisiones de negocio para el sector de la movilidad. Somos la unidad de analítica y consultoría de Astara, compañía global de movilidad, y trabajamos con clientes públicos y privados en proyectos de movilidad inteligente, estrategia, datos e innovación.

Buscamos un/a consultor especialista en análisis de datos de movilidad para incorporarse al equipo de consultoría de movilidad en ASTARA Intelligence (Advisory). Participarás en proyectos de consultoría de movilidad, analizando datos, estructurando problemas complejos y preparando recomendaciones claras para cliente.

Main Functions/Responsibilities


Analizar datos de movilidad, demanda, territorio, usuarios, operaciones y mercado.
Apoyar proyectos de consultoría en movilidad urbana, transporte, smart cities y nuevos modelos de servicio.
Construir análisis, modelos y dashboards en Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL u otras herramientas.
Preparar informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones para cliente, en español e inglés.
Definir KPIs, escenarios, diagnósticos y recomendaciones estratégicas.
Colaborar con consultores/as, analistas, diseñadores/as y perfiles técnicos en proyectos end-to-end.
Explorar el uso de IA y automatización para acelerar research y análisis.


Professional Experience/Qualifications


+5 años de experiencia en consultoría, analítica, movilidad, transporte, smart cities, estrategia y/o data analytics.
Formación en Ingeniería, Economía, Data Science, Estadística, Matemáticas, Urbanismo, Transporte o similar.
Nivel experto de Excel y experiencia en analisis de bases de datos complejas.
Conocimiento experto de Power BI, Tableau, Looker o herramientas similares.
Inglés profesional, escrito y hablado (nivel C1-C2)
Capacidad para estructurar problemas ambiguos, extraer insights y comunicarlos con claridad
Excelente comunicación oral (presentación) y escrita (redacción de documentos)
Interés real por la movilidad, las ciudades, la tecnología y los datos

Title: Data Analyst (with focus on AI)
Place: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Role purpose

We are looking to add to the Analytics team a profile 100% focused on data analysis and business impact, with a strong sensitivity towards the world of applied Artificial Intelligence, capable of transforming complex data into actionable insights, driving continuous improvement, and clearly communicating conclusions in an executive manner to different stakeholders.

We are not looking for a purely academic or AI research profile, but for someone who knows how to use AI as a lever to elevate analysis quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve decision-making.




Key Responsibilities

Analyze large volumes of data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities with direct business impact.
Generate actionable insights by connecting technical metrics with business KPIs and strategic objectives.
Apply AI / advanced analytics techniques (predictive models, clustering, analysis automation, insight generation, etc.) with a practical, results-oriented approach.
Drive continuous improvement by proposing hypotheses, tests, and data-driven recommendations.
Design and create executive presentations (slides, dashboards, one-pagers) for committees and senior stakeholders, with clear, structured, and decision-oriented messaging.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (product, technology, operations, business), acting as a bridge between data and decision-making.
Explore and propose new use cases of AI applied to data analysis, maintaining a pragmatic innovation mindset.




Profile we are looking for

Degree in quantitative fields: Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar.
Strong experience in data analysis and interpretation of business KPIs.
Knowledge and practical experience with analytics tools (SQL, Python, Power BI / Tableau or similar).
Interest and experience in applying AI techniques and advanced models, always with a business focus (not an academic profile).
High ability to synthesize complex information and convert it into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Experience creating executive presentations and presenting conclusions to senior stakeholders.
Continuous improvement mindset, critical thinking, and impact orientation.
Strong communication skills, autonomy, and an end-to-end vision of data.
Fluent in English and Spanish (C1+), with experience working in international and cross-functional environments




Nice to have

Experience using AI to automate analysis, generate insights, or improve analytical efficiency.
Knowledge of cloud environments, large-scale data management, or analytical pipelines.
Previous experience in product, operations, or business environments.
Ability to prioritize and focus analysis on what truly drives impact.




What We Offer

A role with real impact on business decisions.
An environment where AI is applied in a practical, not experimental, way.
Direct participation in decision-making forums and strategic projects.
A highly skilled team with a collaborative mindset.
Opportunity to grow at the intersection of data, AI, and business.







Strong fit with our Company DNA

Passionate in Everything We Do: Our people bring a contagious energy and a sense of urgency that is unmistakable. We create a vision and inspire others around that vision with full engagement and focus. We are all-in, and we love what we do.

Committed to Making a Difference: We are courageous, we deliver what we promise through hard work and resilience. We make a difference, through operating with discipline and doing what is needed. We are hands-on, and we aren’t afraid to get into the detail. We deliver results and we execute with excellence.

Always Innovating: Our people make the impossible possible; it’s a continuous state of mind. We are purpose-driven, curious and we challenge the status quo. We believe good ideas travel, we share and reapply. We take smart risks, and we are not afraid to fail. We believe innovation can be big or small.

Winning as a Team: We are determined to become number 1, and to do that we need to listen to one another, collaborate and work together. We play our part, fueled by a winning attitude and a fighting spirit. We celebrate our successes. We play to our strengths and our diversity to deliver even better outcomes, while developing and supporting one another. We believe that together we go further, and that nothing is impossible.

With Trust & Responsibility: Our people take responsibility for the people we protect. We are accountable and reliable. We role model operating with integrity. We trust and empower one another to do the right thing, always. We deliver on our promise through world-class expertise and meticulous know-how. And, we do this with humility while being honoured to play such an important role in society.




At Verisure, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognising that diversity of thought and background only makes our teams stronger and more innovative. We reject all forms of discrimination and bias, and we believe in access to opportunities for everyone, regardless of gender, age, disability status, race, sexual orientation, or any other status.

We review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position once we find the right candidate. To ensure consideration, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.




Feel free to get in touch with me at enrique.barajasluque@verisure.es. I’d be happy to tell you more about the role and Verisure!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Conetic is an innovative global company dedicated to transforming the flying experience by making the passenger journey engaging and truly memorable.

We specialize in comprehensive media services, with a focus on creating more personalized and engaging experiences for travelers at every step of the journey.

By uniting Touch Inflight Solutions and ABOVE, Conetic brings together a leading IFE content service provider and a robust cloud-based media distribution platform. This combination of curated content, data-driven personalization, and an automated cloud media supply chain enables airlines to deliver fresh, personalized content to passengers faster and more efficiently through a seamless, end-to-end solution.

About the role:

As our Data Analyst, you will provide essential support to the Digital Products & Innovation department by performing a variety of data analysis tasks, such as organizing large amounts of data, defining trends and patterns, as well as supporting data architects on other projects.

About the responsibilities:


Conduct complex data analysis and report on results;
Interpret trends and patterns
Evaluate business needs and objectives
Analyze and organize raw information from different sources
Build data systems, pipelines, algorithms and prototypes
Develop analytical tools and programs
Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability
Prepare data for prescriptive and predictive modeling
Identify opportunities for data acquisition
Collaborate with data scientists and architects on several projects


About you:


Strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems with data.
Proficient in SQL
Experienced with Python
Comfortable working with large datasets and integrating data from multiple sources.
Skilled in using statistical techniques and data modeling to uncover insights.
Knowledge of diferent languages for data analysis is a plus.
Detail-oriented, with the ability to translate raw data into clear and actionable insights.
Collaborative and communicative, able to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Curious, proactive, and eager to improve processes and contribute to innovation.


About the benefits:


Flexible working hours;
International team;
Birthday Leave;

Title: Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d)
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket.

Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will be responsible for identifying opportunities for growth and improvement, as well as gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data to help the organization make better decisions. The Data Analyst will also work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that we meet customer needs and drive sales and profitability.



Responsibilities:



Gather and understand business needs and objectives.
Identify and interpret patterns, trends, insights, business metrics from data
Create data-complex dashboards with an optimized data structure and scaling perspective
Assist in planning, forecasting and AB testing processes.
Work with various product and business stakeholders to develop data-driven insights.
Partner with the Data Engineering team to define and build reliable data sources.
Identify new opportunities for the use of data across the company.


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, Power BI / Tableau, and other data analysis tools
4+ years of experience in data, product analytics, data science or business intelligence, e-commerce experience is a plus
University degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, or a related field
Proficiency in statistical analysis methods, data modeling, hypothesis testing, AB testing
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Fluent English
Good communication skills, ability to communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences
Applying expertise in analysis to see beyond the numbers and provide clear insights


Additional Information



What do we offer?



Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)
Free English and German language classes (after probation period)
Flexible working hours and hybrid work





The position is available for candidates based in Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Moldova or Kazakhstan.



Join us today and let’s create a success story together!





This job was posted on 02/07/2026, and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.
