Title: Data Business Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Join our team at AMGEN Capability Center Portugal, consistently recognized among the top companies in the Best Workplaces™ ranking by Great Place to Work® in Portugal. In 2026, we were once again distinguished as one of the top Best Workplaces in the country (category 201–500 employees), reinforcing our commitment to an exceptional employee experience and workplace culture.

We are a team of over 500 talented individuals, spanning more than 30 functions and areas of expertise, and representing over 40 nationalities. Together, we bring diverse perspectives and professional backgrounds to help shape the future of healthcare through innovation and technology.

This is your opportunity to explore a world of possibilities across areas such as Data & Analytics, Digital, Technology & Innovation, Cybersecurity, R&D Operations, Global Distribution, Finance, Regulatory Affairs, General & Administrative, Human Resources, and many more.

Located in the heart of Lisbon, our AMGEN office fosters a culture of innovation, excellence, and purpose. Come thrive with us at AMGEN, supporting our mission To Serve Patients.

What we do at AMGEN matters in people’s lives.

Data Business Analyst

LIVE

What You Will Do

The Data Business Analyst will join our Commercial Data & Analytics team and play a key role in developing data capabilities that enable deeper insight generation and support informed business decision-making.

Working closely with business subject matter experts, product team members, UX professionals, and data engineering teams, the Data Business Analyst will identify business and product needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements. The role will support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of data products and solutions developed using technologies such as AWS, Databricks, Airflow, Redshift, and S3.

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will:


Collaborate with business subject matter experts and product team members to manage data analysis activities and ensure alignment with product and engineering objectives across the Commercial Data & Analytics team.
Support Voice of the Customer assessments to understand user needs, define business processes, and identify product requirements.
Gather, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring they are appropriately included and prioritized in Product and Release Backlogs.
Facilitate the breakdown of Epics into Features and sprint-sized User Stories and participate in backlog refinement and review sessions with development teams.
Write clear User Stories, requirements, and supporting documentation to ensure stakeholders and delivery teams understand the expected outcomes and how each feature contributes to the overall product.
Define clear Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done requirements and help ensure their traceability to product objectives and key results.
Work closely with UX professionals to align technical requirements, business scenarios, and process maps with user experience designs.
Support PI Planning activities, product roadmap development, and the creation of user journeys.
Prepare and deliver effective product demonstrations for internal and external stakeholders.
Maintain accurate documentation of product configurations, processes, requirements, and changes.
Develop an understanding of end-to-end data pipeline designs and data flows across the Commercial Data Lake.
Use knowledge of data structures and data analytics to investigate and diagnose data issues for resolution by the data engineering team.
Produce data models and product documentation in formats that can be effectively accessed and interpreted by AI models.
Execute and monitor Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) jobs and support the investigation of performance or data-quality issues.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data products, delivery processes, and analytics capabilities.


WIN

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is an analytical, collaborative, and business-oriented individual with a strong interest in data, technology, digital product delivery, and innovation.

Minimum Requirements


High School Diploma or GED and eight years of data analytics experience; or
Associate’s Degree and six years of data analytics experience; or
Bachelor’s Degree and two years of data analytics experience; or
Master’s Degree.
Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business or product needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements.
Experience working with data and analytics concepts, systems, or products.
Proficiency in English.


Preferred Requirements


Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to address complex data challenges.
Experience with Agile software development methodologies, particularly Scrum.
Experience writing User Stories, requirements, and Acceptance Criteria in Jira using the INVEST framework.
Experience managing product features for PI Planning and contributing to product roadmaps and user journeys.
Demonstrated knowledge of data and analytics technologies and related technical concepts.
Understanding of data and analytics software strategy, governance, infrastructure, and data-quality principles.
Understanding of end-to-end data pipelines, data flows, data structures, and ETL processes.
Experience with cloud-based data technologies such as Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3, AWS, or comparable platforms.
Hands-on experience using Python and/or SQL for data analysis, investigation, validation, or troubleshooting.
Familiarity with Airflow or comparable data workflow orchestration technologies.
Familiarity with low-code or no-code test automation tools.
Knowledge of AI and machine learning frameworks, including Large Language Models, generative AI, or agentic AI frameworks.
Experience working with product owners, business stakeholders, UX professionals, data engineers, and other technical teams.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate and traceable product and technical documentation.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional and multicultural teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and take accountability for delivery.
A collaborative working style, an Agile mindset, and a willingness to learn and adopt new technologies.


THRIVE

What You Can Expect Of Us


Vast opportunities to learn, develop, and move up and across our global organization.
Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where colleagues are empowered to bring ideas to the table, take risks, and act.
Generous AMGEN Total Rewards Plan comprising healthcare, finance, wealth, and career benefits.
Flexible work arrangements.


APPLY NOW

Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.

CAREERS.AMGEN.COM

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

Title: Lead Product Analyst, B2C Financial Services
Description:
Department: B2C Financial Services, Analytics

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Remote

Reporting To: jacek.korpikiewicz@tabby.ai

Description

Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system, in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.

About The Role

This role focuses on Tabby Cash, and the growing ecosystem of our debit financial products.

You will lead a team of analysts that work on activation, engagement, and profitability, helping shape how the product grows from 1 → 100. The role requires balancing user growth with sustainable economics, working across Product, Risk, and Growth teams.

You will play a key role in defining how users adopt and use our cards, and how we optimize the products for long-term value.

What you will be doing


Lead a team of product analysts to provide support to the product and business teams across all aspects of their work.
Generate hypotheses, conduct research and A/B tests, and present your findings clearly and compellingly, which highlights the importance of your insights.
Regularly work with several stakeholders, including product and marketing teams, on fundamental research as well as on one-time requests.
Support and monitor existing metrics for the Financial Products, identify areas for improvement, and develop new metrics that inform decision-making across the organization.
Develop data visualizations and reports that are both informative and easily understood by business and product teams.
Assist in the planning of necessary data structures and data quality improvements.



What you will need


Minimum of 4 years of work experience as a data/product analyst.
Experience in leading a team of data analysts of any size.
Proficiency in SQL and relational databases.
Proficiency in data visualization and BI tools.
Experience in planning data structures for new products and features.
Strong knowledge of Python (Pandas, Numpy, Statsmodels, Matplotlib, etc.)
Experience in product analytics in fintech is a plus.
Experience in leveraging LLM/AI for analytical purposes is a plus.
Strong quantitative skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Ability to analyze issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact with business and product teams. At least an upper-intermediate level of English proficiency is required.



What we offer:


Full-time B2B contract
Fully remote setup
Up to 20% tax allowance
22 paid leave days annually
Stock options (ESOP) in a fast-scaling, pre-IPO company
Flexi benefits you can use for wellness, travel, or learning
Work alongside a high-performing, international engineering team in a global fintech unicorn



Relocation support is available to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Portugal, and Spain, including flights, temporary accommodation, and legal setup (if needed)

What You Can Expect


We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.



We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals.

If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

Title: Senior Internal Auditor - Data Analytics (SQL/Python)
Description:
Job Type

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

The team

The Group Internal Audit team provides independent and objective assurance and advice to the Group Audit Committee, and to the Boards of Directors of the companies within the Group, over the processes and systems of control and risk management operating in the Group. Its scope covers all aspects of the Group and its activities. It also liaises closely with other monitoring functions across the Group, including Group Compliance and Group Risk. Its Audit Plans are developed using a risk-based approach.

The Vision for the Group Internal Audit team is ‘To be recognised as a leading edge audit function among its peer group, which provides robust assurance and value creating insight and challenge through the excellence of its people, processes and technology’. The purpose of this Vision is to provide a consistent point of reference for our development. Our day to day work and any changes we make to what we do must be consistent with and contribute to this Vision.

The Group Audit team is based across three hubs in the UK (London and York), Europe (Lisbon and Luxembourg) and US (Atlanta and White Plains). The team is supplemented with additional co-source when required.

Professional standards

Our work adheres to the Institute of Internal Auditors’ (IIA) mandatory guidance including the Definition of Internal Auditing, the Code of Ethics and the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (‘the Standards’). We also adhere to guidance issued by the Chartered Institute of Internal Auditors in the UK (CIIA): Effective Internal Audit in the Financial Services Sector.

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a small but dynamic team, you will conduct internal audits across the Hiscox Group in line with the Audit Plan. These audits will be aligned to all Hiscox Business Units and Group functions. This will be through working with other members of the team, alone on some reviews or with co-source.

The role covers all aspects of the successful delivery of audits, including:


design and execute data-driven audit procedures (e.g. transaction analysis, anomaly detection) and support the development and delivery of the data analytics and AI strategy within the Internal Audit team.
ensuring the successful and timely completion of reviews, from initial scoping and planning through to reporting and follow up of actions and recommendations. You could take on the lead role on several audits, responsible for their end to end delivery, as well as supporting other team members with their audits;
extract, clean and analyse large datasets (SQL, Python)
build reusable analytics tools and scripts
translate technical outputs into clear audit insights for senior stakeholder
making effective and pragmatic recommendations to address issues and to add value to the business;
working with and supporting other team members;
contributing to Internal Audit’s planning and strategy, and to its continued development. You will lead the development and / or implementation of certain assigned aspects of this non-audit related work; and
helping to build and maintain Internal Audit’s presence and reputation across the Group.



Outside the Audit Plan, you may be asked to conduct specific reviews or to take on special projects. You will also be expected to take on additional responsibilities to support the Group Chief Auditor and other team members as required.

The primary reporting line will be to an Audit Director based in Luxembourg.

Specification


Preferably degree qualified in accountancy, computer science, information systems, data science, mathematics or a similar discipline, with a relevant professional accountancy, audit or other professional certification.
Previous internal audit experience (risk or consultancy experience would also be considered for exceptional candidates), which ideally would be gained within insurance
Data extraction and analysis capability, ideally with experience data analytic tooling (e.g. Tableau, SQL, PowerBI, Alteryx, Python)
Experience with AI, machine learning and emerging technologies are an advantage
Experience in continuous auditing, monitoring and automation
Fluent in English
A dynamic, assertive and self-confident individual who can deliver without the need for high levels of supervision
The ability to plan and organise an end to end audit with minimal day to day supervision, audit with the inherent flexibility to adapt the process as required
The ability to translate audit objectives, risks and controls into defensible, repeatable analytics to support audit conclusions
Independent worker, resilient and self-reliant. Must also be confident delivering difficult messages to senior stakeholders and be comfortable drafting written reports (which will be shared at Group Committee and Board level)
Strong people and relationship building skills, notably influencing and negotiating
Sound audit judgement
Excellent team working skills and the ability to supervise and coach other team members constructively and effectively
Experience in business intelligence and data visualisation
Innovative problem solving skills and the courage to apply them
Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
Good commercial awareness



Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

Title: Team Leader - CRM Operations, Governance & Reporting
Description:
Responsible for performing data research and analysis to support business operations including:


Creating data mining architectures/models/protocols, statistical reporting, and data analysis methodologies to identify trends in large data sets
Blending historical data from available external and internal data sources
Data processing, cleaning, analysis, modelling and visualization to identify data patterns and trends to help improve business decision making
Analysis may be applied to various areas of the business (e.g., Market Economics, Supply Chain, Marketing/Advertising, Scientific Research, etc.)
Researching and applying knowledge of existing and emerging data science principles, theories, and techniques to inform business decisions
At higher career levels, may conduct scientific research projects with the goal of breaking new ground in data analytics



Purpose of the Role

The Team Leader - CRM Operations, Governance & Reporting is responsible for leading a team that delivers CRM operational support, reporting services, data governance, and continuous improvement activities in support of the Commercial organisation across Europe.

The role ensures the effective administration and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics CRM, delivering high-quality reporting, analytics, data integrity, and user support services that enable commercial decision making and sales effectiveness.

Acting as a key partner to the European Commercial Centre of Excellence (CoE), Sales Excellence, Sales Leadership, IT, and Global CRM teams, the role drives operational excellence, service performance, standardisation, and continuous improvement across CRM and commercial reporting processes.

The Team Leader is accountable for team performance, stakeholder satisfaction, service levels, governance, compliance, and capability development while fostering a culture of customer focus, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The role also acts as business owner for CRM operational data and reporting requirements, partnering with the commercial data assets, KPI definitions, and governance support scalable analytics and future AI-enabled decision making.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Service Delivery


Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for CRM operations, reporting, user support, and data governance activities.
Establish clear objectives, priorities, performance measures, and development plans for team members.
Monitor team workload, capacity, and service delivery performance to ensure SLA commitments are achieved.
Create a high-performing, customer-focused culture that delivers quality, accuracy, and responsiveness.
Drive employee engagement, capability development, and succession planning within the team.
Ensure effective knowledge management, process documentation, and cross-training across the team.



CRM Operations & Service Management


Own operational delivery of Microsoft Dynamics CRM support services across the European Commercial organisation.
Ensure CRM configuration, workflows, user access, security roles, and business rules are effectively managed and maintained.
Lead management of CRM incidents, service requests, escalations, and enhancement demands.
Act as the senior escalation point for complex system issues and business-critical incidents.
Monitor CRM system performance, user adoption, and service effectiveness across supported markets.



Commercial Reporting & Analytics


Lead the production and delivery of standardized and ad hoc commercial reporting across Europe.
Ensure reporting outputs provide timely, accurate, and actionable business insights.
Work with Bi and Analytics teams to input to the development and maintenance of CRM dashboards, scorecards, KPIs, and management reporting.
Drive standardization of reporting methodologies, definitions, and governance across markets.
Partner with Commercial Excellence and Sales Leadership to identify reporting requirements and support business decision making.
Promote automation and simplification of reporting processes through Power BI, Power Automate, and other digital solutions.
Define and govern commercial KPI definitions and reporting standards across European markets
Prioritize reporting requirements with Commercial Excellence and the Commercial Intellingence Analytics & BI Team.
Ensure business definitions and reporting rules are consistently applied across CRM reporting.



CRM Data Governance & Quality


Establish and maintain CRM data governance standards, controls, and operating procedures.
Ensure data completeness, integrity, consistency, and compliance across all supported markets.
Lead regular audits, data quality reviews, and corrective action plans.
Define and monitor data quality KPIs and reporting metrics.
Partner with Commercial, Compliance, and Data Privacy teams to ensure adherence to governance requirements.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance data quality and system effectiveness.
Own the business glossary and standard business definitions for CRM operational reporting
Ensure CRM data structures support reusable analytics and future AI-enabled capabilities



Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership


Serve as the primary operational interface between the European Commercial CoE and CRM Operations & Reporting team.
Build strong relationships with Commercial Excellence, Sales Leadership, Marketing, Business Unit stakeholders, and Global CoE teams.
Translate business requirements into scalable CRM and reporting solutions.
Provide recommendations and insights to support commercial effectiveness, customer engagement, and sales performance.
Represent CRM Operations & Reporting in governance forums, leadership meetings, and transformation initiatives.
Ensure stakeholder expectations are regularly reviewed and aligned with service delivery objectives.
Act as the primary business partner to the Commercial Intelligence Analytics & BI TEam for prioritization of reporting capabilities and operational data requirements.



Continuous Improvement & Transformation


Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, efficiency, automation, and user experience.
Lead implementation of new CRM capabilities, reporting enhancements, and process optimization opportunities.
Support commercial transformation programmes and digital initiatives impacting CRM and reporting processes.
Identify opportunities to standardize ways of working across European markets through enhanced data products, automation and emerging AI capabilities
Foster a culture of innovation and operational excellence within the team.



Compliance, Risk & Controls


Ensure CRM and reporting processes comply with company policies, GDPR, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain robust controls surrounding CRM access management, data integrity, and reporting accuracy.
Support internal and external audits and ensure remediation actions are completed effectively.
Maintain documentation, audit evidence, process maps, and control records.
Mitigate operational risks through effective governance and control frameworks.



Key Stakeholders You Will Support


European Commercial Centre of Excellence (CoE)
Sales Excellence & Commercial Effectiveness Teams
Sales Directors and Sales Managers
Regional Commercial Leadership Teams
Business Unit Leadership
Global Sales & Marketing Centre of Excellence
IT and CRM Product Owners
CRM Service Desk
Data & Analytics Teams
Compliance, Audit & Data Privacy Teams



People Leadership Responsibilities


Lead and develop a team of CRM Analysts
Manage performance, development, coaching, and succession planning.
Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
Ensure team capability aligns with evolving CRM and reporting needs.
Champion Convatec values and leadership behaviours.



Skills & Competencies

Experience & Qualifications


Degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related discipline
Previous experience in the healthcare industry is highly preferred and will be considered a strong advantage
Significant experience supporting CRM operations, reporting, commercial excellence, or sales effectiveness functions.
Experience leading teams within a shared services, GBS, commercial operations, or sales support environment.
Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics CRM and reporting platforms.
Proven track record of stakeholder management across commercial, IT, and business leadership teams.
Experience delivering process improvements, transformation initiatives, and operational excellence programmes.
Demonstrated ability to lead commercial reporting transformation, automation or digital initiatives.



Technical / Functional


Strong knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM administration, governance, and operational support.
Strong understanding of commercial processes, sales effectiveness, and CRM operating models.
Experience leading CRM support, reporting, or shared services teams.
Strong understanding of data governance, quality management, and compliance requirements.
Experience managing service delivery, SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance.
Experience working within global or regional matrix organisations.
Commercial data literacy
KPI Governance
Data product mindset
Ability to translate commercial business requirements into scalable analytical solutions



Leadership & Behavioural


Strong people leadership and coaching capability.
Customer-focused with a strong service delivery mindset.
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Strategic thinker with strong operational execution capability.
Solutions-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.
Strong planning, prioritisation, and organisational skills.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and lead through change.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Strong accountability and ownership mindset.
Demonstrates collaboration, courage, and resilience in a complex stakeholder environment.
Demonstrates curiosity and embraces data-driven innovation to continuously improve commercial capabilities.

aim higher and really own your work. You’ll be encouraged and

supported to make things happen, too. It can be challenging. But, as

the progress you make will help improve the lives of millions, it’ll be

worth it.

This is work that’ll move you.

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer-Commercial Intelligence
Description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?





We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 










Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 










It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 










Ready to awaken your best with us? 










You'll join the Commercial Intelligence team, a cross-functional, domain-focused team of Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Analysts. The team owns profitability metrics for the entire business. It is also taking its first steps in bringing website and revenue data together, so we can see the full funnel from first visit to final margin.   Roles in the team have fluid borders. You won't hand work over a wall. You'll pick up tasks from your teammates, and they'll pick up yours. You'll build with dbt and Redshift, own what you ship, and help shape how we use AI in and around our data work.  







What you will do:



Own the T in ELT within the Commercial Intelligence domain, from raw data to trusted, analysis-ready models


Make data modelling decisions based on Kimball's design principles, and help the team apply them consistently


Extend the core data warehouse model with new data points


You'll start with profitability metrics and connect web analytics and revenue data into one funnel view


Work closely with Data Engineers and Data Analysts in one team


You'll pick up ingestion, pipeline and analysis work when the team needs it, and share your modelling knowledge in return


Support development with and around AI. That includes using AI tools to speed up your own engineering work, and building well-documented, reliable data foundations that AI use cases can build on


Ensure data integrity, consistency and security


Set up proactive data monitoring and alerting


Build strong relationships with stakeholders in E-Commerce, Marketing and other commercial teams, and with upstream and downstream data teams


Contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team culture


Manage several projects at once in a fast-paced, agile environment










Who we're looking for:



At least 5 years of experience in Analytics Engineering  Strong SQL and dbt skills  Solid Python skills


A very strong grasp of Kimball modelling principles, and the ability to explain them well enough to bring others along


Comfort working across disciplines


You enjoy engineering and analysis work alongside modelling, and you're happy to learn from teammates with different strengths


Curiosity about AI. You already use it in your work, or you're keen to start, and you have ideas on how it can improve data development and data products


Analytical and problem-solving skills, including a good sense for the commercial questions behind the data


Strong communication and interpersonal skills


Proven ability to work autonomously and drive projects from idea to production







Nice to have:





Experience with e-commerce, web analytics or marketing funnel data


Experience with profitability, margin or financial reporting metrics


Experience building semantic layers or documentation that AI tools can use










What we offer:



Maturing Scale-Up: We’re part of the 13–20% of start-ups that transition to scale-up. This is a rare stage where we refine systems without losing agility. It’s where start-up energy meets scalable impact - and where people can build the next version of Emma


Empowerment to Impact: Every Emmie owns part of our success with accountability. It’s about seeing it, owning it, doing it – something that is valued and measured in development


Growth & Learning Journey: We live by the 70/20/10 model – with 70% on the job, 20% from others, 10% structured training. We invest in your growth with trainings and coaching to get you to the top of your game


Emma-zing Community: We hire selectively which means working with smart, collaborative people who care deeply. It’s a community built by Emmies for Emmies


Next Level Global: With 60+ nationalities across 4 offices, global collaboration is part of our values. You’ll work across cultures, perspectives, and time zones


Flexibility: Our Technology team's remote work policy allows for great flexibility. (Please note that the role requires being based in Portugal or Germany)














Become an Emmie 








We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 




It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 




Ready to awaken your best with us? 




You'll join the Commercial Intelligence team, a cross-functional, domain-focused team of Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers and Data Analysts. The team owns profitability metrics for the entire business. It is also taking its first steps in bringing website and revenue data together, so we can see the full funnel from first visit to final margin.   Roles in the team have fluid borders. You won't hand work over a wall. You'll pick up tasks from your teammates, and they'll pick up yours. You'll build with dbt and Redshift, own what you ship, and help shape how we use AI in and around our data work.  



What you will do:

  • Own the T in ELT within the Commercial Intelligence domain, from raw data to trusted, analysis-ready models

  • Make data modelling decisions based on Kimball's design principles, and help the team apply them consistently

  • Extend the core data warehouse model with new data points

  • You'll start with profitability metrics and connect web analytics and revenue data into one funnel view

  • Work closely with Data Engineers and Data Analysts in one team

  • You'll pick up ingestion, pipeline and analysis work when the team needs it, and share your modelling knowledge in return

  • Support development with and around AI. That includes using AI tools to speed up your own engineering work, and building well-documented, reliable data foundations that AI use cases can build on

  • Ensure data integrity, consistency and security

  • Set up proactive data monitoring and alerting

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders in E-Commerce, Marketing and other commercial teams, and with upstream and downstream data teams

  • Contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team culture

  • Manage several projects at once in a fast-paced, agile environment





Who we're looking for:

  • At least 5 years of experience in Analytics Engineering  Strong SQL and dbt skills  Solid Python skills

  • A very strong grasp of Kimball modelling principles, and the ability to explain them well enough to bring others along

  • Comfort working across disciplines

  • You enjoy engineering and analysis work alongside modelling, and you're happy to learn from teammates with different strengths

  • Curiosity about AI. You already use it in your work, or you're keen to start, and you have ideas on how it can improve data development and data products

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, including a good sense for the commercial questions behind the data

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Proven ability to work autonomously and drive projects from idea to production




Nice to have:



  • Experience with e-commerce, web analytics or marketing funnel data

  • Experience with profitability, margin or financial reporting metrics

  • Experience building semantic layers or documentation that AI tools can use





What we offer:

  • Maturing Scale-Up: We’re part of the 13–20% of start-ups that transition to scale-up. This is a rare stage where we refine systems without losing agility. It’s where start-up energy meets scalable impact - and where people can build the next version of Emma

  • Empowerment to Impact: Every Emmie owns part of our success with accountability. It’s about seeing it, owning it, doing it – something that is valued and measured in development

  • Growth & Learning Journey: We live by the 70/20/10 model – with 70% on the job, 20% from others, 10% structured training. We invest in your growth with trainings and coaching to get you to the top of your game

  • Emma-zing Community: We hire selectively which means working with smart, collaborative people who care deeply. It’s a community built by Emmies for Emmies

  • Next Level Global: With 60+ nationalities across 4 offices, global collaboration is part of our values. You’ll work across cultures, perspectives, and time zones

  • Flexibility: Our Technology team's remote work policy allows for great flexibility. (Please note that the role requires being based in Portugal or Germany)







Become an Emmie 



We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

About Vantiva

Pushing the Edge

Vantiva (Euronext Paris: VANTI) is a global technology leader in connectivity technologies. For over 130 years, we have delivered solutions that connect what matters most. Today, we continue to redefine connectivity with industry-leading broadband, video, and IoT-driven smart systems that elevate how people live, work, and connect globally.

Vantiva combines a customer-focused approach with decades of software development, electronics hardware design, and flexible supply chain expertise to deliver high-quality solutions at scale. This proficiency has positioned us as a trusted provider to leading network service providers, enterprise customers, and consumers around the world.

Our strong commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices has earned us multiple Gold and Platinum Medals from EcoVadis for environmental and social performance. These awards place us among the top 2% of organizations in our category evaluated globally.

With our headquarters in Paris and major offices in Australia, Brazil, China, India, South Korea, the United Kingdom, and the United States, we serve a diverse global customer base.

For more information, please visit vantiva.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X (Twitter).

Junior Demand Planning Analyst

Job Description

As part of the Vantiva Connected Home Global Supply Chain Operations department, we are looking for a Demand Planning Analyst who enjoys working in a challenging, ever-changing environment and who enjoys rolling up their sleeves to get the job done. A self-motivated individual who is proficient in collaborating with Business Operations and other stakeholders to deliver quality, high-accuracy data and reporting, drive tasks to completion on time, and support strategic priorities with a focus on team success.

Key Responsibilities


Support the S&OP process with Business Operations to establish consensus forecasts (including monthly turnover and what-if analysis)
Analyze variations of multiple data such as sales, consensus, constrained, and management forecasts, sales order coverage. Propose the best scenario to drive the supply chain accordingly on weekly basis following the S&OP deadlines.
Proposes weekly requirements (GOP) to meet consensus forecasts in budgets.
Demand management (shipping request) as a key input for the back office to be used with our manufacturing partners such as ODM, OEM, etc.
Master Data Management, Improved Automation of Supply Chain Tools
Support for product lifecycle management from NPI to end-of-life, risk reduction.
Monitor and control inventory levels
Support buffer stock programs (finished goods, ...)
Generate key business outcomes around customer intimacy (internal and external), understanding market trends, and products.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (like NPI/SFT/Bus.Ops/CSR/Logistics/Finance) to ensure accurate exchange of business data (like quantity/revenue at planning horizon) during the products lifecycle.


Skills


Master’s or bachelor’s degree in operations and supply chain management, Business Planning or +5 years of professional experience as a Demand Planning Analyst
Strong analytical skills with the ability to understand and develop insights into complex business data (from collection, analysis to outcome)
Attention to detail and a keen sense of urgency and deadlines
A good command of Microsoft Office tools is required (PowerBI, PowerAutomate, Excel, AI etc.)
Kinaxis Rapid Response knowledge is required
SAP skills are not mandatory but are preferable
Apics CPIM or CSCP certifications are an advantage as well as an understanding of Lean principles
Comfortable in a remote and international teamwork environment; Self-motivated and results-oriented
Strong organizational skills, strong communication and presentation skills, and ability to influence internal direction
Language(s): English required; French and Spanish are an advantage


Location


Portugal - Lisbon
Alternate Location(s): #N/A


Our most important asset is our People.

Vantiva’s success greatly relies on our people’s energy, motivation, and talent.

We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that embraces and celebrates diversity as we believe our differences drive our creativity, and innovation.

We are proactive in supporting equality and maintaining an inclusive work environment, developing, and enhancing career opportunities for all.

Vantiva is committed to ensuring that all its employees receive a fair wage that is sufficient to live with dignity.

Title: Sales Operations Specialist
Description:
Who are we?

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

What will you contribute?

As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting the sales organization by ensuring operational excellence, maintaining CRM data integrity, and delivering actionable business insights. You will collaborate closely with sales teams and cross-functional stakeholders to optimize processes, support deal execution, and drive data-driven decision-making.

This is an excellent opportunity for a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional who enjoys problem-solving, process improvement, and working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities & Deliverables

As a Sales Operations Analyst, You Will


Provide operational support to the sales organization by resolving requests and inquiries submitted through the Sales Operations Support Services queue.
Support Executive Deal Desk activities, including documenting discussions, tracking action items, and ensuring CRM records are accurately maintained.
Partner with stakeholders to develop reports, dashboards, and analyses that support business priorities and sales performance monitoring.
Gather business requirements and recommend effective solutions to address operational challenges and process gaps.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of sales processes, systems, and best practices.
Deliver guidance and training to regional sales teams on Salesforce and pricing-related processes.
Support CRM enhancement initiatives by documenting business requirements, test scenarios, and user acceptance testing activities.
Assist with testing and validation of system changes prior to production deployment.
Help ensure high standards of data quality, reporting accuracy, and operational efficiency across the sales organization.
Leverage AI to enhance productivity, streamline routine tasks, validate outputs against trusted sources, and translate AI-generated insights into informed business decisions.


Required Experience


Bachelor's degree.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into recommendations.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong presentation skills using PowerPoint.
Working knowledge of CRM platforms, with Salesforce experience considered an advantage.
Understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting practices is a plus.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.


What We Are Looking For


A proactive and self-motivated professional who takes ownership and drives results.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
A naturally curious and analytical mindset.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A collaborative team player who can build effective relationships across functions and regions.
Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems, tools, and processes.
The ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and deadlines.


Benefits

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

Well‑being: Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

Health & Financial Security: Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.*

Sustainability: Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

Inclusion: Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

Recognition: Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.


Specific benefits may vary by location.


At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

Title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Portugal
Description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.




With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.




We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.







We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to design, maintain, and evolve data models that power business intelligence and analytical solutions. In this role, you will own the layered dbt data model, enabling reliable data consumption across Power BI and downstream applications.




You will play a key role in supporting the development of a pricing engine, enhancing item categorization and price elasticity analysis, and harmonizing KPIs across regions to establish a consistent, data-driven pricing methodology.


Responsibilities



Own and evolve the layered dbt data model, ensuring reliable, consistent, and well-structured data for Power BI and downstream consumers


Develop and maintain data transformation workflows using dbt and SQL, following best practices for modularity, testing, documentation, and maintainability


Extend existing data models to support the pricing engine MVP, including item categorization and price elasticity analysis


Harmonize business KPIs across regions, ensuring consistent definitions and calculations to support a common pricing methodology


Build and optimize analytical data solutions using Databricks and Azure


Apply Python where needed to support data processing, analysis, and automation


Develop and maintain data models for Power BI, enabling accurate reporting and effective business insights


Ensure data quality, consistency, and usability across analytical models and downstream applications


Collaborate with business stakeholders, data teams, and regional teams to translate analytical requirements into scalable data solutions


Contribute to continuous improvements in data architecture, modeling practices, and analytics engineering standards




Requirements for this challenge



Strong experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related data-focused role


Advanced proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with dbt


Experience designing and maintaining layered data models for analytics and business intelligence


Experience with Databricks and Azure data environments


Proficiency in Python for data processing, analysis, or automation


Experience with Power BI, particularly data modeling and preparing data for reporting and analytics


Strong understanding of data quality, data validation, and consistent metric definitions


Ability to translate business requirements into robust, reusable data models


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data accuracy


Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with stakeholders across different regions




Nice to Have



Experience supporting pricing, revenue optimization, or commercial analytics initiatives


Knowledge of price elasticity, product categorization, and pricing performance metrics


Experience harmonizing KPIs and business definitions across regions or markets


Familiarity with modern data architecture and scalable analytical data platforms


Experience with data testing, documentation, lineage, and governance practices


Ability to balance technical modeling decisions with business priorities and analytical needs















Why join us?




 




- Competitive Salary  




- Generous paid vacation days




- Generous sick time 




- 100% paid health & dental benefits starting day one 




- Annual profit-sharing distribution 




- Paid parental leave 




- Dedicated career advisor  




And so much more…




 




Collaboration is our superpower, diversity unites us, and excellence is our standard. 




We value diverse identities and life experiences, fostering a diverse, inclusive, and safe work environment. We encourage applications from diverse and underrepresented groups to our job positions.

Aiming to support national financial institutions and in the context of its European Network, PwC created, in January 2015, the Financial Services Risk & Regulation (FSRR) Department, fully focused on risk and regulation areas, covering diverse subjects such as strategic risk management, governance and internal organization, management frameworks and advanced risk quantification models (credit, interest rate, liquidity, ESG, etc.), business innovation and transformation, and the design of bank recovery and resolution plans.

For this purpose, PwC brought together a unique combination of professionals with extensive experience in banking, capital markets, supervision, and environmental engineering, as well as in the implementation and/or evaluation of advanced risk management solutions, benefiting from access to international best practices.

Promoting The Ongoing Specialization Of Its Resources, The Department Is Now Organized Into Four Thematic Areas, With Coordination And Cooperation Ensured Across


Risk Modelling, Data & Analytics
Credit Risk Transformation
Compliance, RegTech & Web3
Risk Management Solutions


With this opportunity, you will be able to participate in challenging, inspiring, and highly demanding projects, either with the main national players in the financial system or through PwC's European Network, a condition we consider essential for the personal and professional growth of our collaborators.

By choosing us, you're...

Choosing a company that believes in boldness and in making things happen. That believes opportunities can be found anywhere. That looks to the future with confidence, recognizing technology as our ally.

Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Management, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Physics, or Engineering
Analytical profile, capable of understanding and computing complex business-related problems with a desire for continuous learning

Advanced proficiency in MS Office tools (MS Excel and MS PowerPoint) and knowledge of programming languages (Python, SAS, R, SQL, etc.) - preferred condition

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
📈 At Finsolutia we keep expanding!📈

For this reason, we are looking for a Data Engineer (ETL/SQL/BI) with at least 4-5 years of experience performing similar duties to join our Data Team in Lisbon. Thus, we encourage you to apply and become part of this great team.💪💪

💻What will you do on a day-to-day basis?💻


Develop and implement advanced T-SQL procedures and functions, ensuring efficiency and scalability.
Use Databricks PySpark & SparkSQL to integrate data efficiently into Data Warehouse.
Design and build impactful Power BI reports and dashboards (Operational, Strategic & Analytical) using DAX, Power Query, and advanced data modelling.
Define and implement best practices, guidelines, and repeatable processes to drive efficiency and quality.
Deliver insights that help the business monitor KPIs and make informed, data-driven decisions.
Creating complex DAX calculations and measures to support data analysis.
Ensuring data security and compliance with best practices.
Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Power BI reports.
Ensure the reliability and performance of developed reports and dashboards for both internal and external users.


🔎 What knowledge and skills will you need to have to succeed in the position?🔍


At least 4 years of professional experience in an Enterprise environment or 5 years in any industry sector.
Strong expertise in T-SQL (advanced level) and performance optimization.
Solid experience with ETL processes.
Proficiency in developing and tuning Power BI dashboards, datasets, DAX, and SQL for optimal performance.
Proven experience with Databricks.
Good knowledge of Python. Knowledge of Powershell is a plus.
Fluency in English.
Knowledge of Portuguese will be positively valued.


🏆What Will Make You Stand Out (Soft Skills) 🏆


Self-motivated, proactive, and autonomous.
Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
A commitment to quality and testing excellence.
A team player, focused on achieving results.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions.


🔝What can we offer you?🔝


To be part of a dynamic and constantly growing company.
To be in an excellent work environment that will favor your professional development.
You will have a competitive and flexible remuneration.
Flexibility in and out of the office.
You will have a package of social benefits.
The offer includes a competitive salary.


Come and join our team!

At Finsolutia, we evaluate all candidates fairly and equitably, ensuring equal opportunities for all applicants based solely on the skills, experience, and competencies required for the role. No candidate in this process will be discriminated against on the basis of race, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, or any other personal characteristic. Our commitment is to ensure an inclusive environment and equal opportunities for all candidates.

Privacy Note

Please note that the personal data collected through this channel will be used exclusively for the professional management of the recruitment process in question. Your data will be processed and stored by Finsolutia Spain SLU in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of April 27, 2016 (GDPR). This information will be retained for a maximum period of 4 years in the event you participate in a recruitment process. You may, at any time, object to the storage and processing of your data, withdraw your consent, and exercise your rights of access, rectification, and erasure under the applicable regulations.

To exercise these rights, you may contact us in person or by post, enclosing a copy of your ID, at:

Calle Cardenal Marcelo Spínola 14, 4th Floor, 28016 Madrid, Spain

Title: Data Engineer (Databricks)
Description:
Do you want to be part of a company that specializes 100% in its own #Data & #Analytics projects? If so, keep reading! 👀

Even though we are relatively unknown to the general public, at SDG we work for half of the IBEX-35 groups and other international companies. Thanks to the analytics boom, we are growing steadily and have been helping our clients understand and analyse their data since 1994.




What makes us different? 🧐

In our projects, data and technology are the leaders, we will train you to be able to work with the latest in the market (we have an innovation area where we promote new partnerships with technology manufacturers and R&D centers).
You will have all the opportunities to develop your best self, with a completely customized career plan in which you will learn on your own and also have the support of your colleagues. You will set your own time, you will talk to your manager every six months to share feedback and new challenges, and based on your results, there will be a salary review.
We are a big family, from the first moment we will try to make your life easier. Your colleagues and the rest of the team will always have a smile on their faces and will be ready to help and support you.
You will collaborate and work on a daily basis with great references (technical and/or business), they will be happy to teach you as much as possible and will be proud to see you grow.
Smartwork is possible with us. You will experience a way of working where everyone manages their own time.
We are a brand with purpose. We believe that diversity and inclusion help promote a culture of creativity, allowing us to overcome new situations and challenges as an organization committed to people and society.
Getting into more formal matters, but not less important, we offer a permanent contract, we want you to stay with us for a long time! A competitive salary according to your level of training and experience (don't worry, we will discuss this aspect in the first interview and inform you if your expectations are aligned).




We could go on and on about what makes us special, and we'd love to do it in a phone call. For now, let's show you some details that we're sure you'll find interesting 👇🏼







What will be your mission? ✍

Analysis, design and development of solutions and projects in the field of data engineering in Business Intelligence.
Data processing and development of ETL processes.
Creation and modeling of Data Marts in relational, dimensional and/or table environments.
Build and maintain positive relationships with client staff at all levels;
Be updated on the latest technological trends in the field of Analytics.







What will make you succeed in this position? 👇

Bachelor/Master in a field that emphasizes data analysis (Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, Engineering or Statistics).
Experience over 5 years in the field of Analytics, ideally in service/consulting companies.
Experience using Azure Databricks for data processing and analysis.
Proficiency in Python programming and SQL Server.
Innovative spirit with balanced customer, business and technology orientation.
Interest in challenges, commitment, integrity, maturity, ability to work as a team and a high sense of responsibility.
Fluent level of English.







Finally, we would like to tell you about the stages of our selection process.




In Our Processes You Will Do 3️ Meetings

First contact with our People First area (where we will discuss professional growth, salary band and define which areas suit you).
Second technical session where you can surprise us with all your knowledge and skills in technological environments (so we can offer you a project that matches your knowledge and interests).
Meeting with the person in charge of the team you will be joining in order to solve any doubts that may have emerged during the process.







If you have passed all the phases, good news! You will receive a call from People First where we will present our offer for you to join us, and we will be able to answer any questions you may have. When you confirm that you want to be part of the SDG family, we will start preparing everything to welcome you with great enthusiasm.




You can't join us now, but you are interested in SDG Group? Don't worry, you can go through the selection process now and we will consider you for the next job opportunities that match your professional profile.




JOIN NOW, WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

#WeAreSDG #SDGGroup #WhySDG

Title: Técnico/a Júnior de Sistemas e Dados – Lisboa
HTML:
A Newrest Portugal está a reforçar a sua equipa e procura um(a) Técnico/a de Aplicação ERP (Winrest) para integrar a nossa equipa em Lisboa, na zona do Aeroporto.

Se tens interesse por tecnologia, sistemas, dados e processos, és organizado/a, curioso/a e gostas de perceber como os processos funcionam, esta pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para desenvolveres o teu percurso profissional.

Não precisas de ser especialista em ERP - procuramos sobretudo vontade de aprender, capacidade analítica e facilidade em trabalhar com diferentes equipas.

O que vais fazer?

  • Apoiar na criação, atualização e manutenção de informação no sistema Winrest;
  • Garantir a qualidade e atualização dos dados existentes no sistema;
  • Apoiar os utilizadores na utilização do ERP e na resolução de questões do dia a dia;
  • Acompanhar e validar a utilização do sistema pelas diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Identificar erros ou inconsistências e apoiar na sua correção;
  • Apoiar na criação e análise de relatórios e indicadores;
  • Trabalhar com ferramentas como Excel, Power BI e Winrest;
  • Participar na melhoria de processos e na otimização da utilização do sistema;
  • Contactar diariamente com diferentes áreas da empresa, como Operações, Compras, Produção e Logística.

O que procuramos?

  • Licenciatura em Gestão, Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Operações, Informática, Engenharia ou áreas similares;
  • Interesse por sistemas, tecnologia e análise de dados;
  • Bons conhecimentos de Excel;
  • Conhecimentos de Power BI serão valorizados;
  • Boa capacidade de organização e atenção ao detalhe;
  • Capacidade analítica e gosto pela resolução de problemas;
  • Facilidade de comunicação e gosto pelo trabalho em equipa;
  • Proatividade, curiosidade e vontade de aprender;
  • Bons conhecimentos de inglês.

O Que Valorizamos

  • Experiência em ambientes operacionais com elevado volume de informação.
  • Participação em projetos de implementação ou melhoria de sistemas ERP.
  • Conhecimentos de processos de compras, produção, logística ou operações.

O Que Oferecemos

  • Integração numa empresa multinacional e num ambiente dinâmico;
  • Formação e acompanhamento no desenvolvimento da função;
  • Oportunidade de aprender e trabalhar diretamente com um sistema ERP utilizado na operação;
  • Contacto com diferentes áreas do negócio;
  • Possibilidade de desenvolver competências em sistemas, dados, reporting e operações;
  • Perspetivas de desenvolvimento profissional.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – Marketing Measurement & Causal Inference (m/f/d)
Description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

As a Senior Data Scientist in our Commercial & Marketing Intelligence team at Flix, you can make an impact by owning and evolving our causal measurement practice — designing and running experiments that directly shape how we allocate our global marketing budget. You will work closely with a dedicated team across Marketing & Sales, Revenue Management, Reporting, and Engineering to ensure our incrementality evidence drives smarter, more transparent choices at scale.

About The Role


Own the design, execution, and continuous improvement of geo-based, time-based, and synthetic control experiment frameworks, ensuring methodological rigour and scalability across global markets and channels
Apply econometric and causal inference techniques — including difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and Bayesian structural time series — to measure the true incremental effect of marketing activities on bookings and revenue
Build and manage a structured test-and-learn programme across paid channels, identifying measurement gaps and prioritising experiments by expected business value
Contribute to the development and validation of attribution models (CLV-MTA and MMM), providing reliable benchmarks that reduce reliance on platform self-reported data
Translate complex causal findings into clear, actionable recommendations for a wide range of stakeholders including marketing teams, finance, and senior management
Review experiment designs, create thorough documentation, and help shape internal standards for how Flix measures marketing effectiveness across all channels


About You


Holds a Master's or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
Brings 5+ years of experience in a data science or quantitative research role, with hands-on expertise in designing and evaluating causal experiments such as geo experiments, time-series holdouts, or synthetic control studies
Demonstrate strong command of causal inference methods including difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series, or matched market testing
Proficient in Python,SQL, Power BI and experienced with statistical modelling libraries such as statsmodels, PyMC, CausalImpact, or equivalent tools
Comfortable with version control (Git), reproducible workflows, and cloud or data warehouse environments such as BigQuery or Snowflake
Proven ability to present statistical findings to non-technical audiences and contribute to strategic choices with data
Experience in marketing measurement, media mix modelling, or growth reporting is a plus — as is familiarity with Bayesian methods


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer


Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Title: Senior Marketing Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

As a Senior Data Scientist in our Commercial & Marketing Intelligence team at Flix, you can make an impact by owning and evolving our causal measurement practice — designing and running experiments that directly shape how we allocate our global marketing budget. You will work closely with a dedicated team across Marketing & Sales, Revenue Management, Reporting, and Engineering to ensure our incrementality evidence drives smarter, more transparent choices at scale.

About The Role


Own the design, execution, and continuous improvement of geo-based, time-based, and synthetic control experiment frameworks, ensuring methodological rigour and scalability across global markets and channels
Apply econometric and causal inference techniques — including difference-in-differences, synthetic control, and Bayesian structural time series — to measure the true incremental effect of marketing activities on bookings and revenue
Build and manage a structured test-and-learn programme across paid channels, identifying measurement gaps and prioritising experiments by expected business value
Contribute to the development and validation of attribution models (CLV-MTA and MMM), providing reliable benchmarks that reduce reliance on platform self-reported data
Translate complex causal findings into clear, actionable recommendations for a wide range of stakeholders including marketing teams, finance, and senior management
Review experiment designs, create thorough documentation, and help shape internal standards for how Flix measures marketing effectiveness across all channels


About You


Holds a Master's or PhD in Statistics, Econometrics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field
Brings 5+ years of experience in a data science or quantitative research role, with hands-on expertise in designing and evaluating causal experiments such as geo experiments, time-series holdouts, or synthetic control studies
Demonstrate strong command of causal inference methods including difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series, or matched market testing
Proficient in Python,SQL, Power BI and experienced with statistical modelling libraries such as statsmodels, PyMC, CausalImpact, or equivalent tools
Comfortable with version control (Git), reproducible workflows, and cloud or data warehouse environments such as BigQuery or Snowflake
Proven ability to present statistical findings to non-technical audiences and contribute to strategic choices with data
Experience in marketing measurement, media mix modelling, or growth reporting is a plus — as is familiarity with Bayesian methods


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer


Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

Title: GCP/Power BI Data Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled professional to join our Squad Data RUN – Data Entreprise, dedicated to ensuring the achievement of business objectives and the effective management of daily operations, including incident resolution and necessary evolutions. This role is pivotal in supporting the transformation of our Data product and requires a strong technical background in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and data transformations tools (ETL/ELT).

Our team focuses on developing and maintaining internal corporate tools utilizing a robust technical stack that includes the BPCE SI cloud ecosystem, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Linux, Python, Power BI, Composer, and SSIS. We employ various methods and tools to enhance our workflow, including Jira and Confluence for project management, Clarity for resource planning, PowerDesigner and DataGalaxy for data modeling, and Dataplex for data management. Our testing processes are supported by Jira Xray, and we adhere to the Agile framework within the BPCE Tempo ecosystem to ensure efficient and adaptive project delivery.

Main Responsibilities


Integrate into the Performance and Run team, collaborating closely with BPCE-SI business units to guarantee the stability of existing systems.
Manage incidents effectively, ensuring minimal impact on operations while implementing necessary system evolutions.
Develop specific components in the context of construction projects, contributing to the overall enhancement of our data capabilities.
Employ Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery and Composer, to optimize data management and analysis.
Utilize Power BI for reporting and visualization, alongside data integration tools such as SSIS to ensure seamless data flow.
Work under the supervision of a squad lead to ensure optimal coordination and successful project execution.
Engage in proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical requirements.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with a strong understanding of data management and integration practices.
Expertise in Power BI and data integration tools such as SSIS.
Knowledge of programming languages, particularly Python and SQL, for data analysis and manipulation.
Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in daily stand-ups and iterative development practices.
French proficiency is mandatory (B2 level, minimum).


Soft Skills


Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with business units.
Demonstrated ability to understand and prioritize user requirements effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills for effective incident management and minimizing operational impact.
Proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into technical requirements.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
