Title: Data Analyst
HTML:
We are looking for a data analyst who can also develop practical tools. The main responsibility is to analyze operational data from tolling and intelligent transportation products. The candidate will use SQL and Excel to prepare data, investigate results, identify problems, and communicate findings. When analysis work benefits from automation, the candidate will use Python, Linux, and scripting to build small utilities and repeatable workflows. This is primarily a data-analysis role, not a general software-development role.

What The Candidate Must Have

Data analysis

  • Practical professional experience analyzing data;
  • Good working knowledge of SQL;
  • Good working knowledge of Excel, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, and charts;
  • Ability to clean, compare, summarize, and validate data;
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies, patterns, and outliers;
  • Ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical people.

Development support

  • Practical experience with Python;
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools;
  • Familiarity with scripting and task automation;
  • Ability to create or adapt small tools that make analysis faster or more reliable.

Working style

  • Strong analytical skills and critical-thinking ability;
  • Careful and methodical when handling data;
  • Able to question assumptions, assess evidence, and distinguish facts from interpretations;
  • Able to document assumptions, steps, and conclusions;
  • Highly autonomous and accountable for progressing work independently;
  • Comfortable working in an exploratory environment where the problem and expected outcome may not always be fully scoped;
  • Comfortable collaborating with software and operations teams;
  • Good communication in English, spoken and written.

Typical work

  • Query and analyze operational data using SQL;
  • Use Excel to explore data, produce summaries, and communicate results;
  • Check data quality and investigate unexpected results;
  • Compare data from different systems or sources;
  • Prepare concise reports and recommendations;
  • Automate repetitive preparation and analysis tasks with Python and scripts;
  • Use Linux tools to inspect files, logs, and data-processing jobs;
  • Build lightweight utilities to support analysis when needed;
  • Keep analysis steps and results understandable to other team members.

Useful, But Not Required

  • Experience with Python data-analysis libraries such as pandas;
  • Experience with operational, event, sensor, image, or other high-volume data;
  • Experience working with software, systems, or operations teams;
  • Familiarity with Git;
  • Experience in tolling or intelligent transportation.

These are advantages, not mandatory requirements. Candidates should not be excluded because they lack a specific framework, database product, degree, or software-development methodology if they can demonstrate the core skills above.

Company Context

  • International company working on tolling and intelligent transportation products;
  • Work location: Lagoas Park, Oeiras;
  • Collaboration with software, systems, data, and operations teams;
  • Documentation and collaboration in English and Portuguese;
  • The required development and data environments will be provided.

Title: Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Revenue Intelligence
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket. Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



About the Role



As our business scales across 27 European markets, understanding the mechanics behind our financial performance and identifying new revenue streams is vital. We need an experienced analytical professional who can translate complex datasets into actionable business strategies and take ownership of high-impact initiatives.



To achieve this goal, we are hiring a Data Analyst (m/f/d) to join our Revenue Intelligence team. In this role, you will act as a key strategic partner to our leadership, working closely with our Head of Revenue Intelligence and Chief Revenue Officer, while collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Management and other teams.



You will focus on dissecting revenue dynamics, building predictive models and developing automated anomaly detection systems to safeguard and boost performance. You will leverage SQL and Python to run causal inference analyses, evaluate pricing initiatives and uncover performance drivers across our e-commerce ecosystem. Beyond technical execution, a key part of your mission will be data storytelling—translating advanced statistical concepts into clear, compelling insights for non-technical stakeholders.



This is an exciting opportunity for a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, proactive problem-solving and high visibility. You will have the direct space to pitch independent ideas, shape analytical frameworks and immediately influence commercial outcomes in a fast-paced scale-up environment.



What You Will Do



Monitor revenue and profit trends continuously across diverse e-commerce dimensions.



Build automated detection systems and frameworks to identify performance anomalies, early warning signals and degradation drivers.



Conduct deep root-cause analyses and apply causal inference methods to distinguish correlation from causation in business performance changes.



Quantify factor contributions to revenue shifts and evaluate commercial initiatives like pricing strategies or category launches.



Communicate analytical findings effectively to cross-functional partners and present actionable insights to senior leadership.



Utilize advanced tools, data processing models and modern analytics technologies to enhance team productivity and workflow automation.





Qualifications



Proven experience (5-7 years) in economic analysis, revenue management, or financial planning and analysis (FP&A), ideally within e-commerce, retail or tech.



Academic background in Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.



Strong technical proficiency in SQL for advanced data extraction and transformation.



Fluency in Python for data analysis, statistical modeling and analytical processing (e.g., pandas, numpy,etc ).



Solid understanding of statistics, econometrics, time series forecasting, regression and segmentation.



Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.



Proactive mindset with a collaborative approach and strong problem-solving drive.



Professional fluency in English.





Additional Information


Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

This job was posted on 31/08/2026 and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: Data Analyst
HTML:
Se procuras um projeto onde a tua capacidade analítica tenha impacto real na gestão financeira de operações críticas, e onde possas crescer num ambiente internacional e dinâmico, continua a ler…


Quem somos:

A NoeXa é uma tech consultancy focada em inovação e excelência, parte do grupo austríaco XRXES — cujo nome simboliza "Success".

Com sede em Lisboa, somos o centro de competência tecnológica do grupo, liderando projetos de transformação digital. Trabalhamos lado a lado com organizações públicas e privadas, combinando tecnologia, visão de negócio e foco no cliente para resolver desafios complexos e gerar impacto real.


Posição: Data Analyst

Regime de trabalho: Híbrido (3x por semana na região de Lisboa)


O contexto do projeto:

Vais integrar uma equipa responsável por analisar a atividade de ATMs do ponto de vista financeiro ao longo de toda a cadeia de valor — desde empresas de transporte de valores, passando por terminais, até às contas de suporte. O objetivo é identificar gaps entre o que é esperado e o que realmente acontece nesta operação, e garantir que são resolvidos junto das equipas certas.


O teu papel:

  • Extrair, tratar e agregar dados de diversas fontes para análise;
  • Analisar indicadores relativos à atividade de ATMs, cruzando dados de diferentes intervenientes da cadeia de valor (transporte de valores, terminais, contas de suporte);
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos com os gaps identificados;
  • Despoletar e acompanhar a resolução de gaps junto das equipas internas envolvidas;
  • Analisar faturas de fornecedores, validando-as face às ordens solicitadas;
  • Preparar conteúdos, apresentações e relatórios para clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar em reuniões de equipa.


O que valorizamos em ti:

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Job


As part of the global GM (Global Market) Brokerage team, BAU (Business As Usual) Support acts as a bridge between stakeholders of brokerage team as well as a between London and Lisbon teams
It is notably responsible for implementing and innovating possible technical MAOS' automations and admin tasks and supporting processes
It is created and designed to perform the different type of queries coming from the stakeholders as well as to have flexible and adjustable way of communication, according to the multiple stakeholders' languages and needs
BAU is also responsible to ensure all the Brokerage fees paid out of Europe, are being applied and paid according BNPP guidelines


Your Main Activities Are


Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of GM's brokers, ensuring data integrity and streamlined onboarding/offboarding processes
Act as the central lead for brokerage business management, providing key insights and reporting to support strategic decision-making
Monitor and reconcile brokerage fees by analysing trading activity against invoicing to ensure accuracy and prevent leakage
Serve as the primary analytical interface between internal trading desks and external suppliers regarding fee structures and usage
Maintain oversight of internal control frameworks surrounding broker activities through regular data-driven audits and monitoring
Identify and implement data-led initiatives to improve operational efficiency and drive cost-saving opportunities
Utilise spend analysis and market data to lead or support the negotiation of broker rate cards
Identify and propose initiatives to improve the efficiency of processes and/or cost efficiency


Profile And Skills To Success


Bachelors or Masters degree in Mathematics, Data Science or Engineering
Advanced level of Excel knowledge, intermediate level of Python and VBA
Advanced level of English
Good communication skills
Analytical mindset with attention to detail
Curious and proactive mindset


Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner


Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.


Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To


Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.


To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.


Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered.
In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

Title: Analista sênior
HTML:
A Arrow Global Portugal pretende reforçar a sua área de Finance através da integração de um(a) Senior Analyst para a equipa de Planning & Management Control, com atuação transversal sobre os diferentes negócios e áreas da organização.

A função visa impulsionar a capacidade analítica da equipa, assegurando a transformação de dados financeiros e operacionais em informação de gestão rigorosa, consistente e acionável.

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade analítica, elevada orientação para dados e sólido entendimento de indicadores de negócio, capaz de interpretar informação financeira e operacional complexa e transformá-la em insights claros, estruturados e relevantes para apoiar a tomada de decisão.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar os processos de budget, forecast e acompanhamento de performance, assegurando a preparação, tratamento e consolidação dos dados necessários aos exercícios conduzidos pela equipa de Planning & Management Control;
  • Recolher, estruturar e validar informação proveniente de diferentes fontes, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e integridade dos dados utilizados no reporting de gestão;
  • Desenvolver e manter reporting e dashboards de gestão, transformando dados financeiros e operacionais em informação clara e acessível para os diferentes stakeholders;
  • Apoiar a análise de desvios face ao orçamento, forecast e períodos anteriores, estruturando a informação e identificando tendências e principais drivers dos vários negócios do grupo em Portugal;
  • Trabalhar com diferentes bases de dados e fontes de informação, identificando inconsistências, gaps e oportunidades de melhoria na forma como os dados são recolhidos, tratados e apresentados;
  • Desenvolver e melhorar modelos de análise e ferramentas de Business Intelligence, promovendo a automatização e eficiência dos processos de reporting;
  • Utilizar Power BI e Excel para transformar dados em dashboards, análises e ferramentas de acompanhamento dos principais KPIs financeiros e operacionais;
  • Apoiar a construção e manutenção de modelos de dados que suportem os diferentes processos de Planning & Management Control;
  • Trabalhar transversalmente com as diferentes direcções financeiras e restantes áreas de Shared Services e de Negócio, assegurando o alinhamento das necessidades de informação e a adequada disponibilização dos dados;
  • Preparar análises ad hoc e suportar projetos de melhoria da função, nomeadamente ao nível de reporting, automatização, qualidade de dados e eficiência dos processos;
  • Identificar oportunidades para simplificar processos e melhorar a forma como a informação de gestão é produzida, analisada e disponibilizada.




Perfil Pretendido

  • Formação superior em Gestão, Economia, Finanças, Data Analytics ou área semelhante;
  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência profissional relevante em Management Control, Financial Reporting, FP&A, Business/Data Analytics ou funções semelhantes, preferencialmente em ambientes corporativos complexos;
  • Experiência no tratamento e análise de dados financeiros e/ou operacionais e na preparação de reporting de gestão;
  • Power BI com experiência prática na construção de dashboards e tratamento/modelação de dados;
  • Excel avançado, incluindo capacidade para trabalhar com grandes volumes de informação e desenvolver modelos de análise;
  • Conhecimentos de SQL serão valorizados;
  • Boa compreensão de conceitos de performance financeira, KPIs, P&L, orçamento e análise de desvios;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e atenção ao detalhe, com capacidade para identificar inconsistências, interpretar informação e encontrar os principais drivers dos resultados;
  • Capacidade para transformar informação complexa em reporting simples, estruturado e orientado para o utilizador;
  • Autonomia e sentido de responsabilidade, mantendo capacidade de trabalhar em articulação próxima com áreas financeiras e diferentes stakeholders;
  • Curiosidade, espírito crítico e orientação para a melhoria e automatização de processos;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e organização, com facilidade em trabalhar num contexto transversal e com múltiplas prioridades;
  • Fluência em português e inglês.


O que oferecemos

  • Integração numa função com impacto direto na produção de informação crítica para a gestão e para a tomada de decisão.
  • Exposição transversal às diferentes áreas de negócio, adquirindo uma visão abrangente da atividade e dos principais drivers de performance da organização.
  • Participação em processos de planeamento, análise de desempenho e acompanhamento da execução dos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Oportunidade de contribuir para a evolução das capacidades analíticas, modelos de reporting e processos de gestão da informação.
  • Desenvolvimento profissional num contexto exigente, dinâmico e orientado para a melhoria contínua.
  • Integração num Grupo sólido, diversificado e em fase de crescimento e transformação.


Horário e Local de Trabalho:

Full-Time/Lisboa

Benefícios de integrar a Arrow Global Portugal

Na Arrow Global Portugal promovemos uma cultura que valoriza o talento, o equilíbrio e o desenvolvimento contínuo. Este compromisso reflete‑se num conjunto de benefícios pensados para cuidar de quem faz parte da nossa equipa.


Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho flexível e baseado na confiança, que promove a autonomia, o bem‑estar e o equilíbrio entre a vida pessoal e profissional, com condições que permitem uma melhor gestão do tempo.


Apostamos no desenvolvimento contínuo através de oportunidades de aprendizagem e crescimento alinhadas com os objetivos individuais, bem como em perspectivas de progressão num contexto dinâmico e com projetos desafiantes. Tudo isto num ambiente assente em valores sólidos, com impacto positivo nas pessoas e na comunidade.

Title: Data Analytics Specialist
HTML:
Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

Cyber Defence Operations (CDO) is Vodafone Group’s Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence, accountable for protecting Vodafone, its customers and its services against global cyber risk.

The Analytics Specialist is responsible for developing cross-Cyber Defence analytics and insight products that provide a holistic, asset-centric view of Vodafone’s security, operational and risk posture.

The role works across CTU, CSOC, CDIR and Security Testing & Exposure Management to aggregate, model and interpret data from multiple platforms, helping identify systemic patterns, control weaknesses, operational trends and emerging risks.

The role translates complex technical and operational data into trusted, reusable analytics that support incident response, threat-led defence, vulnerability prioritisation, exposure reduction, control improvement and leadership decision-making.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and own cross-Cyber Defence analytics use cases that provide trend-based and asset-centric insight across threat, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability and exposure management domains;
  • Design and maintain end-to-end analytics pipelines, from data sourcing and modelling through to dashboards, insights and executive-ready outputs;
  • Aggregate and normalise data from multiple platforms including Elastic data lakes, Dynatrace, Power BI, cloud platforms and cyber security tooling, ensuring consistency, quality and reusability;
  • Develop asset-centric views that correlate telemetry across infrastructure, applications, services, incidents, vulnerabilities and security controls to support a joined-up understanding of risk and performance;
  • Produce long-term trend analysis, behavioural baselining and forecasting to identify emerging risks, control degradation, systemic issues and opportunities for improvement;
  • Build and maintain dashboards and analytical products that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight for technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Work across CTU, CSOC, Incident Management, STEM, and wider Technology, Network and Platform teams to shape analytics requirements, define success measures and ensure outputs align to real operational and strategic questions
  • Apply analytical and statistical techniques such as time-series analysis, clustering and regression to extract meaning from large, high-volume datasets;
  • Ensure analytics outputs are explainable, repeatable and trusted, with clear documentation, assumptions and data lineage;
  • Contribute analytical insight to strategic planning, operational reviews, risk discussions, investment decisions and control improvement initiatives across Vodafone;
  • Support the evolution of Cyber Defence analytics capabilities, including improved data models, shared metrics, and more effective use of security, operational and exposure data;
  • Contribute to cyber reporting, dashboards and briefings, ensuring accurate, timely and data-driven insights are shared with the right stakeholders


Who You Are

  • Demonstrable experience (typically 3–5 years) in data analytics, business intelligence, data science or a related analytical role;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience;
  • Working towards, or willingness to obtain, relevant certifications such as Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Fundamentals, or data analytics / data science certifications is desirable;
  • Strong experience in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, ideally within a cyber, technology or risk environment;
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate broad operational questions into scalable data models, metrics and visualisations;
  • Experience working with enterprise analytics and observability platforms such as Power BI, Elastic, Dynatrace, Splunk or similar;
  • Proven ability to work across large and complex datasets to identify trends, correlations, anomalies and emerging risks;
  • Comfortable engaging with stakeholders across cyber security, technology and leadership to understand problems and frame useful analytical questions;
  • Able to communicate insights clearly through visuals, storytelling and written narrative, tailored to different audiences;
  • Advanced capability in Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, visualisation and dashboard design;
  • Working knowledge of SQL and/or KQL for querying large-scale analytical datasets;
  • Experience using Python or similar languages for data preparation, analysis and statistical modelling is desirable;
  • Understanding of time-series analysis, trend analysis, statistical baselining and forecasting techniques;
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, data quality management and schema harmonisation across multiple data sources;
  • Practical understanding of cyber risk concepts across security monitoring, incident response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management and exposure management;
  • Ability to balance analytical rigour with pragmatism, delivering outputs that are useful, trusted and timely;
  • Experience integrating diverse data sources such as cloud platforms, endpoint telemetry, network/security tooling, threat intelligence feeds, vulnerability data and external exposure data;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and support both operational and leadership decision-making;
  • Fluency in English


Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.

What's In It For You

  • Hybrid Work Model - Flexible hybrid work model with 8-10 in-office days per month, managed by team leaders;
  • Vodafone Products and Services - Employees get a mobile phone, free communication plan, data card, and various discounts on services and products;
  • Recognition - Recognition programs for innovative, creative, high-potential employees and exemplary behaviors;
  • Health and Well-being - Well-being Program offers nutrition and psychological consultations, webinars, workshops, and discounts on various services and products;
  • Learning - Access to Communities of Practice and a customizable digital training platform with high-quality content (namely Harvard Business Publishing, Skillsoft and Speexx);
  • Local and International Mobility - Internal recruitment with local and international rotation opportunities across departments and roles


Who We Are

We are a leading international Telco, serving millions of customers. At Vodafone, we believe that connectivity is a force for good. If we use it for the things that really matter, it can improve people's lives and the world around us. Through our technology we empower people, connecting everyone regardless of who they are or where they live and we protect the planet, whilst helping our customers do the same.

Belonging at Vodafone isn't a concept; it's lived, breathed, and cultivated through everything we do. You'll be part of a global and diverse community, with many different minds, abilities, backgrounds and cultures. We're committed to increase diversity, ensure equal representation, and make Vodafone a place everyone feels safe, valued and included.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, please refer to https://careers.vodafone.com/application-adjustments/ for guidance.

Together we can.

Title: Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner
Description:
About The Company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category - the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy - full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner who will help us understand where the business makes money, where profit is lost, and which decisions can improve margins, cash flow, and overall performance. You will work closely with founders, finance, product, operations, and business teams to turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations. This role exists to help leadership make faster, better decisions based on real business numbers.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build and improve executive dashboards that show revenue, profit, margins, COGS, OpEx, refunds, payouts, cash flow, and key business metrics

Analyze profitability across products, customers, providers, geographies, channels, lead sources, and operational workflows

Create P&L analysis, gross margin analysis, contribution margin analysis, unit economics models, forecasts, and scenario analysis

Identify cost leaks, overspending, inefficient vendors, payment issues, margin risks, and other areas where the business can improve profit

Partner with finance, accounting, product, operations, sales, and marketing teams to connect business activity with financial outcomes

Reconcile business data with invoices, payouts, payment systems, taxes, accounting records, and financial reports

Present clear recommendations to founders and senior leadership on pricing, cost optimization, product profitability, hiring, and growth decisions

What Makes You a Strong Fit:

6-8+ years of experience in financial analytics, FP&A, data analytics, business analytics, or a similar role

Strong experience with financial modeling, P&L analysis, unit economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis

Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on experience with BigQuery

Strong experience with Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial modeling, reporting, and scenario analysis

Good understanding of accounting basics, financial statements, revenue, COGS, OpEx, gross margin, contribution margin, and cash flow

Clear communication in English, both spoken and written, with the ability to explain financial insights to founders, business teams, and non-finance stakeholders

Bonus if you have:

Experience with Python or another scripting language for data analysis and reporting automation

Experience with payment systems, accounting systems, CRM, ERP, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar tools

Experience in marketplace, SaaS, fintech, real estate, lead generation, or performance marketing businesses

Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership in a fast-moving business environment

Why You'll Love It Here:

You'll work at the core of a product-led, AI-powered startup where data drives every decision

Your work will ship fast and impact thousands of users

High autonomy, low bureaucracy: we trust you to own your domain

Remote-first culture with flexible hours and async-friendly communication

Salary (fixed base) ABOVE the market average

A smart, passionate team that moves fast, supports each other, and builds cool stuff

15 paid vacation days plus 5 paid sick days annually

Paid access to courses, books, and growth resources

Real decision-making power and ownership of your results

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Product Analyst at Air Apps, you will analyze both internal and external products to identify potential new functionalities, uncover bottlenecks, and provide data-driven insights to enhance user experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to interpret product performance, optimize features, and support strategic decision-making through actionable recommendations.

Responsibilities

Analyze product usage data to identify trends, friction points, and opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate competitor products to benchmark functionalities and propose innovative solutions.
Develop reports and dashboards to track key performance metrics.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to enhance product features based on data insights.
Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to validate new functionalities and improve user engagement.
Provide actionable insights to support product roadmap decisions.
Identify and address bottlenecks in user flows and product performance.

Requirements

Around 3+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills with experience in SQL, Python, or R for data analysis.
Proficiency with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude).
Understanding of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
Strong communication skills to present insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

What benefits are we offering?

Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
Annual Bonus
Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
Childcare support.
Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
Meals 100% free at the hub.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.

Application Disclaimer

At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

Compensation Range: €36K - €46K

Important Notice

Air Apps does not partner with nor is represented by any recruiting agencies, staffing firms, or third-party recruiters in connection with our hiring efforts. All legitimate communication regarding Air Apps opportunities will come exclusively from an official @airapps.com email address. Additionally, all open positions are published only through our official careers platform, Ashby.

If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent Air Apps from a different email domain, through a recruiting agency, or via a job posting source other than Ashby, please exercise caution. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies, and any such submissions will not be considered.

Title: CRM and SQL Database Analyst (M/F)
HTML:
The Tecnimede Group has 900 employees around the world looking to the future, united and focused on improving and preserving the health of all of us. Because we own the entire life cycle of medicines for human use, with our own factories located in Portugal and Morocco, and with a Research and Development center in Torres Vedras (Portugal).

We are 100% Portuguese, but also international, with a direct presence in more than 100 countries.


We are looking to strengthen our Marketing team with a CRM and SQL Database Analyst (M/F).


We are seeking an experienced CRM and SQL Database Analyst with background in the pharmaceutical industry to join our team.


The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and optimizing Salesforce CRM, supporting commercial and medical teams, maintaining data quality, and delivering actionable business insights through advanced SQL-based analysis and reporting.


This role requires a professional who understands pharmaceutical sales, customer engagement, healthcare professional (HCP) data management, and the importance of regulatory compliance in a highly regulated environment.


Responsibilities:


  • Managing and maintaining the company's CRM, ensuring that it is up-to-date and compliant with sector regulations;
  • Manage the database of HCPs and pharmacies, ensuring the accuracy, consistency and correct alignment of the commercial teams' dashboards;
  • Creating CRM data reports that meet the needs of the different Business Units;
  • Keeping up to date with the latest CRM trends and technologies.
  • Develop SQL queries for extracting, analyzing and integrating data from different sources
  • Create and maintain dashboards and interactive reports in Power BI, providing actionable insights to the marketing and sales teams;


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in economics, management, data analysis, mathematics, marketing or others;
  • 1-2 years of experience in CRM and data analysis;
  • Experience in CRM systems Salesforce, VEEVA, OCE or others;
  • Knowledge of SQL and experience in data analysis and modeling
  • Experience with data integration, BI tools (Power BI);
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting;
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory.


Additional skills:


  • Strong understanding of CRM architecture and functionalities, especially modules related to customer management, sales, marketing and service;
  • Certifications or trainings related to CRM or data management would be highly valued;
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) would be a plus
  • Experience in implementing Power BI and/or AI projects.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical sector is a plus;


In accordance with the provisions of the GDPR and other legislation in force on personal data protection, the contracting company guarantees that the processing of your personal data is lawful, fair, transparent and limited to the purposes for which your data was collected.

Title: Finance data analyst: Reporting and Master Data Management
Description:
Job Description:

Responsibilities - Your Mission

Digitalization

The jobholder will be accountable for the Digitalization of their own scope of activities (Reporting data transformation) and team members activities (Chargeback, Utilities...) with knowledge and practical application of essential coding languages including Python, SQL, AppScript. To use Gemini / AI and Skywise for automation purposes.

Master data Management

The jobholder will be accountable for the Master Data Management including coherence and consistency for the Sites & Services Programme scope and FMRE function scope.

In this role he/she is in charge of ensuring the maintenance and the updates of the following Master Data in the system:


Cost Element Group / Cost Element / Cost Nature (specific mapping)
Programme structure (Financial Activity / Financial product / Controlling Group / Sub Group / CPN) according to the guideline of the Programme controller
Master Data behind Corporate Project Numbers (CPNs) including Life Cycle Stage
Cost Center Hierarchy / Cost center Group / Cost Centre according to Function controller inputs
Mapping from Cost Centre to CPN (for Recurring costs) to ensure adherence to accounting principle
Team member access rights to financial and business tools (ICPT / ClicknBuy...)


Reporting Factory

The jobholder will be in charge of delivering to the entire team detailed monthly reporting related to:


Programme reporting (Profit & Loss)
Function reporting (detailed cost base)


He/she will be responsible to provide accurate data in the defined format and to deliver on due time the following:


Deliver Airbus Commercial (AI) operational reporting (Cost by Nature): Extracting, checking, compiling and filling the monthly reporting from the financial systems and delivering it to the Function controllers. It includes row data and reporting templates at Function and Domain level.


The jobholder will be in close relation with the Function controllers, but as well with the Cost accounting department and the Financial system teams.


Deliver and be responsible for the AI operational consolidation (Cost by Nature )
Deliver AI Programme reporting (Cost by Destination): extracting and checking the monthly reporting from the financial systems for Airbus Commercial and delivering it to the Programme controllers. It includes row data and P&L.


The jobholder will be in close relation with the Programme controller, but as well with the Consolidation team.


Deliver the Divisional consolidation (Cost by Nature): collecting and compiling Actuals from the other Division controllers (Airbus Defense and Space and Helicopters)
The jobholder will be the focal point for any improvement/change project or new tools (new SAP Analytics Cloud)
The jobholder will define yearly Reporting calendar and coordinate the delivery of all stakeholders


Requirements - our ideal candidate will have


Knowledge of tools such as SAP, IFRP, ClicknBuy is highly recommended
Knowledge of Python, SQL, AppScript, Gemini / AI and Skywise is highly recommended
Accounting and Controlling background
Continuous improvement mindset / Best practice sharing
Good at drumbeating and coordinating
Willingness to support others / Team spirit
Language: English mandatory


This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
Description:
Tem uma forte capacidade analítica, interesse pelo negócio e gosta de transformar dados em decisões comerciais? Gostaria de desempenhar um papel central no suporte às equipas de Vendas e Marketing numa empresa líder de mercado? Então esta oportunidade poderá ser para si.

A Empresa

A Coloplast é uma multinacional dinamarquesa que desenvolve e comercializa dispositivos médicos e produtos de saúde para diversas áreas terapêuticas. A nossa elevada quota de mercado e crescimento sustentado resultam da capacidade de oferecer soluções inovadoras e do elevado nível dos nossos profissionais.

A Posição

Esta é uma posição-chave para o sucesso comercial da subsidiária portuguesa, transformando dados em insights acionáveis e apoiando decisões estratégicas que impulsionam o crescimento do negócio.

A principal missão da função é fornecer informação e análises baseadas em factos para aumentar o desempenho das vendas, a produtividade e a excelência da execução comercial. Será necessária uma excelente capacidade analítica e aptidão para sintetizar grandes volumes de informação, transformando-os em formatos de fácil compreensão para os departamentos de Marketing e Vendas. A função reporta diretamente à Country Manager e integra o planeamento anual e os principais projetos comerciais e estratégicos da organização.

Principais Responsabilidades


Análise de dados: gestão e análise de dados de vendas sell-in e sell-out. Responsável pela relação com a hmR e pela gestão do contrato anual.
Segmentação, Targeting e Compliance: desenvolver e manter modelos de segmentação e definição de clientes prioritários, garantindo a eficiência da estratégia de visitas.
Manutenção do CRM (Salesforce): garantir a qualidade, integridade e completude dos dados, incluindo a área de negócio de consumo.
Pricing e gestão de grossistas: apoiar análises de preços e a gestão de armazenistas e grossistas farmacêuticos.
Suporte analítico à organização: desenvolver análises ad hoc e assegurar a qualidade das ferramentas analíticas e ficheiros Excel.
Apoio à gestão: suportar a equipa de liderança através de análises e recomendações estratégicas.




Perfil Procurado


Mentalidade analítica com forte orientação comercial.
Excelentes competências interpessoais e de comunicação.
Utilizador avançado de Excel; conhecimentos de Power BI serão valorizados.
Experiência com Salesforce ou outro sistema de CRM será considerada uma mais-valia.
Experiência mínima de 2 anos numa função analítica e/ou comercial.
Elevada atenção ao detalhe e rigor analítico.
Capacidade para comunicar conclusões complexas de forma simples e clara.
Orientação para resultados e melhoria contínua.
Fluência em português e inglês.




O Que Oferecemos

Integração numa empresa multinacional líder, com formação inicial e contínua, exposição a projetos estratégicos, ambiente internacional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.

Com uma agenda de crescimento ambiciosa, a Coloplast desenvolve e comercializa produtos e serviços que facilitam a vida de pessoas com necessidades íntimas de saúde. Emprega cerca de 16.000 pessoas e com produtos disponíveis em mais de 143 países, somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais em dispositivos médicos. Estamos em constante crescimento e sempre à procura de novas formas de avançar – exploramos, aprendemos e procuramos novas formas de fazer as coisas.

A Coloplast está comprometida em ser uma organização inclusiva, onde as pessoas trazem suas diferenças para o trabalho todos os dias, realizam o seu potencial e têm uma forte sensação de pertença porque – e não apesar – das suas diferenças. Portanto, incentivamos todos os candidatos qualificados a se inscreverem, independentemente do gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade, etnia, orientação sexual, crença religiosa ou capacidade física.

  • Trabalhar em projetos relacionados com gestão de risco, combate à fraude e branqueamento de capitais, compliance, governo de dados, continuidade de negócio e gestão de fornecedores;
  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados provenientes de diferentes sistemas e tecnologias para tratamento, identificação de padrões, tendências e indicadores de risco;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de tratamento de dados (ETL), garantindo a correta extração, transformação e integração de dados para responder a necessidades de negócio
  • Construir dashboards, reports e soluções de reporting para análise de risco, compliance, performance operacional e tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver modelos quantitativos e qualitativos para avaliação e previsão de riscos, utilizando técnicas estatísticas e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Realizar auditorias informáticas para avaliar a conformidade com os padrões e políticas de segurança estabelecidos;
  • Desenvolver soluções eficazes para garantir a resiliência operacional em face de interrupções ou desastres:
  • Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares na implementação de soluções tecnológicas em ambientes complexos.


És tu quem procuramos?

  • Formação académica em Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Data Science, Engenharia Eletrotécnica, Informática de Gestão ou áreas similares;
  • Entre 1 a 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento, análise de dados, automação, reporting, implementação de soluções tecnológicas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos em linguagens e ferramentas como Python, SQL, Power BI, Databricks, SAS, Java, Spark ou tecnologias equivalentes;
  • Experiência ou conhecimento em processos de ETL, incluindo integração e transformação de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes;
  • Interesse em aplicar soluções técnicas a desafios reais de negócio, nomeadamente nas áreas de risco, compliance, dados, fraude, governo de dados ou continuidade de negócio;

Na Deloitte nunca trabalharás sozinho. Além disso, as nossas equipas em Portugal têm projeção internacional, o que demonstra a nossa forte liderança global em low code/no code, em engenharia de redes de telecomunicações, em plataformas tecnológicas de transformação organizacional (ServiceNow e Apptio) e na indústria de serviços financeiros (Finastra, TIA e Guidewire).

Se tens interesse em explorar e desenvolver as tuas competências nalguma destas áreas em soluções tecnológicas – engenharia de software, cloud, integração de sistemas, data analytics & data science, cyber risk, engenharia de redes telecomunicações, UX design - e gostarias de trabalhar com tecnologias como AWS, Google, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, Mulesoft, Feedzai e SAS, entre outras, então estás no lugar certo!

Title: Capabilities & Insights Analytics Analyst - Sales Diagnostics Solution
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

You will apply a suite of sales assets that will help clients optimize their sales planning, coverage strategy, go-to-market model, front-line talent and commercial capabilities.

You will have responsibilities that will include translating business problems into appropriate configurations of the solution, orchestrating the solution delivery process with a global team of colleagues and preparing client deliverables with in-depth analysis and distinctive insights. You will leverage our firm’s assets to serve clients and create sustainable impact. You will often work on more than one project at a time that will include optimizing their planning, coverage strategy, go-to-market model, front-line talent, and commercial capabilities.

You will work with client representatives and McKinsey consultants in joint problem-solving sessions and will drive the process of translating data, benchmarks and analytics into value-added insights and recommendations to help clients achieve breakthrough commercial improvements including sales productivity and go-to-market excellence. You will be fully responsible for delivering our diagnostic solutions in close collaboration with both McKinsey consultants and clients. You will ensure effective and impactful diagnostic projects and scope. You will set up, run, and analyze the findings of our diagnostics. Our McKinsey consultants will look to you for guidance on setting the sales/pricing agenda for their clients and will see you as a thought partner in client development and client service strategies.

You will also be an entrepreneurial leader in our solutions team, taking ownership to improve our existing assets and helping us innovate new ones. You will be directly involved in improving the process and technology improvements needed to further scale our client support model.

Your work will give you the opportunity to enjoy the combination of McKinsey’s highly professional environment and a start-up attitude of entrepreneurship and dynamics. You’ll work in our office in Lisbon as part of our Sales Solutions team.

The Growth, Marketing & Sales (GM&S) practice strives to help clients in both consumer and business-to-business environments on a wide variety of commercial topics. Our clients benefit from our experience in core areas of GM&S such as CLM (Customer Lifecycle Management), pricing, growth acceleration, and sales and channel management.

Our practice offers an exceptional opportunity to work at the intersection of marketing, sales and consulting. Focusing on issues like redefining marketing and sales operations and commercial transformation, our people help clients build capabilities and transform how companies go to market – moving them to customer-centric organizations.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s degree with a focus on business, marketing & sales or statistics/mathematics
1+ years in a consulting/analytics position
Excel and PowerPoint skills are required; Alteryx/KNIME skills are preferred
Background in, or strong interest for, Marketing & Sales in B2B (business-to-business); willingness to specialize in the area and bring related expertise to McKinsey teams and clients
Experience applying analytics, knowledge of R/SPSS/Python and experience leveraging AI tools are a plus
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop data-driven strategies and solutions
Proven ability to extract actionable insights from complex data sets to support decisions
Confidence and ability to work with senior firm stakeholders
Sound problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly process complex information and present it clearly and simply
Entrepreneurial mindset and the willingness to work in a fast-changing environment
Curious and committed to personal development and that consistently delivers exceptional results and great ideas
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

Recolha, avaliação, tratamento e estruturação dos bancos de dados para garantir a qualidade e consistência dos mesmos

Licenciatura em Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou outra área relevante para a função
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência numa função semelhante
Experiência em SQL e Python

Experiência na criação de relatórios em CRM
Excel nível avançado

Excelentes competências analíticas
Atenção ao detalhe e proatividade

Title: Customer Development Excellence Business Analyst
Description:
Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

Sobre a Posição Procuramos um(a) CD Excellence Business Analyst, para apoiar a análise de performance do negócio, os processos de closing e forecast, o desenvolvimento de reporting e a otimização de processos e ferramentas de suporte às equipas comerciais. Esta função terá um papel fundamental na geração de insights, identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados. Principais Responsabilidades: Planeamento e Controlo de Performance Apoiar os processos de monthly closing e forecast; Garantir a criação atempada de PO's e GR's, em conformidade com os prazos definidos; Suportar a estimativa de monthly closing de Trade Operations (OOH); Monitorizar o budget e as projeções de custos, assegurando a qualidade da informação utilizada nos exercícios de forecast. Ferramentas e Suporte Comercial Assegurar o suporte funcional às aplicações de vendas e auditoria de lojas (Trax e Rex); Coordenar com fornecedores externos a resolução de incidentes e a implementação de melhorias identificadas; Contribuir para a otimização das ferramentas e dos processos que suportam a execução comercial. Análise de Dados, Reporting e Melhoria Contínua Desenvolver análises ad-hoc em resposta às necessidades das diferentes áreas do negócio; Identificar tendências, padrões e insights que suportem a tomada de decisão; Desenvolver e otimizar reports e dashboards em Power BI, garantindo a relevância, qualidade e consistência da informação disponibilizada; Documentar, analisar e rever processos, identificando oportunidades de simplificação, automatização e ganhos de eficiência; Participar em projetos de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a excelência operacional e evolução das práticas da área. Quem procuramos: Experiência Profissional Experiência em Business Analytics, Sales Analytics, Controlo de Gestão ou áreas similares será valorizada; Experiência em gestão de projetos e trabalho multifuncional. Conhecimentos Técnicos Conhecimentos avançados de Excel e Power BI; Capacidade de transformar dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio; Conhecimentos de Power Apps e Power Automate serão valorizados; Experiência em análise de dados, reporting e monitorização de indicadores de performance. Competências Comportamentais Forte capacidade analítica e orientação para a resolução de problemas; Boa capacidade de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders; Autonomia, responsabilidade e sentido de ownership; Organização, resiliência e orientação para resultados; Espírito colaborativo e foco na melhoria contínua. Formação acadêmica Licenciatura em Gestão, Economia, Engenharia, Data Analytics ou área relevante. Idiomas Inglês avançado. O que oferecemos: Pacote de remuneração competitivo; Oportunidades contínuas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento profissional; Regime de trabalho híbrido, com possibilidade de teletrabalho até 2 dias por semana; Horário de trabalho flexível; Subsídio de refeição; Seguro saúde; Seguro de vida; Plano de pensões.

Why join us?

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.


Roles with real accountability and visible impact
Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
Continuous learning and development as the business grows
Reward linked to performance and contribution.


Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Description

We are looking for a sharp and insightful Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence (BI) team. Key Responsibilities


Gather and translate business needs into technical requirements for data models and reporting solutions.
Develop, optimize, and execute SQL queries to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Design and build dynamic dashboards and reports, primarily using Power BI, to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable business insights.

Present findings and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, clearly communicating complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Participate in the full lifecycle of BI projects, from requirements gathering to final deployment.



Qualifications


3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar role focused on data and reporting.

Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, data manipulation, automation, and scripting (e.g., using Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries).
Expert hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI (or similar BI tools) for data modeling, visualization, and publishing reports.
Proven ability to gather, document, and manage business requirements effectively.
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with data.
Experience with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling is expected.



Valued Skills:


Experience with other components of the Microsoft Data Stack (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Analysis Services).
Knowledge of Data Modeling principles (e.g., Dimensional Modeling).
Professional fluency (B2+) in French is highly valued and may be a mandatory requirement for allocation on specific projects with Francophone clients.

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose


As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.


Responsibilities


Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.


Education


Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.


Experience


Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.


Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

Title: GCP/Power BI Data Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI
Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled professional to join our Squad Data RUN – Data Entreprise, dedicated to ensuring the achievement of business objectives and the effective management of daily operations, including incident resolution and necessary evolutions. This role is pivotal in supporting the transformation of our Data product and requires a strong technical background in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and data transformations tools (ETL/ELT).

Our team focuses on developing and maintaining internal corporate tools utilizing a robust technical stack that includes the BPCE SI cloud ecosystem, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Linux, Python, Power BI, Composer, and SSIS. We employ various methods and tools to enhance our workflow, including Jira and Confluence for project management, Clarity for resource planning, PowerDesigner and DataGalaxy for data modeling, and Dataplex for data management. Our testing processes are supported by Jira Xray, and we adhere to the Agile framework within the BPCE Tempo ecosystem to ensure efficient and adaptive project delivery.

Main Responsibilities


Integrate into the Performance and Run team, collaborating closely with BPCE-SI business units to guarantee the stability of existing systems.
Manage incidents effectively, ensuring minimal impact on operations while implementing necessary system evolutions.
Develop specific components in the context of construction projects, contributing to the overall enhancement of our data capabilities.
Employ Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery and Composer, to optimize data management and analysis.
Utilize Power BI for reporting and visualization, alongside data integration tools such as SSIS to ensure seamless data flow.
Work under the supervision of a squad lead to ensure optimal coordination and successful project execution.
Engage in proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into technical requirements.


Qualifications

Hard Skills:


Proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with a strong understanding of data management and integration practices.
Expertise in Power BI and data integration tools such as SSIS.
Knowledge of programming languages, particularly Python and SQL, for data analysis and manipulation.
Experience working in Agile environments, including participation in daily stand-ups and iterative development practices.
French proficiency is mandatory (B2 level, minimum).


Soft Skills


Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with business units.
Demonstrated ability to understand and prioritize user requirements effectively.
Strong problem-solving skills for effective incident management and minimizing operational impact.
Proactive communication with business stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into technical requirements.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
