Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.



Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

Title: Price Data Analyst (Paredes)
Description:
A SIXT Portugal, com sede em Paredes, Porto, é um fornecedor líder de serviços de mobilidade premium, presente em mais de 30 pontos por todo o país. Através das suas soluções SIXT rent, SIXT ride, SIXT+, bem como dos serviços direcionados para clientes Corporate e Luxury, a empresa disponibiliza uma oferta integrada, flexível e inovadora nas áreas de aluguer de veículos particulares e comerciais, transporte por aplicação e assinatura automóvel.




Com uma frota premium, uma forte cultura de inovação e uma orientação permanente para a excelência no serviço, a SIXT Portugal procura proporcionar experiências que superem as expectativas dos seus clientes, garantindo soluções de mobilidade adaptadas às suas necessidades.




As nossas Operações representam um dos principais pontos de contacto com o cliente, seja nas estações SIXT, por telefone ou por e-mail. Este departamento assume um papel essencial na qualidade da experiência do cliente, assegurando um atendimento premium, consultoria personalizada, apoio no processo de aluguer e uma gestão eficiente do dia a dia operacional.




A nível global, a SIXT é uma das principais empresas de mobilidade do mundo, contando com cerca de 7.500 colaboradores, presença em mais de 110 países e aproximadamente 2.100 estações de aluguer. Assente numa cultura de empreendedorismo, inovação, coragem para mudar e vontade de crescer, a SIXT continua a afirmar-se como uma das empresas mais dinâmicas, inovadoras e rentáveis do setor da mobilidade.




Responsabilidades:

- Analisar dados históricos de vendas, para identificar padrões e tendências.

- Monitorizar preços de mercado em diferentes canais e localizações.

- Construir, manter e atualizar modelos de pricing dinâmico que suportem decisões diárias de revenue management.

- Desenvolver e aplicar modelos preditivos com machine learning (procura, sazonalidade, impacto de promoções).

- Apoiar a equipa de gestão de frota e operações na definição de estratégias de alocação e otimização de recursos.

- Criar dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão da gestão.

- Contribuir para a definição de políticas comerciais e campanhas promocionais baseadas em análises de rentabilidade.




Perfil:

- Formação superior em Engenharia e Gestão Industrial.

- Conhecimentos de Excel avançado e SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.

- Conhecimentos em linguagens de programação (Python ou R) aplicados a análise de dados, estatística e machine learning são valorizados.

- Conhecimentos de ferramentas de visualização de dados, Power BI, Looker ou similar.

- Conhecimentos de inglês.




Oferecemos:

- Integração num Grupo sólido e credível, tendo em curso a implementação de vários projetos de crescimento.

- Formação e possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.

- Oportunidade real de progressão de carreira, de acordo com o desempenho e as competências demonstradas.

- Boas condições de trabalho e benefícios sociais (Seguro de Saúde, Seguro de Vida e possibilidade de acesso a Plano de Pensões).




Informação adicional

A SIXT Portugal pertence ao Grupo JAP, uma referência centenária no setor automóvel e da mobilidade.

O Grupo JAP representa atualmente cerca de 20 marcas automóveis, através de mais de 60 pontos de venda e reparação CARBY, detém a MATRIZAUTO, a maior megastore de viaturas seminovas e usadas do país, e é o master franchise da rent-a-car SIXT em Portugal.

Para além da sua forte presença no setor automóvel, o Grupo é também uma referência nacional no mercado das máquinas agrícolas, industriais e de movimentação de cargas, através do Entreposto Máquinas. Internacionalmente, está presente em vários mercados africanos, nomeadamente Angola, Quénia, Uganda, Tanzânia e Moçambique, onde atua nas áreas da mobilidade, veículos pesados e maquinaria agrícola e industrial.

Fazer parte do universo JAP é integrar um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução, com presença em diferentes geografias, mercados e áreas de negócio.

Se procura um desafio profissional aliciante e quer fazer parte de um projeto em crescimento, esta oportunidade é para si.

Title: Analista de Dados (m/f) - SHEQ
Description:
Descrição da Oportunidade

Estamos a reforçar a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, responsável por apoiar a definição de diretrizes, standards, indicadores e práticas de gestão em Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade em todo o Grupo. Uma das nossas prioridades é evoluir para uma gestão SHEQ cada vez mais orientada por dados, capaz de antecipar riscos, identificar tendências e apoiar decisões mais informadas.

Procuramos um/a Analista de Dados para apoiar a definição, recolha, tratamento, automatização e análise de dados SHEQ, transformando informação operacional proveniente de diferentes fontes em dashboards, indicadores e insights acionáveis para diferentes níveis da organização.

Em articulação com a equipa SHEQ Corporativa, IT e equipas SHEQ e operacionais das várias unidades de negócio, contribuirá para transformar dados e tendências em informação útil para antecipar riscos, melhorar decisões e reforçar o desempenho SHEQ do Grupo

Requisitos da Função


Formação superior em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Engenharia Informática, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia e Gestão Industrial ou área equivalente.
Experiência mínima de 3 anos em análise de dados, Business Intelligence, reporting corporativo, gestão e consolidação de informação ou funções similares.
Domínio de Power BI, DAX e Power Query, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios corporativos.
Conhecimentos sólidos de SQL e bases de dados relacionais. Conhecimentos de Python ou de outras linguagens de análise e tratamento de dados serão valorizados.
Experiência na recolha, tratamento, validação, harmonização e consolidação de dados provenientes de múltiplos projetos, empresas ou unidades de negócio.
Conhecimentos de modelação de dados, definição de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e estruturação de modelos de informação para suporte à tomada de decisão.
Experiência na integração e automatização de fluxos de dados, incluindo processos ETL, APIs, Power Platform ou ferramentas equivalentes.
Conhecimentos de estatística aplicada e análise exploratória de dados, incluindo a identificação de tendências, correlações, desvios e fatores de risco. Experiência em analítica avançada ou modelos preditivos será valorizada.
Conhecimentos de governação, qualidade e gestão de dados, assegurando a sua integridade, consistência, rastreabilidade e comparabilidade entre diferentes fontes de informação.
Fluência em português (obrigatório) e inglês (mínimo B2). Conhecimentos de espanhol ou francês serão valorizados.
Conhecimento dos processos e indicadores de Segurança, Saúde, Ambiente e Qualidade (SHEQ), incluindo gestão de incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, observações, riscos, não conformidades e desempenho ambiental, será valorizado.
Conhecimento dos referenciais ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001 será valorizado.
Disponibilidade para deslocações pontuais a projetos e mercados internacionais.


Principais tarefas


Definição, em articulação com as áreas SHEQ e operacionais, dos indicadores, dados e critérios de reporte necessários à monitorização do desempenho SHEQ.
Estruturação, harmonização e validação de dados provenientes de diferentes empresas, geografias e sistemas, assegurando a sua qualidade, consistência e comparabilidade.
Automatização dos processos de recolha, consolidação e tratamento de dados, promovendo a fiabilidade da informação.
Colaboração no desenvolvimento e melhoria contínua de plataformas, ferramentas de reporte e soluções digitais de suporte aos processos SHEQ.
Integração e análise de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, identificando tendências, desvios, padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos corporativos, assegurando a qualidade e atualização da informação.
Produção de análises e insights sobre indicadores SHEQ, incluindo incidentes, auditorias, inspeções, não conformidades, ações corretivas e desempenho ambiental.
Implementação de mecanismos de monitorização da qualidade dos dados e promoção de boas práticas de governação da informação.
Apoio à identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria através da análise de tendências e do cruzamento de dados entre processos e unidades de negócio.
Exploração de soluções de análise avançada, inteligência artificial e modelos preditivos aplicados à melhoria do desempenho SHEQ.
Apoio à realização de auditorias internas e externas.


Perfil de competências


Pensamento analítico e rigor, com preocupação pela qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados.
Capacidade de comunicar através dos dados, traduzindo análises complexas em informação clara, útil e orientada à decisão.
Visão de negócio e sensibilidade SHEQ, compreendendo os processos operacionais e as necessidades de informação que suportam a tomada de decisão.
Autonomia e proatividade, com capacidade para propor soluções e promover a melhoria contínua.
Colaboração e relacionamento interpessoal, trabalhando em articulação com equipas SHEQ, IT, outras áreas corporativas e operacionais das diferentes unidades de negócio.
Curiosidade técnica e aprendizagem contínua, acompanhando a evolução das ferramentas de dados, automação e análise avançada.
Adaptabilidade e sensibilidade intercultural, essenciais num contexto internacional e multissetorial.
Orientação para o impacto, contribuindo para a melhoria do desempenho SHEQ e para a criação de valor para o Grupo.


O que oferecemos


Integração num Grupo multinacional de referência, com presença internacional e projetos em diferentes setores e geografias.
Oportunidade de desempenhar uma função com impacto direto na forma como a informação SHEQ é recolhida, analisada e utilizada para suportar a tomada de decisão.
Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital, contribuindo para a evolução dos sistemas de informação, indicadores e ferramentas de gestão SHEQ.
Trabalho com dados provenientes de diferentes projetos, empresas e geografias, proporcionando uma visão abrangente do negócio e dos seus desafios operacionais.
Colaboração com equipas multidisciplinares das áreas SHEQ, Operações, Tecnologia e Gestão.
Possibilidade de aplicar e desenvolver competências em análise de dados, automação, Business Intelligence e análise avançada.
Ambiente de aprendizagem contínua, com contacto com diferentes realidades operacionais, culturas e práticas de gestão.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
In 1966, in Marseille, Pierre Bellon laid the foundations of what would become Sodexo, guided by a simple yet powerful idea: improving everyday life through services that truly matter.

Today, Sodexo is a global leader in Food and Services, supporting people at every moment of life, at work, in schools, hospitals and communities. With 426,000 colleagues across 43 countries, we serve 80 million consumers every day, generating €24.1 billion in revenues. Our growth goes hand in hand with social and environmental responsibility, driven by our purpose: to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all.




About Sodexo Business Services (SBS)




Portugal is no exception! Eight years ago, we established Sodexo Business Services (SBS), our shared service center. Here, you will have the opportunity to join various Financial teams such as Record to Report, Order to Cash, Purchase to Pay, Financial Analysis, and Master Data, supporting European markets and ensuring business growth.




Join Us!

We are looking for talented professionals to be part of our team, bringing unique skills and perspectives to help us grow even further.




Data Analyst

The Data Analyst is responsible for the technical execution of reporting and insight that enhances transparency & business performance with particular emphasis on digitization (Power BI), process efficiency & solution




⚙What will you do?

Enhancing our digital reporting suite & ensuring smooth execution of business-critical activities.
Demonstrate strong technical capability across reporting tools,
Accountable for scoping, designing, and delivering reporting developments.
Explore new ways to leverage reporting technologies, with a focus on building advanced proficiency in tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Ensure that reporting output and architecture is coherent and consistent with our governance framework and standards.
Evaluate reporting processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce non‑value‑adding analysis.
Engage proactively with stakeholders to deliver reporting and insights, building effective business partnerships and communicating data in a clear, relatable narrative.
Translate broad or unclear stakeholder requirements into structured reporting plans and deliverables.
Be able to shift between data modelling, content creation, commercial insight & business partnering.




🤙What You Need to Succeed:

Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
Fluency in English required, ability to speak other European language is a plus
Focus on produt excellence, integrity and costumer focus
Experiency in Power BI, Power Automate, and Excel.
Continuous improvement mindset
Communication skills
Problem solving
Be flexible and versatile




What we have to offer you?

Hybrid working model;
Flexible working hours;
Health & Life Insurance;
Meal allowance paid in Meal Card;
Additional Days off: extra vacation day, employee’s birthday, volunteering day;
Opportunity to grow professionally inside the Company;
Possibility to participate in multicultural projects;
Several internal activities aiming to promote our team´s wellbeing.

Diversity & Inclusion Statement

Sodexo is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit.




🔒 Data Privacy:

We respect your privacy. Your personal data will be used exclusively for recruitment purposes, processed under GDPR regulations, and treated confidentially. For further details, contact privacy.sbs@sodexo.com.

Title: Finance Data & Power BI Analyst
Description:
🤔Who are we?

Quanteam, founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, is a consulting firm specialized in Banking and Financial Services. With more than 1200 consultants across 10 countries, we combine business and IT expertise to support leading institutions in transformation projects.




Our core areas:

➡Quantitative Finance

➡Risk & Compliance

➡Operations & Finance

➡Transformation & Organization

➡ Information Systems.




🔎 We are looking for a Finance Data & Power BI Analyst




Main Tasks

Power BI Development: Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports from scratch, supporting financial analysis and business decision-making.
Data Integration & Modelling: Consolidate data from multiple sources, transform datasets and build robust data models to ensure data consistency, accuracy and reliability.
Data Transformation & Automation: Use Power Query and DAX to transform data, develop calculations and optimise reporting processes. Apply Python where relevant to support data processing and automation.
Financial Reporting & Analysis: Support financial closing activities, financial reporting and data reconciliation, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of financial information.
Data Quality & Reconciliation: Identify discrepancies between data sources, investigate inconsistencies and ensure the integrity of financial data.
Excel-Based Analysis: Perform advanced financial analysis and data manipulation using Excel.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, translate business needs into analytical solutions and present financial insights clearly.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, dashboard performance and data management processes.







Main Skills & Requirements

Title: Sr Specialist GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management & Solutions reporting team is looking for a Senior Specialist Reporting Analytics to support the development and delivery of operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and contribute to self-service analytics through Power BI. The role combines hands-on reporting development, data analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder support. Working within established reporting processes and data products, the role collaborates with business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable and effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards using existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Support business stakeholders in gathering and clarifying reporting requirements and contribute to the translation of defined business needs into practical reporting and analytics solutions, with guidance from more senior team members for complex or ambiguous requirements.
Analyze and troubleshoot reporting and data issues, perform initial root cause analysis, and resolve issues within own area of support, seeking guidance or escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Support the intake and coordination of reporting requests by gathering relevant information, clarifying requirements, and tracking progress in collaboration with more senior team members.
Provide support to Power Users and business users on Power BI reports, data interpretation, and established reporting practices, helping to promote self-service analytics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI development standards across Supply Planning operational teams.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), including test execution, issue documentation, and coordination of feedback.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Practical experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards.
Data & Technical Skills: Basic SQL skills with the ability to query, analyze, and validate data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate data and reporting issues and identify potential causes.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements and processes and translate them into clear reporting requirements and practical solutions, with support where requirements are complex or ambiguous.
Problem Solving: Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically, resolve straightforward problems independently, and know when to seek support or escalate.
Stakeholder Engagement: Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams. Able to explain reporting and data topics clearly to non-technical users.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams and contributing to the delivery of reporting enhancements. Ability to support UAT, document issues, and follow established delivery processes.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, work independently on defined activities, and deliver high-quality outcomes while following established processes, standards, and development practices.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Basic to intermediate experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks).
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Description:
Snapshot of your day

At Siemens Energy, we are building the next-generation HR Data Platform - a global foundation for data consolidation, governance, and analytics. We are looking for a hybrid Data Engineer & Analyst who can bridge the gap between raw data infrastructure and business intelligence.

In this role, you will own the full data lifecycle: from maintaining the consolidation layer and pipelines of our HR Data Hub to designing the final reporting solutions that empower strategic workforce decisions. You will ensure our data is not only technically sound but also accessible and insightful for business stakeholders.

How You’ll Make a Difference


Data Pipeline & Transformation Management: Design and maintain the transformation layer (using dbt and SQL) for the Internal Platform, ensuring raw data is effectively consolidated and modeled for downstream use
Analytics & Dashboarding: Develop and optimize dashboards (PowerBI) to provide key insights for HR and Operations units, directly supporting strategic business decisions
Data Quality & Governance: Act as a guardian for data integrity by implementing governance practices and monitoring data quality patterns to find and fix common issues in structured and unstructured data
Legacy Migration & Optimization: Lead or support migration projects to move legacy data pipelines to modern cloud infrastructure, aiming to eliminate technical debt, reduce costs, and restore stakeholder trust
Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data processing and reporting tasks (using Python or SQL procedures), reducing manual handling time for the HR team
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Establish clear documentation for data models and processes, creating a central knowledge base to ensure continuity and team alignment



What You Bring


Hybrid Experience: Proven cross-industry experience acting as both a Data Engineer and Data Analyst, with the ability to navigate complex pipelines and deliver business-facing insights
Core Engineering Stack: Strong hands-on expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation, along with experience in modern Data Warehousing (Snowflake)
Transformation & Visualization: Proficiency with dbt for data transformation and major visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar)
Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to troubleshooting, with experience in navigating complex or legacy data environments and driving infrastructure improvements
Communication: Fluent in English (C2 level preferred) with the ability to translate technical data concepts into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
Education: Background in Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field



About The Team

You will be working within the Human Resources function – People Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget alignment of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits


Competitive salary and meal allowance
Fair compensation for international work
Health insurance coverage
Remote work permitted within the country
Additional 5 “Pontes” days off and Birthday off if it falls on a weekday, when not abroad (only applies for Portugal)
Among others

Title: Manager GPS DPM & Solutions
Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management team is looking for a Manager Reporting Analytics to deliver operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and enable self-service analytics through Power BI.

The role combines reporting solution development, problem solving, and stakeholder engagement, acting as a bridge between business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and effective reporting solutions

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards by leveraging existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and translate business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Investigate reporting and data issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and collaborate with the Supply Chain Intelligence and Data Domain teams on global capabilities issues.
Manage reporting demand by triaging requests, prioritizing work, and coordinating the delivery of reporting solutions.
Support and enable the Power User community by providing technical guidance, promoting self-service analytics, and driving reporting best practices.
Drive continuous improvements to reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI governance across Supply Planning operational teams.
Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) and adoption of new and enhanced reporting solutions.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI reporting solutions, including DAX, data modelling, and performance optimization for operational reporting.
Data & Technical Skills: Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate reporting issues and ensure data accuracy.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business processes, gather requirements, and translate them into practical, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to investigate reporting and data issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate resolutions or escalation paths.
Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and the Power User community, adapting communication to different audiences.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams to deliver reporting enhancements, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and drive successful adoption of new reporting capabilities.
Continuous Improvement: Proactive approach to improving reporting processes, development standards, data quality, and self-service analytics through innovation and best practices.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a dynamic, global environment.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
5+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks). Experience with Python is an advantage.
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Criamos valor juntos, inovamos a cada passo e lideramos de forma próxima, reconhecendo as qualidades de cada um. Diferentes histórias e ideias unem-nos no mesmo propósito: crescer e chegar à melhor versão de nós próprios. Porque tudo o que somos, conseguimos juntos.


Temos experiências, perspetivas e percursos diferentes, mas partilhamos a mesma ambição: construir melhores soluções para os nossos clientes e alcançar, juntos, a nossa melhor versão.


Por isso, junta-te a nós!

Integrarás o Centro de Excelência de Assortment, uma equipa que trabalha em estreita colaboração com as áreas Comerciais e de Operações para garantir a definição e otimização das gamas de produtos nas nossas lojas. Title: AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst [F/M/X]
Description:
Job Description

As part of Mantu’s continued growth and digital transformation, we are looking for an AI FinOps & Platform Cost Analyst to join our IT team.

Reporting to the Data & AI Manager, you will help establish and operate Mantu’s AI FinOps capability. Your role will sit at the intersection of IT operations, data analytics, AI platform management, and financial governance.

You will provide visibility into AI and LLM consumption, build the data foundations and dashboards required to monitor usage and costs, and help the organisation optimise the performance, scalability, and commercial value of its AI platforms.

You will work closely with the Data & AI, IT, Finance, Procurement, Security, and business teams to ensure that AI services are used efficiently, sustainably, and in line with Mantu’s technical and commercial objectives.

Your missions



Build dashboard-level visibility into AI platform spend (e.g., Dust, Claude), identifying which agents and use cases drive costs
Develop predictive consumption models that go beyond linear extrapolation, enabling accurate forecasting of AI/LLM costs
Report monthly on cost, consumption trends, and risk exposure to relevant stakeholders
Identify and shift workloads off premium models where not justified, optimizing spend by aligning tasks with appropriate model tiers
Track model pricing evolution and reassess cost/quality tradeoffs as new models are released
Monitor consumption against contracted thresholds and flag commercial risks proactively
Support contract negotiation and renewal discussions with AI platform vendors in collaboration with Procurement and the AI team
Build and continuously refine Mantu’s AI cost model, incorporating external advisory input and documenting methodology for future client-facing offers[doc1]



Your profile

You have a strong interest in the intersection of IT, data, artificial intelligence, cloud platforms, and cost optimisation. You are comfortable working with technical teams and translating complex usage data into clear recommendations for business and financial stakeholders.



Experience in IT, data analytics, cloud operations, platform engineering, FinOps, or AI operations.
Experience with modeling, Python or SQL for data extraction, and generative AI tools
Academic background: Master’s degree in management, engineering, or a related field
English fluent. French is a plus.
Experience with cloud or SaaS FinOps practices
Experience building and maintaining cost dashboards or models
Familiarity with AI/LLM commercial models, including token or credit-based pricing, tiered contracts, and overage rates
You demonstrate the ability to build and defend cost/value models to non-technical stakeholders
You demonstrate comfort working with high-variance, unpredictable cost data and understanding of budget and vendor contracts
You demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills, and the ability to translate technical usage into actionable cost insights



Remuneration

Gross Annual Salary (GAS): EUR 22,000 - EUR 40,000 (basic salary only, the variable component will be detailed in the offer)

What We Offer



An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities
An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)
At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.



Mantu is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics

Who are we?

Mantu is an independent international consulting player, founded in 2007. Bringing together expert and complementary brands, Mantu stands out for the breadth of its spectrum, responding to all business transformation challenges.

Its activities are divided into four practices:

Leadership & Advocacy, Technology, Brand Strategy & Experiences and Total Talent Management.

A wide range of skills, all serving a single mission: connecting and powering companies with leading teams and technology to succeed faster and sustainably. 

From its headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland, Mantu relies on a community of 12,000 talented people in more than 60 countries on 5 continents and has a turnover of 1billion euros.

Title: HR Reporting and Analytics Manager
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose


The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.


Responsibilities


Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.


Education


Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.


Experience


Proven experience in HR reporting, data analytics, and data management within a corporate environment.
Strong knowledge of HR systems (such as SAP SuccessFactors), data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and data governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, communicate insights effectively, and align reporting strategies with business objectives.
Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.


Functional Competencies

Tools and data governance

Compliance

Analytics and reporting

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Data Management

HR Acumen

Risk Management

Innovation

Title: Analytics Engineer Mid
Description:
As a Mid-Level Analytics Engineer, you will support the development of Körber’s marketing analytics and reporting capabilities in a modern, AI-driven environment. Working closely with the data team, you will complete defined tasks in Databricks, contribute to AI agents that let users ask natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, and support selected reporting work in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric when needed. The role combines hands-on implementation with ad hoc analysis. You will need to understand relevant business logic so that your work is accurate, useful, and aligned with the intended reporting outcome. Our technology environment includes Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AI/ML services, and a central data lake.

Your role in our team


Implement SQL queries, data models, and reporting components in Databricks based on defined requirements.
Contribute to AI agents for natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, including prompt design, retrieval, testing, and evaluation.
Perform ad hoc analyses and data checks, applying relevant business logic and documenting assumptions and results.
Support the migration of selected reporting use cases from Power BI to Databricks and occasionally maintain or enhance reports in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Identify data quality issues, follow team standards for documentation and development, and collaborate with the data team to resolve open questions.


Your profile


Practical experience with SQL and Databricks or a similar cloud data platform.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, agent evaluation, or similar AI application patterns.
Genuine interest in AI, with the motivation to learn, experiment, and develop further in AI-assisted analytics.
Understanding of data analysis fundamentals and the ability to apply business logic to marketing, website, campaign, or CRM data.
Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including reports, datasets, or data models, to support occasional reporting tasks.
Reliable and collaborative working style, with the ability to complete assigned tasks, ask effective questions, and communicate clearly within the data team.


We offer you


Possibility of Working from Home – we care about results not locations;
Training Budget for each employee – we care about the growth of our people;
Private Health Insurance – we care about health on and off working hours;

A home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do;
An environment where the team thinks and acts entrepreneurial;
An international and dynamic working atmosphere with cross-functional teams;
The opportunity to take more responsibility and develop your career.

We are looking for a Senior Power BI Developer to join a technology team supporting the banking and financial services sector. This opportunity focuses on enterprise reporting, advanced data modeling, SQL-based data extraction and Power BI performance optimization in a hybrid setup based in Porto.




WHAT YOU WILL DO




- Design, build and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports and semantic models aligned with business and analytical requirements.

- Develop and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform and structure data from multiple source systems.

- Build query logic for historical data analysis using dynamic date parameters, time-based filters and customized data retrieval patterns.

- Integrate dynamic parameters into custom SQL queries within Power BI to improve data load efficiency and reporting flexibility.

- Create, optimize and maintain DAX measures, including time intelligence, filter context logic and nested calculations.

- Troubleshoot report performance, refresh duration, data model efficiency and SQL execution issues.

- Support technical quality through code reviews, best practices and guidance for junior and mid-level developers.

- More than 9 years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering or Data Analytics, with strong exposure to the Microsoft BI ecosystem.

- Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability and attention to performance, reliability and data quality.

- Ability to translate complex data structures into clear insights for technical and business stakeholders.

- Experience supporting technical decisions, sharing best practices and mentoring less experienced team members.

- Professional working proficiency in English.




TECHNICAL SKILLS




- Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.

- Advanced SQL, including subqueries, CTEs, joins, unions, aggregations and query optimization.

- DAX for foundational and advanced calculations, including time intelligence and filter context manipulation.

- Power BI data modeling, semantic models and dashboard development.

- Dynamic SQL parameters and historical data extraction logic.

- Gateway configuration, row-level security and workspace administration.

- Performance tuning for reports, data refresh processes and database queries.




NICE TO HAVE




- Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate or equivalent certification.

- Professional working proficiency in French.

- Experience in banking, financial services or regulated environments.

- Private health insurance from day one, with no waiting periods and optional family extension.

- Confidential mental health support through TEAM 24, including psychological support, content and live sessions.

- Continuous training and certification support to help you build long-term capability.

- Flexibility whenever the role and context allow it, supporting sustainable delivery and daily balance.

- Childcare vouchers and practical support measures for different life stages.

- Community moments, shared milestones and leadership presence when it matters most.

- Upskilling opportunities in quality management, information security, AI governance and cybersecurity best practices.

Description:
Who Are We

adidas Porto provides globally unified services to adidas employees, consumers and other users, based on standardized and automated solutions across different functions and markets. We leverage state of the art technology and encourage a human-centric and innovative mindset to continually raise the bar of the user experience. This is enabling us to drive operational efficiency, improved agility and better decision-making whilst reducing complexity in adidas.

Our mandate is to be the foundation for an agile and efficient company. This is our role to support adidas mission of being the best sports brand in the world.

We embrace diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and seek to create a workforce which reflects our consumers and communities. We champion individual uniqueness and cultivate a culture of belonging, so that everyone can create at their best.

Purpose & Overall Relevance For The Organization

The Global Product Supply Digital Process Management & Solutions reporting team is looking for a Senior Specialist Reporting Analytics to support the development and delivery of operational reporting solutions, analyze reporting issues, and contribute to self-service analytics through Power BI. The role combines hands-on reporting development, data analysis, problem solving, and stakeholder support. Working within established reporting processes and data products, the role collaborates with business users and central Supply Chain Management analytics teams to deliver reliable and effective reporting solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain operational Power BI reports and dashboards using existing data products, semantic models, and SQL queries against Databricks tables and views.
Support business stakeholders in gathering and clarifying reporting requirements and contribute to the translation of defined business needs into practical reporting and analytics solutions, with guidance from more senior team members for complex or ambiguous requirements.
Analyze and troubleshoot reporting and data issues, perform initial root cause analysis, and resolve issues within own area of support, seeking guidance or escalating more complex issues as appropriate.
Support the intake and coordination of reporting requests by gathering relevant information, clarifying requirements, and tracking progress in collaboration with more senior team members.
Provide support to Power Users and business users on Power BI reports, data interpretation, and established reporting practices, helping to promote self-service analytics.
Contribute to continuous improvement of reporting solutions, data quality, report performance, and Power BI development standards across Supply Planning operational teams.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT), including test execution, issue documentation, and coordination of feedback.


Key Relationships


Global Supply Planning
Global Sourcing
Global Tech, Global Data Domain
Supply Chain Intelligence
Market SCM


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Power BI Development: Practical experience developing and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards.
Data & Technical Skills: Basic SQL skills with the ability to query, analyze, and validate data from Databricks or similar cloud-based data platforms. Ability to investigate data and reporting issues and identify potential causes.
Business Analysis: Ability to understand business requirements and processes and translate them into clear reporting requirements and practical solutions, with support where requirements are complex or ambiguous.
Problem Solving: Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues systematically, resolve straightforward problems independently, and know when to seek support or escalate.
Stakeholder Engagement: Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and technical teams. Able to explain reporting and data topics clearly to non-technical users.
Collaboration & Delivery: Experience working in cross-functional teams and contributing to the delivery of reporting enhancements. Ability to support UAT, document issues, and follow established delivery processes.
Organisation & Adaptability: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities, work independently on defined activities, and deliver high-quality outcomes while following established processes, standards, and development practices.
Fluent in English (written & spoken)


Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications


Four-year degree from college or university required with emphasis in Supply Chain Management, Business analytics, Business administration or Information Systems preferred.
2+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or a related analytical role.
Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including DAX.
Basic to intermediate experience writing SQL queries to extract, validate, and analyze data from enterprise data platforms (e.g., Databricks).
Understanding of supply chain planning processes and ERP systems (e.g., SAP or SAP IBP) is preffered.

Title: Consumer Insights & Analytics Internship
Description:
About BrandDelta

At BrandDelta, we help some of the world's leading Consumer Goods and Direct-to-Consumer brands make better commercial and marketing decisions through data.

By combining consumer, market and commercial data with advanced analytics and AI, we transform complex information into clear insights that help businesses grow.

As an intern, you'll join BrandDelta for a paid, 12-month internship, becoming part of an international team working on real client projects from day one. You'll collaborate with experienced consultants, analysts and data scientists while developing practical analytical and business skills that will support your future career.




What you'll learn

During your paid 12-month internship, you'll gain exposure to how data supports business decision-making across Marketing, Consumer Insights and Revenue Growth Management, working with clients across Japan, Europe and the US.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Analyse consumer, brand and market trends.
Explore pricing, promotions and commercial performance.
Work with a variety of real-world datasets.
Develop analytical and problem-solving skills.
Build compelling presentations and business recommendations.
Learn how global Consumer Goods companies use data to make informed choices.




What you'll be doing

As part of the BrandDelta team, you'll contribute to real client projects while learning how data can be transformed into meaningful business insights and commercial recommendations. Throughout your internship, you'll have the opportunity to:

Research consumer behaviour, market trends and brand performance using a variety of data sources, including social media, search, reviews, surveys, sales and market data.
Analyse datasets to identify patterns, trends and opportunities that help answer real business and commercial questions.
Support projects related to consumer insights, pricing, promotions, sales performance, product portfolios and Revenue Growth Management.
Transform data into clear insights and compelling business recommendations through reports, dashboards and presentations.
Develop your analytical, problem-solving and storytelling skills by communicating findings in a clear, engaging and business-focused way.
Collaborate with colleagues across our Data & AI, Modelling and Insights teams, gaining exposure to different disciplines and learning how multidisciplinary teams solve complex business challenges for leading global Consumer Goods and D2C brands.




Who we're looking for

We're looking for students and recent graduates who are naturally curious, enjoy solving problems and are excited by the idea of using data to answer real business questions.

You'll be a great fit if you:

Are currently completing or have recently completed a degree in Business, Economics, Management, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field.
Have a strong record of academic achievement and extracurricular involvement.
Enjoy analysing information and turning it into meaningful insights.
Have an interest in consumer behaviour, brands, markets and business strategy.
Are comfortable working with numbers and keen to develop your analytical skills.
Communicate ideas clearly and enjoy working collaboratively with others.
Take initiative, are eager to learn and enjoy challenging yourself.
Are fluent in English, as you'll be working in an international environment.




Nice to have

You don't need previous professional experience to apply. However, it would be great if you've had exposure to any of the following through your studies, personal projects or previous internships:

Microsoft Excel and data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Basic knowledge of Python, R, SQL or other analytical tools.
Data analysis, consumer research or business analytics projects.
Marketing, commercial strategy, finance or market research concepts.
An interest in the Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry and how brands use data to make commercial and marketing decisions.




What you'll gain

At BrandDelta, we believe an internship should be more than just a learning experience — it should be the start of your professional journey.

Throughout your internship, you'll have the opportunity to:

Contribute to real projects for leading international Consumer Goods and D2C brands.
Learn from experienced consultants, analysts and data specialists through ongoing mentoring and collaboration.
Develop practical skills in data analysis, business problem-solving and strategic thinking.
Gain hands-on experience with modern analytics, AI and data visualisation tools.
Understand how global organisations use consumer, market and commercial insights to drive business growth.
Strengthen your communication and presentation skills by transforming data into clear business recommendations.
Build a solid foundation for a career in Analytics, Consumer Insights, Revenue Growth Management, Consulting, Marketing or Commercial Strategy.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



The HR Reporting and Analytics Manager is responsible for managing HR data and analytics to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions.
This role ensures the accuracy, security, and accessibility of HR data across systems, collaborates with key stakeholders to align reporting capabilities with business needs, and drives continuous improvement in data reporting, visualization, and analytics.



Responsibilities



Oversee the collection, organization, and validation of HR data across multiple platforms to ensure accuracy and integrity. Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that provide high-quality, actionable insights to support decision-making at all levels.
Partner with HR leadership and the HRIS team to align reporting and analytics strategies with broader HR and business goals, ensuring that reporting capabilities meet evolving organizational needs and support workforce planning, performance metrics, and other strategic initiatives.
Work closely with IT, Digital, and HR teams to enhance data integration, improve reporting processes, and ensure data accessibility. Act as the primary liaison for data analytics-related initiatives, promoting a data-driven culture within HR.
Identify and implement improvements to reporting and analytics processes, leveraging new tools, technology, and best practices to enhance data-driven decision-making across HR functions. Drive the adoption of advanced analytics techniques to anticipate trends and support predictive insights.
Ensure all HR data management and reporting practices adhere to internal governance standards, regulatory requirements, and data privacy regulations, and other applicable laws.
Lead and mentor HR Reporting and Analytics team, ensuring effective task assignment, skills development and alignment with team and business goals. Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and professional growth within the team.



Education



Bachelor’s degree in HR, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.



Experience



Proven experience in HR reporting, data analytics, and data management within a corporate environment.
Strong knowledge of HR systems (such as SAP SuccessFactors), data analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and data governance practices.
Demonstrated ability to interpret complex data, communicate insights effectively, and align reporting strategies with business objectives.
Excellent leadership and project management skills, with a focus on driving results and fostering a collaborative team environment.

Title: Analytics Engineer Mid
Description:
As a Mid-Level Analytics Engineer, you will support the development of Körber’s marketing analytics and reporting capabilities in a modern, AI-driven environment. Working closely with the data team, you will complete defined tasks in Databricks, contribute to AI agents that let users ask natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, and support selected reporting work in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric when needed. The role combines hands-on implementation with ad hoc analysis. You will need to understand relevant business logic so that your work is accurate, useful, and aligned with the intended reporting outcome. Our technology environment includes Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, AI/ML services, and a central data lake.

Your role in our team


Implement SQL queries, data models, and reporting components in Databricks based on defined requirements.
Contribute to AI agents for natural-language questions about marketing, website, and CRM data, including prompt design, retrieval, testing, and evaluation.
Perform ad hoc analyses and data checks, applying relevant business logic and documenting assumptions and results.
Support the migration of selected reporting use cases from Power BI to Databricks and occasionally maintain or enhance reports in Power BI or Microsoft Fabric.
Identify data quality issues, follow team standards for documentation and development, and collaborate with the data team to resolve open questions.


Your profile


Practical experience with SQL and Databricks or a similar cloud data platform.
Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, agent evaluation, or similar AI application patterns.
Genuine interest in AI, with the motivation to learn, experiment, and develop further in AI-assisted analytics.
Understanding of data analysis fundamentals and the ability to apply business logic to marketing, website, campaign, or CRM data.
Familiarity with Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, including reports, datasets, or data models, to support occasional reporting tasks.
Reliable and collaborative working style, with the ability to complete assigned tasks, ask effective questions, and communicate clearly within the data team.


We offer you


Possibility of Working from Home – we care about results not locations;
Training Budget for each employee – we care about the growth of our people;
Private Health Insurance – we care about health on and off working hours;
3 Additional Vacation Days – we care about free time;
Fresh fruits – we care about your daily dose of vitamins;

A home for passionate people who innovate, collaborate and love what they do;
An environment where the team thinks and acts entrepreneurial;
An international and dynamic working atmosphere with cross-functional teams;
The opportunity to take more responsibility and develop your career.


Recruitment Team

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Junta-te à IDW e constrói o futuro da tecnologia connosco! 🚀




Somos uma empresa portuguesa de referência, reconhecida pela excelência dos nossos serviços e, acima de tudo, pelo talento das nossas pessoas. Na IDW, combinamos inovação, conhecimento e paixão para criar soluções de negócio que fazem a diferença em grandes empresas, tanto em Portugal como além-fronteiras.

Desenhamos e implementamos projetos desafiantes, com impacto real, e procuramos mentes criativas e motivadas para crescer connosco. Se procuras um ambiente onde a tecnologia é levada a sério, o talento é valorizado e as oportunidades são reais — então o teu lugar pode ser aqui.




Estamos à procura de um Business Analyst para integrar um projeto no Porto, em modelo híbrido.




Perfil:

Mais de 3 anos de experiência técnica e funcional como Business Analyst em ambientes dinâmicos
Domínio avançado de linguagem SQL (JOINs, subqueries e funções analíticas) focado na análise de bases de dados relacionais
Experiência comprovada no ecossistema Oracle com recurso a ferramentas como PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver ou SQL Developer
Compreensão sólida de conceitos de arquitetura de dados (Data Warehouse e Data Marts) e análise de modelos (tabelas, views)
Capacidade de comunicação, autonomia na gestão de prioridades e resolução de problemas
Inglês fluente




Tarefas:

Escrever consultas SQL para extrair, analisar e validar dados diretamente nas bases de dados
Explorar e analisar dados para mapear regras de negócio subjacentes e identificar anomalias na informação
Colaborar com as equipas de Data Engineering, BI e Analytics na tradução de requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas
Elaborar documentação funcional e técnica detalhada, incluindo o mapeamento de dados
Apoiar os interlocutores de negócio na definição de requisitos com base na disponibilidade real dos dados nos sistemas Oracle
Desenhar e executar planos de testes funcionais e processos de reconciliação técnica de dados




O que temos para oferecer:

Salário compatível com o mercado e a função
Seguro de saúde
Subsídio de alimentação pago em cartão refeição
Feedback contínuo, oportunidades de evolução e reconhecimento pelo teu trabalho
Benefícios exclusivos em saúde e bem-estar, educação, restauração, cultura e lazer
Programa de referenciação de talentos

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY




We are looking for a Senior Power BI Developer to join a technology team supporting the banking and financial services sector. This opportunity focuses on enterprise reporting, advanced data modeling, SQL-based data extraction and Power BI performance optimization in a hybrid setup based in Porto.




WHAT YOU WILL DO




- Design, build and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports and semantic models aligned with business and analytical requirements.

- Develop and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform and structure data from multiple source systems.

- Build query logic for historical data analysis using dynamic date parameters, time-based filters and customized data retrieval patterns.

- Integrate dynamic parameters into custom SQL queries within Power BI to improve data load efficiency and reporting flexibility.

- Create, optimize and maintain DAX measures, including time intelligence, filter context logic and nested calculations.

- Troubleshoot report performance, refresh duration, data model efficiency and SQL execution issues.

- Support technical quality through code reviews, best practices and guidance for junior and mid-level developers.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR




- More than 9 years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering or Data Analytics, with strong exposure to the Microsoft BI ecosystem.

- Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability and attention to performance, reliability and data quality.

- Ability to translate complex data structures into clear insights for technical and business stakeholders.

- Experience supporting technical decisions, sharing best practices and mentoring less experienced team members.

- Professional working proficiency in English.




TECHNICAL SKILLS




- Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.

- Advanced SQL, including subqueries, CTEs, joins, unions, aggregations and query optimization.

- DAX for foundational and advanced calculations, including time intelligence and filter context manipulation.

- Power BI data modeling, semantic models and dashboard development.

- Dynamic SQL parameters and historical data extraction logic.

- Gateway configuration, row-level security and workspace administration.

- Performance tuning for reports, data refresh processes and database queries.




NICE TO HAVE




- Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate or equivalent certification.

- Professional working proficiency in French.

- Experience in banking, financial services or regulated environments.




WHAT WE OFFER




- Private health insurance from day one, with no waiting periods and optional family extension.

- Confidential mental health support through TEAM 24, including psychological support, content and live sessions.

- Continuous training and certification support to help you build long-term capability.

- Flexibility whenever the role and context allow it, supporting sustainable delivery and daily balance.

- Childcare vouchers and practical support measures for different life stages.

- Community moments, shared milestones and leadership presence when it matters most.

- Upskilling opportunities in quality management, information security, AI governance and cybersecurity best practices.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY




Hexa is committed to equal opportunity and to an inclusive recruitment experience, aligned with the principles of the Portuguese Diversity Charter. We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences.




HEXA LIFE




At Hexa, every professional is a Builder. You will be part of a collaborative environment built on honesty, mutual support and agility, where people are encouraged to contribute, learn, improve and create impact together.

Title: Master Data Analyst
Description:
Job Posting Title

Master Data Analyst

Legal Entity

GKN Automotive Portugal Limitada (Portugal)

Job Description Summary

This role will be responsible for the setup, administration and maintenance of master data records utilized across the business processes. They will manage Master Data processes relevant to the following workstreams: Procurement, Commercial, Finance, HR, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Engineering and Quality. Furthermore, they follow the department standards and documentation to ensure the desired level of data quality.

Job Description


Ensure adherence to Data Governance standards and naming conventions.
Manage supplier, customer, finance, quality, and manufacturing engineering master data.
Support business consistency by following group guidelines and MDM quality standards.
Ensure highest degree of data quality (e.g., identify mismatches, eliminate duplicates).
Maintain and administer master records used across business processes:
Supplier Master Data: Creation, changes, inactivation/blocking/activation across purchasing tools, ERPs, and related applications.
Customer Master Data: Creation, changes, inactivation/activation.
Finance Master Data: Maintain Chart of Accounts, cost centers, project data.
Quality Master Data: Maintain IMDS material data sheets and BOM datasets.
Manufacturing Engineering Data: Maintain item master data.


Required Skills And Education


Bachelor's degree
Working with ERPs
Analytical Processes
Attention to Detail
Language Skills
Multi-tasking
Prioritizing
Teamwork


About Dauch

Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Formed through the acquisition of Dowlais Group plc and its subsidiaries - GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy, Dauch unites deep engineering roots with global manufacturing capabilities and an entrepreneurial spirit to move mobility forward. Visit www.dauch.com to learn more.
